items.detail: LLM agents' capabilities depend not only on their underlying models but also on their execution harnesses. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a promising approach to automatically evolve these harnesses. However, deploying RSI in open-world settings still faces two critical challenges. First, open-world tasks are typically unseen during the harness design phase and novel at test time, leaving no ground-truth verifiers to reliably guide online harness edits. Second, the RSI process remains highly task-specific and fails to generalize to novel scenarios. We introduce Harness^2, a plug-and-play, recursive agent harnessing framework that addresses these challenges through two connected levels of recursion. Task-level recursion refines the current task's harness using a contrastive Propose-Probe-Compose step that reliably guides edits without ground-truth verifiers, and can be scaled further via parallel or sequential recursion. Harnessing-level recursion then extracts experience from these edits to update a continual improvement harness, enabling the agent to better adapt to future tasks. Across three professional benchmarks and four model-harness configurations, a single step consistently improves GLM-5 and Gemini 3.5 Flash over their base harnesses, yielding gains of up to 11.5 points on WorkBuddy-Bench, 4.5 points on JobBench, and 11.8 percentage points on LAB, with further gains as the task-level recursion budget increases.
items.title_zh: Harness^2：面向开放世界的递归式 Agent Harness 优化
items.detail_zh: LLM代理的能力不仅取决于其基本模型,还取决于其执行手段. 递减自修(RSI)提供了一种可以自动地发展出这些绳索的有希望的方法. 然而,在开放世界环境中部署区域安全倡议仍然面临两个重大挑战。 首先,开放世界的任务通常在利用设计阶段和试验时不为人知,没有地面真实核查员可靠地指导在线利用编辑。 第二,区域安全倡议进程仍然高度具体的任务,未能概括到新情况。 我们引入了Harness ^2,一个插座和游戏,递归剂利用框架,通过两个相联的递归层次来应对这些挑战. 任务级的重复使用对比性的提议-预测步骤改进了当前任务的利用率,该步骤可靠地指导没有地面真实核查员的编辑工作,并通过平行或相继的重复可以进一步缩小。 然后利用这些编辑的经验来更新不断改进的利用率,使代理人能够更好地适应未来的任务。 通过三个专业基准和四个模型harness配置,一个步骤不断改进GLM-5和双子座3.5 由于任务层面的重复预算增加,在基座上闪烁,在WorkBuddy-Bench、Job Bench和LAB上分别获得最多11.5分、4.5分和11.8分的收益。

items.title: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
items.subtitle: Significant progress has been made in automated problem-solving using societies of agents powered by large language models (LLMs). In finance, efforts have largely focused on single-agent systems handling specific tasks or multi-agent frameworks independently gathering data. However, the multi-agent systems' potential to replicate real-world trading firms' collaborative dynamics remains underexplored. TradingAgents proposes a novel stock trading framework inspired by trading firms, featuring LLM-powered agents in specialized roles such as fundamental analysts, sentiment analysts, technical analysts, and traders with varied risk profiles. The framework includes Bull and Bear researcher agents
items.detail: Significant progress has been made in automated problem-solving using societies of agents powered by large language models (LLMs). In finance, efforts have largely focused on single-agent systems handling specific tasks or multi-agent frameworks independently gathering data. However, the multi-agent systems' potential to replicate real-world trading firms' collaborative dynamics remains underexplored. TradingAgents proposes a novel stock trading framework inspired by trading firms, featuring LLM-powered agents in specialized roles such as fundamental analysts, sentiment analysts, technical analysts, and traders with varied risk profiles. The framework includes Bull and Bear researcher agents assessing market conditions, a risk management team monitoring exposure, and traders synthesizing insights from debates and historical data to make informed decisions. By simulating a dynamic, collaborative trading environment, this framework aims to improve trading performance. Detailed architecture and extensive experiments reveal its superiority over baseline models, with notable improvements in cumulative returns, Sharpe ratio, and maximum drawdown, highlighting the potential of multi-agent LLM frameworks in financial trading. TradingAgents is available at https://github.com/TauricResearch/TradingAgents.
items.title_zh: TradingAgents：基于多智能体大语言模型的金融交易框架
items.detail_zh: 在利用由大语言模型提供动力的代理人组成的社会自动解决问题方面取得了重大进展。 在财务方面,工作主要集中于处理具体任务的单一代理系统或独立收集数据的多代理框架。 然而,多种代理系统复制现实世界贸易公司合作动力的潜力仍然没有得到充分利用。 贸易代理公司提出了一个新的股票交易框架,其灵感来自贸易公司,其特点是由LLM驱动的代理人发挥专门作用,如基本分析师、情绪分析师、技术分析师和具有不同风险特征的贸易商。 该框架包括公牛和熊的研究人员评估市场条件、风险管理小组监测风险,以及贸易商从辩论和历史数据中综合见解,以作出知情决定。 这个框架通过模拟一个充满活力的协作性贸易环境,旨在改善贸易业绩。 详细的架构和广泛的实验显示其优于基线模型,在累积回报率,夏普比和最大缩减上都有了显著的改善,凸显了多代理LLM框架在金融交易中的潜力. 贸易代理商可在https://github.com/TauricResearch/TradingAgents查询。

items.detail: The success of large-scale pre-training paradigm, exemplified by Large Language Models (LLMs), has inspired the development of Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs). However, their application to financial candlestick (K-line) data remains limited, often underperforming non-pre-trained architectures. Moreover, existing TSFMs often overlook crucial downstream tasks such as volatility prediction and synthetic data generation. To address these limitations, we propose Kronos, a unified, scalable pre-training framework tailored to financial K-line modeling. Kronos introduces a specialized tokenizer that discretizes continuous market information into token sequences, preserving both price dynamics and trade activity patterns. We pre-train Kronos using an autoregressive objective on a massive, multi-market corpus of over 12 billion K-line records from 45 global exchanges, enabling it to learn nuanced temporal and cross-asset representations. Kronos excels in a zero-shot setting across a diverse set of financial tasks. On benchmark datasets, Kronos boosts price series forecasting RankIC by 93% over the leading TSFM and 87% over the best non-pre-trained baseline. It also achieves a 9% lower MAE in volatility forecasting and a 22% improvement in generative fidelity for synthetic K-line sequences. These results establish Kronos as a robust, versatile foundation model for end-to-end financial time series analysis. Our pre-trained model is publicly available at https://github.com/shiyu-coder/Kronos.

items.detail: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) inference on consumer hardware is bounded by weight memory: a 35B-class model is 19.5GB at 4-bit, and sparsity shrinks the compute per token, not the bytes that must be held. Naive offloading to SSD does not help on its own, because layer N+1's experts must be chosen before layer N's output exists, so the reads cannot start early enough to hide behind compute. We present Edge0, a streaming MoE inference engine that closes the gap with a prerouter: a per-layer head predicts the next layer's routing one token ahead, and the prediction is consumed as the routing itself, so the staged expert set equals the routed set and nothing is dropped. An unmerged recovery LoRA, trained on the student path, pays back the quality lost to int4 quantization and routing replacement. On a single 24GB machine, Edge0 serves a 35B MoE at 20tok/s inside 3GiB of peak active memory, within a few points of its fp16 teacher on average across five public benchmarks. An 8B tier runs on the same framework, and the framework, checkpoints, and adapters are open source.
items.title_zh: 记忆墙的另一半:用训练的跑道预测服务SSD的35B MoEs
items.detail_zh: Mixture-of-experters(MoE)对消费硬件的推论被重量内存所限制:一个35B级的模型为19.5GB分4位,而sparsity会收缩每个符的计算,而不是必须持有的字节. 将直觉卸载到SSD本身无济于事,因为N+1层的专家必须在N层输出存在之前被选中,因此读取的开始不能早到足以隐藏在计算后. 我们提出Edge0,一种用前导线来堵住缺口的流动的MOE推想引擎:每层头会预测下层的路由前出一兆,预测会作为路由本身被消耗,所以所上演的专家集等于路由集而无一被抛出. 在学生之路上接受训练的未合并恢复LORA,将损失的质量还给倒数和路由替换。 在一款24GB单机上,Edge0在峰值活性记忆的3GiB内部以20tok/s为35B MoE服务,平均在fp16教师的几分范围内服务于5个公共基准. 8B级在同一框架上运行,框架、检查站和适配器是开源的。

items.detail: Recent closed-source image generation systems can produce diverse visual content from simple compositions to information-dense graphics, yet open-weight text-to-image models still struggle with dense text and intricate layouts. To narrow this gap, we introduce MOSS-Image, an open generation system that combines high-fidelity visual synthesis with intent-aware composition. First, we pretrain a 5B single-stream diffusion transformer (DiT) from scratch with a carefully designed recipe, enabling bilingual long-form text rendering and precise layout control. Second, we develop an intention-aware agentic prompt enhancement (PE) module that translates diverse user requests into detailed content and layout specifications. Together, they enable MOSS-Image to generate text-rich and layout-coherent images. We further introduce LongLongTextBench (LLTB) for evaluating long-form English and Chinese text rendering, and RealLayoutArena (RLA) for end-to-end layout-rich generation. MOSS-Image achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-weight models on LLTB, with an average text coverage of 96.3%. On RLA, MOSS-Image ranks second in the end-to-end system comparison, while its backbone ranks first among generators evaluated with shared enhanced prompts. We will release the model, training recipe, and evaluation framework to support further research and promote the text-to-image community.
items.title_zh: 最低业务安全标准-图像技术报告
items.detail_zh: 最近的闭源图像生成系统可以产生从简单组成到信息密集图形的不同视觉内容,然而开放式的文本到图像模型仍然与密集的文本和复杂布局相抗衡. 为了缩小这一差距,我们引入了MOSS-Image,一种将高真能视觉合成和意向意识成分相结合的开源系统. 首先,我们先用精心设计的食谱从头开始训练出一款5B型单流扩散变压器(DIT),使双语长式文本渲染和精确布局控制成为可能. 第二,我们开发了一个意向意识的即时增强(PE)模块,将不同的用户请求转化为详细的内容和布局规格. 它们共同使MOSS-Image能够生成内容丰富和布局一致的图像. 我们进一步引入了LongLongText Bench(LLTB)用于评价长式英文和中文文本渲染,并引入了RealLayoutArena(RLA)用于端到端布局丰富的一代. MOSS-Image在LLTB上的开放量级模型中实现了最先进的性能,平均文本覆盖率为96.3%. 在RALA方面,MOSS-Image在端到端系统比较中排名第二,而其骨干在通过共享增强提示评价的发电机中排名第一. 我们将发布模型、培训食谱和评价框架,以支持进一步研究,并推广文本到图像社区。

items.detail: Assistants from 2011 answered and waited, and agents from 2023 did a task and stopped. In September 2026 Meta's Muse showed an agent for one person, with accounts, devices, memory and a conversation that lasts, closed, in a vendor's cloud, in one country. Such an agent is expected to act on a person's accounts and devices, remember them across weeks, speak first when it is worth it, and answer for what it did. It is a kind of software, not a model, and until now had no open counterpart. This report defines the personal agent in five questions and three horizons. It reads how Muse is built from Meta's public record and a copy of its production prompt, each statement marked by its source. It then presents nanoMuse, the open-source counterpart under the GPL-3.0, one agent on every device a person owns, with hands on the phone's screen and the computer's. They share one conversation over a relay anyone can run; every action goes through a Sentinel, memory is files the person can read, and the model is their choice. Its size and cost are given as estimates. What is open, memory with provenance, an evaluation suite for the hands and an open model for them, is set out as a roadmap.
items.title_zh: 纳米Muse:每个设备的开源个人代理
items.detail_zh: 2011年的助手回答并等待,2023年的特工做了一项任务并停下来. 2026年9月,Meta's Muse为一人展示了一名经纪人,其账号,设备,内存和对话持续,关闭,在一个卖家的云中,在一个国家. 这样的代理人应该对一个人的账户和装置采取行动,在数周内记住这些账户和装置,在值得的时候首先发言,并对它的所作所为负责。 它是一种软件,不是模型,直到现在还没有开放的对应器。 这份报告在五个问题和三个地平线中定义了个人代理人. 它读取了Muse是如何从Meta的公开记录和一份制作即时的拷贝,每个声明都用它的出处来标记. 然后呈现纳米Muse,GPL-3.0下的开源对应器,在一个人拥有的每个设备上都有一个代理,手放在电话屏幕上和电脑上. 他们通过一个接力分享一个对话 任何人都可以运行;每一个动作都通过一个哨兵, 记忆是人们能够读取的文件, 模型是他们的选择。 其规模和费用作为估计数列出。 开放的内容,有出处的记忆,手的一套评价套件和手的开放式模型,都作为路线图列出.

items.detail: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have opened new avenues for applying multi-agent systems in very large-scale simulations. However, there remain several challenges when conducting multi-agent simulations with existing platforms, such as limited scalability and low efficiency, unsatisfied agent diversity, and effort-intensive management processes. To address these challenges, we develop several new features and components for AgentScope, a user-friendly multi-agent platform, enhancing its convenience and flexibility for supporting very large-scale multi-agent simulations. Specifically, we propose an actor-based distributed mechanism as the underlying technological infrastructure towards great scalability and high efficiency, and provide flexible environment support for simulating various real-world scenarios, which enables parallel execution of multiple agents, centralized workflow orchestration, and both inter-agent and agent-environment interactions among agents. Moreover, we integrate an easy-to-use configurable tool and an automatic background generation pipeline in AgentScope, simplifying the process of creating agents with diverse yet detailed background settings. Last but not least, we provide a web-based interface for conveniently monitoring and managing a large number of agents that might deploy across multiple devices. We conduct a comprehensive simulation to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed enhancements in AgentScope, and provide detailed observations and discussions to highlight the great potential of applying multi-agent systems in large-scale simulations. The source code is released on GitHub at https://github.com/modelscope/agentscope to inspire further research and development in large-scale multi-agent simulations.
items.title_zh: 特效中非常大的多剂模拟
items.detail_zh: 最近大语言模型(LLMs)的进步为在非常大规模的模拟中应用多代理系统开辟了新的途径. 然而,在与现有平台进行多剂模拟时仍面临若干挑战,如可扩展性有限、效率低、代理多样性不尽人意、以及工作密集型管理程序等。 为了应对这些挑战,我们为AgentScope开发了几个新的功能和组件,AgentScope是一个方便用户的多代理平台,增强了它支持非常大规模多代理模拟的方便和灵活性. 具体地说,我们提议建立一个基于行动者的分布式机制,作为实现巨大可扩展性和高效益的基础技术基础设施,并为模拟各种现实世界情景提供灵活的环境支持,从而能够同时执行多种代理人、集中工作流程的管弦以及代理人之间和代理人与环境之间的相互作用。 此外,我们在AgentScope中整合了一个易于使用的可配置工具和自动背景生成管道,简化了创建具有多样而详细背景环境的代理的程序. 最后但并非最不重要的是,我们提供了一个基于网络的界面,方便地监测和管理许多可能部署在多个设备上的代理人。 我们进行全面的模拟,以展示AgentScope中拟议增强的效果,并提供详细的观察和讨论,以强调在大规模模拟中应用多剂系统的巨大潜力. 源代码发布于GitHub上 https://github.com/modelscope/agentscope,以激励在大规模多剂模拟中的进一步研发.

items.title: StartLux-Decision: AutoThink Decision Models with Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions
items.subtitle: We introduce StartLux-Decision, decision models from 0.8B to 27B parameters that combine efficient single-pass prediction with adaptive, confidence-guided reasoning. items.detail: We introduce StartLux-Decision, decision models from 0.8B to 27B parameters that combine efficient single-pass prediction with adaptive, confidence-guided reasoning. The Instant models use bidirectional attention in full-attention layers to improve decision accuracy while keeping single-pass inference. The AutoThink models invoke explicit reasoning for uncertain decisions and answer confident cases directly. A three-stage training pipeline establishes shared decision capabilities, specializes the two variants, and equips AutoThink with reasoning through reasoning supervision and reinforcement learning. We introduce Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions (RLCD^2), which uses a frozen model and proper scoring rules to reward improvements in decision probability quality and applies a soft penalty to overlong reasoning traces. RLCD^2 raises the share of reasoning traces that terminate within the generation limit by up to 48 percentage points and cuts average reasoning length by up to 65%, while largely preserving decision accuracy. On the public subset of Decision Index 0.3, the Instant models outperform the strongest evaluated comparable-scale open-weight decision models by 7.4-16.9 points, and the 27B AutoThink model reaches 73.4. We also introduce DecisionPivot, a programmatically verifiable benchmark of computational decisions built from contrast pairs that differ in a single answer-changing detail. On DecisionPivot, AutoThink outperforms its Instant counterparts by 11.5-18.4 points in pair accuracy and leads among evaluated systems. The models run on vLLM, llama.cpp and MLX, with quantized variants for lower memory use.
items.title_zh: StartLux- decision: 将决定模式与强化学习相结合, 用于校正设计决定
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了StartLux-Decision,决定模型从0.8B到27B参数,将高效的单行道预测与适应性强的,有信心引导的推理相结合. 即时模型在全注层中采用双向注意来提高决策精度,同时保持单通推论. Auto Think模型为不确定的决定引用了明确的推理,直接回答自信的案件. 一个分三阶段的培训管道建立了共同的决策能力,专门处理两个变体,并通过推理监督和强化学习,使Auto Think具备推理能力. 我们引入了 " 强化学习 " (RLCD^2),它使用被冻结的模式和适当的评分规则来奖励决策概率质量的提高,并对过长的推理痕迹适用软惩罚。 RLCD^2将在生成限内终止的推理分量提升了48个百分点,将平均推理长度削减了65%,同时在很大程度上保持了决定的准确性. 在决定指数0.3的公共子集上,即时模型的性能超过了最强的被评价的可比较尺度开放量级决定模型7.4-16.9分,而27B AutoThink模型达到73.4分. 我们还采用了“决定支柱”这一可进行方案核查的计算决定基准,该基准是根据在单一的答案变化细节上有所不同的对比对作出的。 关于 " 决定支柱 " , " 自动思维 " 系统在对等系统中的精确度和领先性比对对等系统高出11.5至18.4分。 模型运行于vLLM,lama.cpp和MLX上,并有被量化的变体,用于较低的内存使用.

items.title: Prism: Dynamic Sparse Attention for Native 2K Joint Video-Audio Generation Model Training

items.detail: Natively training joint video-audio generation models at higher resolutions empowers them to learn richer visual details and sharper motion dynamics. However, full attention incurs quadratic cost and, as resolution increases, spreads attention over increasingly redundant tokens, diluting learning signals for informative content and disrupting pretrained priors. Existing sparse attention methods either target training-free acceleration or overlook the unique structure of joint video-audio data, where cross-modal interactions are inherently concentrated around sound-producing regions. To address this, we propose Prism, a dynamic sparse attention framework for natively training joint video-audio generation models at 2K. In particular, Prism organizes the token sequence into spatiotemporal macro-zones, enabling the attention structure to adapt to local content. For each zone, it estimates local information structure via video feature variance along the channel and feature norms from the audio-to-video cross-attention, jointly capturing how visual content varies directionally and how strongly audio influences each visual region. Based on these signals, Prism dynamically assigns a tailored block shape to each zone, applying finer partitioning along axes of rapid visual content variation and strong audio-visual coupling. This encourages tokens within each block to remain semantically coherent, allowing block-level features to capture both visual content and joint video-audio interaction patterns. Prism further adopts a hybrid block selection strategy to dynamically determine per-query sparsity. Experiments show that Prism achieves 2.5times training speedup compared to full attention, while surpassing it in generation quality.
items.title_zh: 棱镜:动态 sparse 关注土著 2K 联合视频-音频生成模式培训
items.detail_zh: 原地训练高分辨度的联合视频-音频生成模型,赋予他们学习更丰富的视觉细节和更锐利的运动动态的能力. 然而,充分关注需要四重费用,随着分辨率的增加,注意力分散在日益冗余的标志上,淡化信息内容的学习信号并打乱预先训练过的前科。 现有的注意力稀少的方法要么针对无培训加速,要么忽略了联合视频-音频数据的独特结构,其中跨模式互动本质上集中在声音制作区域。 为了解决这个问题,我们提议Prism, 一个动态的零散关注框架, 本地培训联合视频-音频生成模型 在2K。 特别是"棱镜"(Prism)将符号序列组织为spatiotal宏区,使关注结构能够适应本地内容. 对于每个区,它通过视频功能沿信道的差异和音频对视频交叉注意的特征规范来估计本地信息结构,共同捕捉视觉内容在方向上的差异以及音频对每个视觉区域的强烈影响。 基于这些信号,棱镜能动态地为每个区指定一个量身定制的块形,沿快速视觉内容变异和强烈相声相通的轴进行更细的分化. 这鼓励了每个区块内的道具保持相通一致,使区块级的功能既能捕捉到视觉内容又能捕捉到视频-音频联合互动模式. 棱镜还采用了混合区块选择策略来动态地确定每个平滑的相片. 实验显示,与全注意力相比,棱晶实现了2.5次训练加速,同时在生成质量上超过了它.

items.detail: Driven by rapid advancements of Large Language Models (LLMs), agents are empowered to combine intrinsic knowledge with dynamic tool use, greatly enhancing their capacity to address real-world tasks. In line with such an evolution, AgentScope introduces major improvements in a new version (1.0), towards comprehensively supporting flexible and efficient tool-based agent-environment interactions for building agentic applications. Specifically, we abstract foundational components essential for agentic applications and provide unified interfaces and extensible modules, enabling developers to easily leverage the latest progress, such as new models and MCPs. Furthermore, we ground agent behaviors in the ReAct paradigm and offer advanced agent-level infrastructure based on a systematic asynchronous design, which enriches both human-agent and agent-agent interaction patterns while improving execution efficiency. Building on this foundation, we integrate several built-in agents tailored to specific practical scenarios. AgentScope also includes robust engineering support for developer-friendly experiences. We provide a scalable evaluation module with a visual studio interface, making the development of long-trajectory agentic applications more manageable and easier to trace. In addition, AgentScope offers a runtime sandbox to ensure safe agent execution and facilitates rapid deployment in production environments. With these enhancements, AgentScope provides a practical foundation for building scalable, adaptive, and effective agentic applications.
items.title_zh: AgentScope 1.0: 构建代理应用程序的开发者-子框架
items.detail_zh: 在"大语言模型"(LLMS)的快速进步的推动下,代理人被赋予了将内在知识与动态工具使用相结合的能力,极大地增强了他们处理现实世界任务的能力. 根据这一演变,AgentScope在新版本(1.0)中引入了重大改进,以全面支持基于工具的Agent-Environment互动,以构建Agent应用. 具体来说,我们抽象出对代理应用程序至关重要的基础组件,并提供统一的接口和可扩展模块,使开发者能够轻松地利用最新进展,如新模型和MCP. 此外,我们在ReAct范式中的地面代理行为,并提供基于系统同步设计的先进的代理一级基础设施,这丰富了人与代理人和代理人之间的互动模式,同时提高了执行效率。 在这个基础上,我们综合了几个适合具体实际情况的内在代理人。 AgentScope还包括对开发者友好体验的强力工程支持. 我们提供了一个可伸缩的评价模块,带有可视工作室接口,使长射剂应用的开发更便于管理并更容易被追踪. 此外,AgentScope还提供运行时的沙盒来保证安全剂执行,并便利生产环境中的快速部署. 通过这些增强,AgentScope为构建可伸缩,可适应,可有效使用的Agent.

items.detail: High throughput serving of large language models (LLMs) requires batching sufficiently many requests at a time. However, existing systems struggle because the key-value cache (KV cache) memory for each request is huge and grows and shrinks dynamically. When managed inefficiently, this memory can be significantly wasted by fragmentation and redundant duplication, limiting the batch size. To address this problem, we propose PagedAttention, an attention algorithm inspired by the classical virtual memory and paging techniques in operating systems. On top of it, we build vLLM, an LLM serving system that achieves (1) near-zero waste in KV cache memory and (2) flexible sharing of KV cache within and across requests to further reduce memory usage. Our evaluations show that vLLM improves the throughput of popular LLMs by 2-4times with the same level of latency compared to the state-of-the-art systems, such as FasterTransformer and Orca. The improvement is more pronounced with longer sequences, larger models, and more complex decoding algorithms. vLLM's source code is publicly available at https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm
items.title_zh: 高效的大型语言模型内存管理
items.detail_zh: 服务于大型语言模型的高吞吐量要求一次批量地提出足够多的请求. 然而,由于每个请求的密钥-值缓存(KV缓存)内存巨大并不断增长并动态收缩,所以现有系统挣扎. 如果管理效率低下,这种内存可能会被破碎和多余的重复大量浪费,限制了批量大小. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出PagedAttenty,一种受经典虚拟内存和操作系统中的呼唤技术所启发的注意力算法. 除此之外,我们建造了vLLM,一个LLM服务系统,实现(1) KV缓存内存中的近零废物,和(2) 在请求内部和相互之间灵活共享KV缓存,以进一步减少内存使用. 我们的评估表明,vLLM比最新系统,如S更快的Transformer和Orca,在耐久性上提高2-4次流行LLM的吞吐量。 改进更为显著的是较长的序列,更大的模型,更复杂的解码算法. vLLM的源代码可在https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm上公开查阅.

items.detail: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer parallel sampling for faster generation than autoregressive models, an increasingly important advantage as inference becomes a dominant computational workload. However, DLMs degrade quickly with fewer sampling steps, process the full sequence at every step, and require many passes over the dataset to reach good quality. We introduce Next-Concept Modeling (NCM), a two-stage, coarse-to-fine framework: a multiscale residual VQ-VAE encodes text into a hierarchy of discrete codes, and a transformer generates one level at a time, predicting all codes within a level in parallel. At matched parameter scales, NCM achieves better generative perplexity than the strongest DLM baseline on LM1B while running 21times faster. On OpenWebText, NCM is competitive with the strongest DLM while running 10times faster; on XSum, it matches the strongest DLM's ROUGE-L while being 31times faster. On the reasoning task of Sudoku, NCM outperforms autoregressive and diffusion baselines across all difficulty levels, using fewer function evaluations. items.title: OpenDevin: An Open Platform for AI Software Developers as Generalist Agents

items.detail: Software is one of the most powerful tools that we humans have at our disposal; it allows a skilled programmer to interact with the world in complex and profound ways. At the same time, thanks to improvements in large language models (LLMs), there has also been a rapid development in AI agents that interact with and affect change in their surrounding environments. In this paper, we introduce OpenDevin, a platform for the development of powerful and flexible AI agents that interact with the world in similar ways to those of a human developer: by writing code, interacting with a command line, and browsing the web. We describe how the platform allows for the implementation of new agents, safe interaction with sandboxed environments for code execution, coordination between multiple agents, and incorporation of evaluation benchmarks. Based on our currently incorporated benchmarks, we perform an evaluation of agents over 15 challenging tasks, including software engineering (e.g., SWE-Bench) and web browsing (e.g., WebArena), among others. Released under the permissive MIT license, OpenDevin is a community project spanning academia and industry with more than 1.3K contributions from over 160 contributors and will improve going forward.
items.title_zh: OpenDevin:作为通用代理的AI软件开发者的开放平台
items.detail_zh: 软件是我们人类拥有的最强大的工具之一;它允许一个技术熟练的程序员以复杂而深刻的方式同世界互动. 同时,由于大语言模型(LLMS)的改进,AI代理也迅速发展出与周围环境相互作用并影响其变化. 在本文中,我们引入了OpenDevin,这是一个开发强大而灵活的AI代理的平台,它以与人类开发者相似的方式与世界互动:通过写出代码,与命令行互动,并浏览网络. 我们描述了该平台如何允许实施新的代理、与用于代码执行的沙箱环境的安全互动、多个代理之间的协调以及纳入评价基准。 根据我们目前纳入的基准,我们对超过15个具有挑战性任务的代理人进行评估,包括软件工程(例如SWE-Bench)和网络浏览(例如WebArena)等. OpenDevin是根据允许的麻省理工学院许可证发布的,是一个涵盖学术界和工业界的社区项目,160多名捐助者贡献了1.3K多笔捐款,并将改进工作。

items.detail: Recently, end-to-end OCR models, exemplified by DeepSeek OCR, have once again thrust OCR into the spotlight. A widely held view is that employing a large language model (LLM) as the decoder allows the model to leverage the prior distribution of language, leading to improved OCR performance. However, the downside is equally evident: as the output sequence lengthens, the accumulated KV cache drives up memory consumption and progressively slows down generation. This stands in stark contrast to humans, who exhibit no such decline in efficiency during long-horizon copying tasks. In this technical report, we propose Unlimited OCR, a model designed to emulate human parsing working memory. Taking DeepSeek OCR as the baseline, we replace all attention layers in the decoder with our proposed Reference Sliding Window Attention (R-SWA), which reduces attention computation costs while maintaining a constant KV cache throughout the entire decoding process. By combining the high compression rate of DeepSeek OCR's encoder with our constant KV cache design, Unlimited OCR can transcribe dozens of pages of documents in a single forward pass under a standard maximum length of 32K. More importantly, R-SWA is a general-purpose parsing attention mechanism - beyond OCR, it is equally applicable to tasks such as ASR, translation, etc. Codes and model weights are publicly available at http://github.com/baidu/Unlimited-OCR.
items.title_zh: 无限制 OCR 工程
items.detail_zh: 最近,端到端的OCR模型,由DeepSeek OCR所取出的例子,再次将OCR推入了聚光灯. 一个被广泛持有的观点是,使用一款大语言模型(LLM)作为解码器可以使该模型能利用语言的先发后发,从而导致OCR性能得到改进. 然而,下行同样明显:随着输出序列的延长,所积累的KV缓存驱动了内存消耗并逐渐减慢了生成. 这与人类形成了鲜明的对照,在长距离复制任务期间,人类的效率没有下降。 在这份技术报告中,我们提出无限OCR,这个模式旨在模仿人类解析工作记忆. 以DeepSeek OCR为基线,我们用我们提出的"参考滑动窗口注意"(R-SWA)来取代解码器中的所有注意层,这降低了注意计算成本,同时在整个解码过程中保持了恒定的KV缓存. 通过将DeepSeek OCR编码器的高压缩率与我们恒定的KV缓存设计相结合,无限制的OCR可以将数十页的文件以单个前行传转出,标准最高长度为32K. 更重要的是,R-SWA是一种通用的解析注意力机制——除了OCR之外,它同样适用于ASR,翻译等任务. 代码和模型权重可在http://github.com/baidu/Unlimited-OCR上公开查阅.

items.title: Internal Safety Collapse in Frontier Large Language Models
items.subtitle: This work identifies a critical failure mode in frontier large language models (LLMs), which we term Internal Safety Collapse (ISC): under certain task conditions, models enter a state in which they continuously generate harmful content while executing otherwise benign tasks. We introduce TVD (Task, Validator, Data), a framework that triggers ISC through domain tasks where generating harmful content is the only valid completion, and construct ISC-Bench containing 53 scenarios across 8 professional disciplines. items.detail: This work identifies a critical failure mode in frontier large language models (LLMs), which we term Internal Safety Collapse (ISC): under certain task conditions, models enter a state in which they continuously generate harmful content while executing otherwise benign tasks. We introduce TVD (Task, Validator, Data), a framework that triggers ISC through domain tasks where generating harmful content is the only valid completion, and construct ISC-Bench containing 53 scenarios across 8 professional disciplines. Evaluated on JailbreakBench, three representative scenarios yield worst-case safety failure rates averaging 95.3% across four frontier LLMs (including GPT-5.2 and Claude Sonnet 4.5), substantially exceeding standard jailbreak attacks. Frontier models are more vulnerable than earlier LLMs: the very capabilities that enable complex task execution become liabilities when tasks intrinsically involve harmful content. This reveals a growing attack surface: almost every professional domain uses tools that process sensitive data, and each new dual-use tool automatically expands this vulnerability--even without any deliberate attack. Despite substantial alignment efforts, frontier LLMs retain inherently unsafe internal capabilities: alignment reshapes observable outputs but does not eliminate the underlying risk profile. These findings underscore the need for caution when deploying LLMs in high-stakes settings. Source code: https://github.com/wuyoscar/ISC-Bench
items.title_zh: 边境大语言模型的内部安全碰撞
items.detail_zh: 这项工作确定了边疆大语言模型(LLMs)中的关键故障模式,我们称之为"内部安全碰撞"(ISC):在某些任务条件下,模型进入一种状态,在持续生成有害内容的同时执行本来是良性的任务. 我们引入了TVD(任务,验证器,数据),这个框架通过域任务触发ISC,其中产生有害内容是唯一有效的完成,并构建了ISC-Bench,包含8个专业学科的53个情景. 三种具有代表性的情景在四个边境有限责任公司(包括GPT-5.2和Claude Sonnet 4.5)中平均得出了95.3%的最严重的安全故障率,大大超过了标准的越狱袭击。 边疆模型比早先的有限责任措施更脆弱:当任务本质上涉及有害内容时,使复杂任务得以执行的能力就成为责任。 这揭示出攻击面越来越大:几乎每个专业领域都使用处理敏感数据的工具,每个新的双重用途工具都自动地扩大这种脆弱性——即使没有故意攻击。 尽管做出了大量调整努力,前沿有限责任管理方案仍保留固有的不安全内部能力:调整重塑了可观察到的产出,但并没有消除潜在的风险。 这些调查结果突出表明,在高收量环境中部署法学硕士时必须谨慎。 资料来源:https://github.com/wuyoscar/ISC-Bench。

items.detail: Scaling data, diversity and model capacity has improved embodied learning in physical environments, where diverse experiences remain grounded in shared physical laws. Whether these gains extend to virtual worlds with different visual styles, dynamics, controls, and objectives remains unclear. We investigate this question through a controlled study of continued pre-training (CPT) across three axes: data volume, diversity, and model size. Our 120 training configurations span four model sizes from 0.8B to 27B, six data budgets from 50 to 1,600 hours, and five mixtures ranging from Minecraft-only data to diverse multi-world corpora. We assess performance and generalization using three-level validation losses and gameplay benchmarks from in-corpus worlds to unseen worlds. Our results show: (1) more data improves in-corpus performance, diversity improves transfer to related worlds with limited gains in distant worlds, and model size improves data efficiency but generalizes worse to distant worlds under single-world training; (2) we observe an early interface phase with broad cross-world benefits and a later world phase with gains narrowed to in-corpus and related worlds, and fit an empirical scaling law relating validation loss to data volume, diversity and model size; and (3) our models are competitive with Minecraft specialists and frontier models in 3D worlds, and perform best in real-time settings. However, the limits of imitation and persistent gaps in distant worlds suggest that building generalist embodied agents requires richer training stages beyond continued pre-training.
items.title_zh: 在游戏中缩放:继续在不同的虚拟世界中为健康代理者进行预训
items.detail_zh: 扩大数据、多样性和示范能力提高了在物理环境中的学习,在物理环境中,各种经验仍然以共同的物理法为基础。 这些收益是否扩展到视觉风格、动态、控制和目标的虚拟世界,仍然不清楚。 我们通过对三个轴心(数据量、多样性和模型规模)的持续培训(CPT)进行有控制的研究来调查这一问题。 我们的120个训练配置跨越了从0.8B到27B的4个模型大小,从50小时到1 600小时的6个数据预算,以及从Minecraft专用数据到多样化多世界公司等5个混合物。 我们利用从公司内部世界到看不见世界的三级验证损失和游戏游戏基准来评估业绩和概括。 我们的结果显示:(1) 更多的数据能提高公司内部的性能,多样性能改善向远世界收益有限的相关世界的转移,模型规模能提高数据效率,但对单世界训练下的相距遥远世界的通用程度更差;(2) 我们观测到一个具有广泛跨世界效益的早期接口阶段,以及一个收益被缩小到公司内部和相关世界的后一世界阶段,并适应一个经验性缩放法,将验证损失与数据数量、多样性和模型规模相挂钩;(3) 我们的模型与3D世界的Minecraft专家和前沿模型具有竞争力,在实时环境下表现最好。 然而,在遥远的世界中,模仿的局限性和长期存在的差距表明,建设泛泛论的代理人需要超越持续的培训前阶段的更丰富的培训阶段。

items.detail: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable for fine-grained visual perception. In this report, we present WeVisOne-VL (WeChat Vision All-in-One), a powerful VLM that unifies object-level and pixel-level perception through structured next-token prediction. It supports multiple visual tasks including object detection, referring localization, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting, enabling localization at any user-specific granularity, from points and boxes to masks and alpha mattes. Architecturally, we integrate a lightweight pixel decoder into the VLM via a special <OBJ> token to generate instance-level pixel outputs. We train the model with a three-stage curriculum SFT followed by mixed-task RL. Across over 30 benchmarks, WeVisOne-VL demonstrates leading performance on both object-level and pixel-level tasks, while maintaining robust rejection for object-absent queries. By releasing WeVisOne-VL to the open-source community, we hope to advance VLMs from broad visual understanding toward truly reliable perception systems for real-world deployment.
items.title_zh: WeVisOne-VL:从对象到像素的统一视觉感受
items.detail_zh: 现有视觉语言模型(VLMs)对于精细的视觉感知仍然不可靠. 在本报告中,我们介绍了WeVisOne-VL(WeChat Vision All-in-One),这是一种强大的VLM,通过结构化的下个托肯预测,统一对象级和像素级的感知. 它支持多个视觉任务,包括对象检测,转介本地化,计数,OCR,分化,和相交,使得任何用户特有的颗粒都能够本地化,从点和盒到口罩和α相交. 建筑上,我们通过一个特殊的"OBJ"符号,将一个轻量级像素解码器整合到VLM中,以生成实例级像素输出. 我们用三个阶段的课程SFT来训练这个模型,然后是混合任务RL. 在超过30个基准中,WeVisOne-VL在对象级别和像素级别的任务中都显示出领先的性能,同时保持对对象偏差查询的强烈拒绝. 通过将We VisOne-VL释放给开源社区,我们希望将VLM从广义的视觉理解推进到真正可靠的感知系统,用于现实世界的部署.

items.detail: We introduce SmolDocling, an ultra-compact vision-language model targeting end-to-end document conversion. Our model comprehensively processes entire pages by generating DocTags, a new universal markup format that captures all page elements in their full context with location. Unlike existing approaches that rely on large foundational models, or ensemble solutions that rely on handcrafted pipelines of multiple specialized models, SmolDocling offers an end-to-end conversion for accurately capturing content, structure and spatial location of document elements in a 256M parameters vision-language model. SmolDocling exhibits robust performance in correctly reproducing document features such as code listings, tables, equations, charts, lists, and more across a diverse range of document types including business documents, academic papers, technical reports, patents, and forms -- significantly extending beyond the commonly observed focus on scientific papers. Additionally, we contribute novel publicly sourced datasets for charts, tables, equations, and code recognition. Experimental results demonstrate that SmolDocling competes with other Vision Language Models that are up to 27 times larger in size, while reducing computational requirements substantially. The model is currently available, datasets will be publicly available soon.
items.title_zh: SmolDocling:用于端到端多模式文件转换的超共通视觉语言模型
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了SmolDocling,一种针对端到端文件转换的超共通视觉语言模型. 我们的模型通过生成 DocTags 来全面处理整个页面,这是一种新的通用标记格式,它将所有页面元素与位置完全结合。 SmolDocling与依赖大型基础模型的现有方法,或依赖多款专业模型的手动管道的综艺解决方案不同,它提供了一个从端到端的转换,以便在256M参数视觉语言模型中准确捕捉文件元素的内容,结构和空间位置. SmolDocling在正确复制诸如代码列表、表格、方程式、图表、列表等文件特征方面表现出了强劲的性能,在包括商业文件、学术论文、技术报告、专利和表格在内的各种文件类型中表现得更多 -- -- 远远超出了通常观察到的科学论文重点。 此外,我们提供了新的公开来源的数据集,用于图表、表格、方程式和代码识别。 实验结果表明斯摩尔道克林与其他尺寸可达27倍的Vision语言模型竞争,同时大幅降低了计算要求. 该模型目前可供使用,数据集将很快公开。

items.detail: Symbolic models make melody, harmony, rhythm, and form explicit but typically stop before a finished recording; audio models produce complete songs while leaving composition implicit. We introduce YuE2, which unifies symbolic and audio music generation at frontier quality through symbolic planning. A single AR-NAR Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) first writes a readable score specifying melody and harmony, expands it into semantic music tokens, and realizes it as full-song audio. In comparisons using the same checkpoint, experts prefer symbolic planning for overall quality and musicality, with 49.3% of overall preferences versus 34.6% without planning. Experts also favor the unified model over a separate language model and diffusion Transformer. On WildSongBench, YuE2 scores 6.73 on SongBench Global Avg, exceeding all evaluated public baselines. Selecting from eight candidates (best-of-8), YuE2 reaches 6.96, the highest observed mean among all evaluated systems. Expert listening further establishes its competitiveness with proprietary song generators, favoring best-of-8 over Suno v4.5 and yielding nearly balanced preferences against Suno v5. To learn this generation process from recordings without aligned scores, we introduce MERT2 and SheetSage2 to supply semantic and symbolic supervision. MERT2 sets a new state of the art in music representation learning, surpassing previous best results on 14 of 15 MARBLE metrics; SheetSage2 leads 12 of 15 benchmark-metric pairs in our lead-sheet transcription comparison. The same checkpoint follows score edits while largely preserving unedited musical content and generates zero-shot covers without cover-specific training. Its readable score also enables agentic music editing, with external language models translating user feedback into revisions of the composition.
items.title_zh: YUE2: 统一符号和音频音乐制作,以边疆质量
items.detail_zh: 符号模型会使旋律,和谐,节奏,并形成清晰而典型地在完成录制之前停止;音频模型会产生完整的歌曲而同时会留下含蓄的成分. 我们介绍YUE2,它通过象征性的规划,统一了象征和音频音乐的制作,具有前沿质量。 单曲AR-NAR Mixture-of-Transfers (MOT)首先会写出可读分数来明确旋律与和谐,将其扩展为语义音乐符号,并实现为全相声. 在使用同一检查站进行比较时,专家倾向于对整体质量和音乐性进行象征性规划,49.3%的总体偏好,34.6%没有规划。 专家们还赞成统一模式,而不是单独的语言模式和传播变形器。 在"WildSong Bench"上,YuE2在"Song Bench Global Avg"上得分6.73分,超过了所有评价的公共基线. 从8名候选人(最佳8名)中挑选,YuE2达到6.96,是所有被评价系统中观察到的最高平均值。 专家聆听进一步确立了其与专有歌曲生成器的竞争力,偏好最佳-8优于Suno v4.5并产生与Suno v5相近的平衡偏好. 为了从没有对齐分数的录音中学习这一代过程,我们引入了MERT2和SetSage2来提供语义和符号监督. items.detail: We introduce MinerU2.5, a 1.2B-parameter document parsing vision-language model that achieves state-of-the-art recognition accuracy while maintaining exceptional computational efficiency. Our approach employs a coarse-to-fine, two-stage parsing strategy that decouples global layout analysis from local content recognition. In the first stage, the model performs efficient layout analysis on downsampled images to identify structural elements, circumventing the computational overhead of processing high-resolution inputs. In the second stage, guided by the global layout, it performs targeted content recognition on native-resolution crops extracted from the original image, preserving fine-grained details in dense text, complex formulas, and tables. To support this strategy, we developed a comprehensive data engine that generates diverse, large-scale training corpora for both pretraining and fine-tuning. Ultimately, MinerU2.5 demonstrates strong document parsing ability, achieving state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks, surpassing both general-purpose and domain-specific models across various recognition tasks, while maintaining significantly lower computational overhead.
items.title_zh: MinerU2.5:高效高分辨率文档解析脱钩的视野-语言模型
items.detail_zh: 我们引进了MinerU2.5, 一种1.2B参数文档,分析视觉语言模型,在保持特殊计算效率的同时,实现最先进的识别精度。 我们的方法采用一种粗糙的、两阶段的解析战略,将全球布局分析与当地内容识别脱钩。 在第一阶段,该模型对被下取样的图像进行高效的布局分析,以识别结构元素,绕过处理高分辨率输入的计算间接费用. 在第二阶段,它以全球布局为指导,对取自原始图像的本地分辨率作物进行目标明确的内容识别,保留了密集文本、复杂公式和表格中精细的细节。 为了支持这一策略,我们开发出一个全面的数据引擎,为预训和微调产生多样化的大规模培训公司. 归根结底,MinerU2.5显示出强大的文件解析能力,在多个基准上实现了最先进的性能,超越了各种识别任务的通用模式和特定域模式,同时维持了显著较低的计算间接费用。

items.detail: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable prowess in generating contextually coherent responses, yet their fixed context windows pose fundamental challenges for maintaining consistency over prolonged multi-session dialogues. We introduce Mem0, a scalable memory-centric architecture that addresses this issue by dynamically extracting, consolidating, and retrieving salient information from ongoing conversations. Building on this foundation, we further propose an enhanced variant that leverages graph-based memory representations to capture complex relational structures among conversational elements. Through comprehensive evaluations on LOCOMO benchmark, we systematically compare our approaches against six baseline categories: (i) established memory-augmented systems, (ii) retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with varying chunk sizes and k-values, (iii) a full-context approach that processes the entire conversation history, (iv) an open-source memory solution, (v) a proprietary model system, and (vi) a dedicated memory management platform. Empirical results show that our methods consistently outperform all existing memory systems across four question categories: single-hop, temporal, multi-hop, and open-domain. Notably, Mem0 achieves 26% relative improvements in the LLM-as-a-Judge metric over OpenAI, while Mem0 with graph memory achieves around 2% higher overall score than the base configuration. Beyond accuracy gains, we also markedly reduce computational overhead compared to full-context method. In particular, Mem0 attains a 91% lower p95 latency and saves more than 90% token cost, offering a compelling balance between advanced reasoning capabilities and practical deployment constraints. Our findings highlight critical role of structured, persistent memory mechanisms for long-term conversational coherence, paving the way for more reliable and efficient LLM-driven AI agents.
items.title_zh: Mem0: 搭建可扩展长期记忆的制作- Ready AI代理
items.detail_zh: 大型语言模型在生成背景一致的响应方面表现出了显著的优势,但其固定的上下文窗口对于在长时间的多会对话中保持一致性构成了根本性的挑战。 我们引入了Mem0,一种可伸缩的以记忆为中心的架构,通过动态地从正在进行的对话中提取,整合并检索出显著信息来解决这个问题. 在这个基础上,我们进一步提出一个增强的变体,利用以图表为基础的内存表示来捕捉对话要素之间的复杂关系结构. 通过对LOCOMO基准的全面评价,我们系统地将我们的方法同六个基线类别进行比较:(一) 已建立的内存增强系统,(二) 大小和克值不一的检索增强生成(RAG),(三) 处理整个对话历史的全文方法,(四) 开源内存解决方案,(五) 专有模式系统,(六) 专用内存管理平台。 经验结果显示,我们的方法在四个问题类别中,即单跳、时跳、多跳和开放域,一直比所有现有的内存系统都好。 值得注意的是,Mem0比OpenAI的LLM-as-a-Judge度量衡实现26%的相对改进,而有图内存的Mem0的总分则比基础配置高了约2%. 除了准确性提高之外,我们还比全文方法显著地减少了计算间接费用。 特别是,Mem0的p95延迟率为91%,节省了90%以上的象征性费用,在先进的推理能力与实际部署限制之间提供了令人信服的平衡。 我们的调查结果强调了结构合理、持久的记忆机制对于长期对话一致性的关键作用,为更可靠和更有效的LLM驱动的AI代理铺平了道路。

items.detail: Recent progress in natural language processing has been driven by advances in both model architecture and model pretraining. Transformer architectures have facilitated building higher-capacity models and pretraining has made it possible to effectively utilize this capacity for a wide variety of tasks. Transformers is an open-source library with the goal of opening up these advances to the wider machine learning community. The library consists of carefully engineered state-of-the art Transformer architectures under a unified API. Backing this library is a curated collection of pretrained models made by and available for the community. Transformers is designed to be extensible by researchers, simple for practitioners, and fast and robust in industrial deployments. The library is available at https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.

items.detail: This report describes ARIS (Auto-Research-in-sleep), an open-source research harness for autonomous research, including its architecture, assurance mechanisms, and early deployment experience. The performance of agent systems built on LLMs depends on both the model weights and the harness around them, which governs what information to store, retrieve, and present to the model. For long-horizon research workflows, the central failure mode is not a visible breakdown but a plausible unsupported success: a long-running agent can produce claims whose evidential support is incomplete, misreported, or silently inherited from the executor's framing. Therefore, we present ARIS as a research harness that coordinates machine-learning research workflows through cross-model adversarial collaboration as a default configuration: an executor model drives forward progress while a reviewer from a different model family is recommended to critique intermediate artifacts and request revisions. ARIS has three architectural layers. The execution layer provides more than 65 reusable Markdown-defined skills, model integrations via MCP, a persistent research wiki for iterative reuse of prior findings, and deterministic figure generation. The orchestration layer coordinates five end-to-end workflows with adjustable effort settings and configurable routing to reviewer models. The assurance layer includes a three-stage process for checking whether experimental claims are supported by evidence: integrity verification, result-to-claim mapping, and claim auditing that cross-checks manuscript statements against the claim ledger and raw evidence, as well as a five-pass scientific-editing pipeline, mathematical-proof checks, and visual inspection of the rendered PDF. A prototype self-improvement loop records research traces and proposes harness improvements that are adopted only after reviewer approval.
items.title_zh: ARIS:通过横向多代理协作进行自主研究
items.detail_zh: 本报告介绍了ARIS(Auto-Research-in-Sleep),这是一种用于自主研究的开源研究工具,包括其结构,保证机制,以及早期部署的经验. 以LLMS为基础的代理系统的性能取决于模型重量及其周围的牵引力,这些牵引力支配着存储、检索和提交模型的信息。 对于长相研究工作流程,中央故障模式并不是一个明显的崩溃,而是一种可能得不到支持的成功:一个长期运行的代理可以提出其证据支持不完整,被误报,或者默默地从执行人的设定中继承的诉求. 因此,我们把ARIS作为一个研究工具,通过跨模型对抗性协作协调机器学习研究工作流程,作为一个默认的配置:一个执行器模型推动进步,而来自不同模型家族的审查员则被推荐批评中间文物并请求修改. ARIS有三个建筑层. 执行层提供了超过65个可再用Markdown定义的技能,通过MCP实现模型集成,一个用于反复再用先前发现的持久研究wiki,以及确定性的数字生成. 管弦乐层协调了5个端到端的工作流程,具有可调整的工作设置和可配置的路由到审查者模型. 保证层包括一个三阶段程序,用以检查实验性索赔是否得到证据的证实:完整性核实、结果对索赔的映射、对照索赔分类账和原始证据核对手稿报表的索赔审计,以及五通科学编辑管道、数学防伪检查和对已提供的PDF进行直观检查。 一个自改进回路原型记录了研究的痕迹并提出了取用改进方案,这些改进方案只有在审查者批准后才被采纳.

items.detail: Unified audio-video creation requires a single model capable of text-conditioned joint synthesis, bidirectional cross-modal generation, and instruction-guided editing across both modalities. Existing methods rely heavily on paired corpora, which are scarce for joint generation and even rarer for editing. Consequently, they are spent learning single-branch generative and editing capabilities that abundant unimodal data could readily teach, rather than on the cross-modal coupling. Furthermore, prevailing systems apply a single shared noise schedule to both modalities, neglecting two critical limitations. First, due to the significant discrepancy in information density, video requires prolonged high noise to organize spatial and motion structure, whereas the sparser audio signal can settle earlier during the synthesis process, the dynamics a uniform schedule might compromise. Second, lockstep denoising leaves asymmetric workflows, such as conditioning on one modality to synthesize or edit another, untrained. We present UniAVC, which addresses both obstacles. It first trains each branch on unimodal dataset to full generative and editing competence, and subsequently dedicates paired data to exploit cross-modal correspondence. Modality-decoupled schedulers meanwhile warp the noise schedule independently from a shared timestep, while subtasks with one clean modality directly supervise asymmetric configurations. These settings respectively enable intent-aware editing, which preserves one modality intact while enlisting it to constrain the other, and post-inference self-refinement, which regenerates only an unsatisfactory branch against an accepted one. UniAVC thus spans multiple creation tasks from a single set of weights without task-specific adapters.
items.title_zh: UniAVC:通过渐进式培训和不对称时间安排来统一制作音频视频
items.detail_zh: 统一的音频视频创建需要一个单一的模型,能够进行文本条件联合合成,双向交叉模式生成,以及两种模式的指令引导编辑. 现有方法严重地依赖成对的蝎子(corpora),它们很少用于联合生成,甚至更罕见的编辑. 因此,它们花费在学习单一分支的基因和编辑能力上,这些能力可以随时传授大量单模式数据,而不是用于交叉模式的组合。 此外,现行系统对两种方式都采用单一的共享噪音时间表,忽略了两个关键限制。 第一,由于信息密度相差很大,视频需要长时间高噪来组织空间和运动结构,而较少的音频信号可以在合成过程中更早地解决,而统一时间表的动态可能妥协. 其次,锁步去诺叶不对称的工作流程,如在一个模式上进行调节以合成或编辑另一个,未经训练. 我们介绍UniAVC,它处理两个障碍。 它首先对单式数据集的每个分支进行培训,使其具备充分的基因和编辑能力,随后将配对数据专门用于利用跨式通信。 模式解相的调度器同时将噪声表从一个共享的时序中独立旋转,而带有一个干净模式的子任务则直接监督不对称配置. 这些设置分别使意向意识编辑能够保持一种模式完好无损,同时争取它来约束另一种模式,而推论后自我修饰则只能使一个不满意的分支再生来对抗被接受的分支. 因此,UniAVC从一组没有任务特定适配器的单重中跨出多个创建任务.

items.detail: We introduce PaddleOCR-VL-1.6, an upgraded compact document parsing model built upon PaddleOCR-VL-1.5. Although PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 establishes a strong 0.9B baseline, its remaining errors concentrate in under-optimized regions where model behavior is unstable, data coverage is sparse, or supervision is unreliable. Rather than expanding the training corpus indiscriminately, PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 introduces a region-aware data optimization framework that identifies weak regions from the previous model, applies targeted enhancement to these regions, and improves the reliability of supervision signals. It further adopts a progressive post-training recipe based on curated data selection and reinforcement learning, pushing model performance to a higher level through staged optimization. PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 achieves a new state-of-the-art score of 96.33% on OmniDocBench v1.6, demonstrates strong competitiveness against top-tier VLMs, and provides a practical post-training recipe for the PaddleOCR-VL series.
items.title_zh: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6: 扩展文件解析范围与未优化区域 完善和进步后培训
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了PaddleOCR-VL-1.6,这是一个基于PaddleOCR-VL-1.5的升级的紧凑文件解析模型。 尽管PaddleOCR-VL-1.5建立了强大的0.9B基线,但其剩余错误集中在模型行为不稳定,数据覆盖度相去甚远,或者监管不可靠。 PaddleOCR-VL-1.6没有不加区别地扩大培训范围,而是引入了一个区域意识数据优化框架,从以前的模型中找出薄弱区域,对这些区域进行有针对性的强化,并改进监督信号的可靠性。 它进一步采用基于整理数据选择和强化学习的渐进式培训后方法,通过分阶段优化将模型性能推向更高水平。 PaddleOCR-VL-1.6在OmniDoc Bench v1.6上实现了96.33%的新一流分数,对顶级VLM表现出了强大的竞争力,并为PaddleOCR-VL系列提供了实用的培训后配方.

items.title: Raven: The Harness of Harnesses for Composable Agentic Intelligence

items.detail: As large language models advance, AI agents are moving beyond isolated, domain-specific tasks toward long-horizon, cross-domain workflows. This transition exposes two challenges: increasing harness complexity makes manual design difficult to scale, while tighter coupling to specific domains limits the generality of a single harness. The central question thus shifts from how to engineer a stronger harness for one domain to how to autonomously construct specialized harnesses, improve them through experience, and orchestrate them across domains. We introduce Raven, The Harness of Harnesses, an open-source multi-agent ecosystem that automatically constructs and evolves modular harnesses for specific models and domains, treating each executable model--harness pair as a composable unit of intelligence. To support an All-Domain Collaboration Network, its Host Agent decomposes goals, matches subtasks to specialized agents, coordinates execution dependencies, and integrates results, while a host archive and EverOS preserve experience across tasks and Skill Forge makes that experience available as reusable procedures. Our theory establishes sufficient conditions for such composition to expand reliable task coverage beyond that of the available individual agents under a shared resource budget. On complex and long-horizon tasks, Raven significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art agent systems, pushing the frontier of composable agentic intelligence.
items.title_zh: Raven:为可编译的代理智能而利用哈内斯
items.detail_zh: 随着大型语言模型的推进,AI代理正在超越孤立的,专有域的任务向长视,跨域工作流程发展. 这一过渡暴露出两个挑战:日益复杂的利用使得手动设计难以规模化,而与具体领域的更紧密的结合限制了单一利用的通俗性. 因此,中心问题从如何为某一领域设计出更强大的工具转向如何自主地建造专门工具,通过经验加以改进,并跨越不同领域加以协调。 我们引入了Raven, The Harnesses, 一个开源多剂生态系统,它自动构造和演化特定模型和域的模块化的取用,将每个可执行的模型-harness配对作为可调和的智能单元. 为了支持一个全域协作网络,其主机代理分解目标,将子任务匹配到专门代理,协调执行依赖,并整合结果,而主机档案和EverOS保存了跨任务的经验,而Skill Forge则将该经验作为可再使用的程序提供. 我们的理论为这种构成提供了充分的条件,以扩大可靠的任务范围,使其超出共享资源预算下现有个别代理人的任务范围。 在复杂而长的视野任务上,雷文显著地超越了最先进的特工系统,推进了可相容的特工智能的前沿.

items.detail: Memory-native evolution requires making memory an intrinsic capability of foundation models, enabling them to continuously accumulate and utilize information. To this end, we introduce MemT-1.0, a new architecture of memory foundation models that internalize memory as part of model computation. Building on Metis, MemT-1.0 employs Gated DeltaNet-2 with a stable token-level memory update mechanism within each turn. We further introduce Mixture-of-Storage to scale native memory capacity. Following a deliberate backbone preparation, we develop a two-stage training pipeline consisting of continued pre-training and post-training, supported by 34B tokens of training data and efficient training and inference infrastructure. We release a model family comprising MemT-1.0-Nano and MemT-1.0-Flash, and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of memory and general capabilities. The results show that they outperform the parametric memory baselines on average and remain competitive with retrieval-augmented methods, while largely preserving general capabilities. At a history length of 128K tokens, MemT-1.0-Nano achieves approximately 1.86times end-to-end inference speedup and a 66times reduction in persistent storage relative to full context KV cache. By internalizing retrieved procedural experience, MemT-1.0 improves task success on agentic tasks, providing a practical step toward memory-native evolution.
items.title_zh: MemT-1.0:走向记忆-内在演变
items.detail_zh: 内存-内在演化需要使内存成为基础模型的内在能力,使其能够不断积累和利用信息. 为此,我们引入了MemT-1.0,这是一种内存基础模型的新架构,将内存内部化,作为模型计算的一部分. 在Metis上,MemT-1.0使用Gated DeltaNet-2,在每个转弯内有一个稳定的符号级内存更新机制. 我们进一步引入了"Storage混合"(Mixture-of-Storage),以扩大本土记忆容量. 经过精心准备的骨干骨干后,我们开发了一个两阶段培训管道,包括持续的培训前培训和培训后培训,并辅之以34B个培训数据标志以及高效培训和推断基础设施。 我们释放了一个由MemT-1.0-Nano和MemT-1.0-Flash组成的模范家族,并对记忆力和一般能力进行全面的评价. 结果表明,它们的平均表现超过了参数内存基线,并且仍然具有检索强化方法的竞争力,同时在很大程度上保持了一般能力。 MemT-1.0-Nano在128K令牌的历史长度上,实现了约1.86次的终到终推速度,相对于全上下文KV缓存,持续存储量减少了66次. MemT-1.0通过将回收的程序经验内部化,改进了代理任务任务的成功,为内存-内在演化提供了一个实际步骤。

items.detail: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate videos chunk by chunk, yet producing plausible continuations does not guarantee that they capture how scenes evolve. Under teacher forcing, strong temporal redundancy may allow local visual continuity to serve as a shortcut for current-chunk denoising, reducing the pressure to model visual evolution. We introduce Future Chunk Prediction (FCP), an auxiliary objective jointly optimized with teacher-forced denoising that predicts temporally separated chunks without access to the intervening visual context. Drawing supervision directly from training videos, FCP requires no additional pretrained visual encoder and leaves autoregressive inference unchanged. Our method achieves superior physical plausibility over standard teacher-forced autoregressive training with a lower overall training compute budget, highlighting the effectiveness and efficiency of future-chunk supervision for modeling visual evolution. Intriguingly, our visualizations suggest that FCP fosters a more structured representation space, which may be valuable for building autoregressive world models.
items.title_zh: Looking Ahead: 自动视频生成中模拟未来进化
items.detail_zh: 自动回放的视频传播模型逐块生成视频,然而,产生可信的续作并不能保证它们能捕捉到场景的发展过程. 在教师的强迫下,强烈的时间冗余可能让局部视觉连续性成为当前-cunk去诺化的捷径,减少模拟视觉进化的压力. 我们提出未来春克预测(Future Chunk President (FCP)),这是一个辅助目标,与教师强迫去诺共同优化,它预言在时间上分离出块而无法进入干扰视觉环境. FCP直接从训练视频中绘制监督,不需要额外的事先训练的视觉编码器,而自动回转推论保持不变. 我们的方法实现了优于标准师资强制自发性培训的物理合理性,总体培训计算预算较低,凸显出未来全能监理视觉演化模型的效能和效率. 有趣的是,我们的可视化表明,FCP培育出一个更有条理的能代表空间,这对建立自相递进的世界模型可能很有价值.

items.detail: Game engines and coding agents can specify the layout, motion, and camera of a scene, yet turning such coarse structure into realistic video requires a renderer that follows the structure and completes the appearance it leaves open. Existing renderers are tied to the representation of one engine, need tens of denoising steps or a costly distillation of their own, and learn from conditions that are not aligned with their target videos. We present SolarRenderer, a structure-conditioned video renderer that adapts a frozen MiniMax-H3 33B backbone with two lightweight LoRAs. Structural videos enter the native reference pathway of the backbone at the positions of the frames they describe, without a type identifier and described only in plain text, so that a single control LoRA follows arbitrary structural representations. Starting from a pretrained four-step LoRA, structure-guided distribution matching renders in four steps, 12.3 times faster than 50-step sampling, while preserving the learned control. A block-causal variant extends the same design to streaming and renders 768p video in real time. To train the model, we build a frame-aligned corpus of 136K clips from game engines, simulators, and YouTube videos. Experiments on an in-distribution test set and a generalization benchmark of 16 structural representations show that SolarRenderer achieves state-of-the-art results across both, and generalizes to 11 unseen representations, including pose skeletons, drawings, and point clouds.
items.title_zh: 太阳能渲染器: 极少数阶梯式基因参考渲染
items.detail_zh: 游戏引擎和编码代理可以指定一个场景的布局,运动和相机,然而将这种粗糙的结构变成现实的视频需要一个遵循结构并完成它留下的外观的渲染器. 现有的渲染器与一个引擎的表示相挂钩,需要数十个去名步骤或自己的昂贵的蒸馏,并学习与其目标视频不相符合的条件. 我们介绍SolarRenderer,一个结构条件化的视频渲染器,可以改造一个被冷冻的MiniMax-H3 33B主干线,并配有两个轻量级的LORA. 结构视频在它们描述的框架位置输入主干线的原生参考路径,没有类型标识符,仅以纯文本来描述,这样单一的控制LORA就遵循了任意的结构表示. 从预先训练的四步LORA开始,结构制导的分布配对在四个步骤中,比50步的取样速度快12.3倍,同时保留所学的控制. 一个区块-causal变体将同一种设计延伸至流出并实时制作768p视频. 为了训练模型,我们从游戏引擎、模拟器和YouTube视频中构建了一套由136K个剪辑组成的帧组合。 对分布式测试集的实验和16个结构表示式的概括化基准显示,SolarRenderer在两个方面都取得了最先进的结果,并概括到11个看不见的表示式,包括姿势骨架,图画和点云.

items.detail: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a fundamental paradigm for expanding Large Language Models beyond their static training limitations. However, a critical misalignment exists between current RAG capabilities and real-world information environments. Modern knowledge repositories are inherently multimodal, containing rich combinations of textual content, visual elements, structured tables, and mathematical expressions. Yet existing RAG frameworks are limited to textual content, creating fundamental gaps when processing multimodal documents. We present RAG-Anything, a unified framework that enables comprehensive knowledge retrieval across all modalities. Our approach reconceptualizes multimodal content as interconnected knowledge entities rather than isolated data types. The framework introduces dual-graph construction to capture both cross-modal relationships and textual semantics within a unified representation. We develop cross-modal hybrid retrieval that combines structural knowledge navigation with semantic matching. This enables effective reasoning over heterogeneous content where relevant evidence spans multiple modalities. RAG-Anything demonstrates superior performance on challenging multimodal benchmarks, achieving significant improvements over state-of-the-art methods. Performance gains become particularly pronounced on long documents where traditional approaches fail. Our framework establishes a new paradigm for multimodal knowledge access, eliminating the architectural fragmentation that constrains current systems. Our framework is open-sourced at: https://github.com/HKUDS/RAG-Anything.
items.title_zh: RAG-任何东西:全能的RAG框架
items.detail_zh: 检索-增强型一代(RAG)已成为超越其静态训练限制扩展大语言模型的基本范例. 然而,目前的RAG能力和现实世界的信息环境之间存在严重的错位. 现代知识库本质上是多模式的,包含丰富的文字内容组合,视觉元素,结构化的表格和数学表达. 然而,现有的RAG框架仅限于文本内容,在处理多式文件时造成了根本的空白。 我们提出 " RAG-Anything " ,这是一个统一的框架,能够对所有模式进行全面的知识检索。 我们的方法将多式联运内容重新定义为相互关联的知识实体,而不是孤立的数据类型。 该框架引入了双图构建,在统一代表制内既抓住了跨模式关系,又抓住了文字语义. 我们开发了将结构知识导航与语义匹配相结合的跨模式混合检索. 在相关证据涉及多种模式的情况下,这样就能够对不同内容进行有效推理。 RAG-任何东西都显示出在挑战性多式联运基准方面的优异表现,比最先进的方法有了重大的改进。 在传统办法失败的长文件中,业绩收益特别明显。 我们的框架为获得多模式知识确立了新的范式,消除了制约现有系统的建筑分化。 我们的框架开放来源于:https://github.com/HKUDS/RAG-Anything。

items.detail: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. Such tasks demand grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements obtained through heterogeneous tools, whose outputs must be made interpretable to the model and retained across reasoning steps. We introduce OpenVLHarness, a multimodal reasoning harness organized around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory. The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering, providing consistent access to heterogeneous backends and converting their outputs into model-readable observations. Persistent multimodal memory retains the corresponding images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts throughout each query. A coding interface executes generated programs over stored data, enabling computations that combine results from multiple tools. Together, these mechanisms support an iterative process of acquiring, inspecting, and composing multimodal evidence. Evaluated on 22 benchmarks with eight open and proprietary backbones, OpenVLHarness improves average scores by 9.7-12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines, including +11.2 with Qwen3-VL-8B, +9.7 with Kimi K3, and +9.9 with GPT-6 Astra. With GPT-6 Luna at medium reasoning effort, OpenVLHarness outperforms the base model, Codex, and Visual Sketchpad at maximum effort by 7.7-8.5 points while incurring at most 37% of their model-token cost.
items.title_zh: OpenVL Harness: 真实世界视觉代理工具与多模式内存
items.detail_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)在视觉推理上取得了迅速的进展,然而许多任务需要的证据单靠内部推理是难以获得的:我们对22个基准的控制研究显示,仅仅增加基础模型的推论预算只能产生微小的收益. 这种任务需要有根据的认知、外部知识和通过各种工具获得的数字计量,其产出必须能够对模型作出解释,并保留各种推理步骤。 我们引进了OpenVLHarness,这是一个围绕能力层和持久的多模式记忆而组织的多模式推理工具。 能力层将任务级工具接口与证据渲染相结合,提供一致的获取多端后端的途径,并将其输出转化为可模型读取的观测. 持续的多模式内存保留了相应的图像,结构化数据和网络引用,作为每个查询的可地址文物. 一个编码接口在存储数据上执行生成的程序,使计算能够结合多个工具的结果. 这些机制共同支持获取、检查和整理多式联运证据的迭接进程。 对22个有8个开放和专有骨干的基准进行评估后,OpenVLHarness的平均分数比匹配的无工具基线提高9.7-12.6分,包括+11.2分与Qune3-VL-8B分,+9.7分与Kimi K3分,+9.9分与GPT-6 Astra分. 随着GPT-6 Luna在中度推理上的努力,OpenVLHarness以最大努力7.7-8.5分的功率超过了基准模型"Codex"和"Visual Sketchpad",同时以最多37%的模型脚本成本承担成本.

items.title: OpenGCUA: Toward a Fully Open Stack for Generalist Computer Use

items.detail: Computer use has reached a turning point: the focus is expanding from GUI-only interaction to systems that complete tasks on users' computers through visual and programmatic interfaces. We define a generalist computer-use agent (GCUA) as a system in which the model chooses how to observe, act, and organize its work across visual and programmatic interfaces. Yet frontier implementations, such as GPT-6 Astra's computer-use system, remain largely closed, limiting systematic study of their design. We introduce Open Generalist CUA (OpenGCUA), an ongoing project to develop and open the full stack for GCUAs with the community. This report presents the first release of OpenGCUA. Code execution is a key feature of our agent design: it lets intermediate results determine subsequent operations and enables models to apply their existing programming capabilities directly to computer interaction. We also propose harness-to-model decision transfer, moving selected observations and task-state decisions from fixed harness rules to the model. On OSWorld-v2, our full configuration improves task scores across all eight evaluated models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5, raising mean partial score by +19.6 points and reducing reported steps per task by an average of 53.0% relative to batched GUI-only execution. We release our implementation and prompts, evaluation trajectories from all eight models, and preliminary versions of a real-device harness and a cross-device SDK. The harness addresses real-device challenges not fully captured by benchmarks, while the SDK provides a common programming interface across computers, mobiles and browsers. Across four real macOS tasks under our real-device harness, selected Qwen3.8-Max runs use 19.4 times as many reported reasoning tokens as GPT-6 Astra, highlighting substantial differences between models in real-device execution efficiency.
items.title_zh: OpenGCUA: 迈向一个供通用计算机使用的完全开放堆栈
items.detail_zh: 计算机的使用已经到了一个转折点:焦点正在从只使用图形界面的交互扩展到通过视觉和程序接口完成用户计算机任务的系统. 我们把通用计算机使用剂(GCUA)定义为一种系统,模型在其中选择如何在视觉与程序界面上观察,行动,和组织其工作. 然而,前沿实施,例如GPT-6 Astra的计算机使用系统,基本上仍然关闭,限制了对其设计的系统研究。 我们提出开放通用的CUA(OpenGCUA),这是一个进行中的项目,旨在开发并开放面向社区的全球CUA的全堆. 这份报告介绍了OpenGCUA的首次发行. 代码执行是我们代理设计的一个关键特征:它让中间结果决定后续的操作,并让模型直接将其现有的编程能力应用于计算机交互. 我们还建议从利用到模式的决策转移,将选定的观察和任务状态的决定从固定利用规则转移到模式。 在OSWorld-v2上,我们的全面配置提高了包括GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5在内的所有8个评价模型的任务分数,将平均分数提高为+19.6分,并将每个任务的报告步骤比批量的GUI只执行平均减少53.0%. 我们发布了我们的执行和提示, 评估轨迹 从所有8个模型, 和初步版本的 真实的装置和交叉的装置SDK。 该套接力解决了基准没有完全捕捉到的真设备挑战,而SDK则提供了一个跨计算机,移动和浏览器的共同编程接口. 通过我们真实设备的4个真正的macOS任务,所选择的Quen3.8-Max运行使用比GPT-6 Astra报告的推理符数多出19.4倍,凸显出在真实设备执行效率方面模型的巨大差异.

items.detail: This paper studies category-level RGB-D object pose estimation, which recovers an object's 3D rotation and translation without instance-specific CAD models or reference views. This task is highly ambiguous due to intra-class variations, symmetries, and partial observations. Current solutions struggle to balance reliability and efficiency: methods based on intermediate structures are prone to error propagation, while diffusion models suffer from high inference latency and complex post-hoc candidate extraction. To address this, we present F2G-Pose, a real-time direct, single-pass framework that predicts category-level pose, metric size, and camera-frame completed shape from a single RGB-D observation in one feed-forward pass. F2G-Pose lifts dense visual foundation features to partial point clouds, encodes local geometry with DGCNN tokenization, and integrates object-level structure with a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer. Joint size prediction and camera-frame shape completion encourage metric consistency through dense geometric supervision. With its task-specific network trained only on pose-annotated synthetic SOPE data and its frozen RADIO backbone externally pretrained, F2G-Pose achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on SOPE and ROPE while running at 28 FPS for pose-only inference, and further demonstrates strong camera-frame geometry on HouseCat6D and real-object transfer on HANDAL. Analyses of latency, robustness, shape completion, and GenPose++ candidate behavior further demonstrate the efficiency and reliability of F2G-Pose, with real-world manipulation experiments demonstrating deployment potential under segmented RGB-D inputs. The project page, code, and pretrained models are made available at https://jrryzh.github.io/F2G-Pose/.
items.title_zh: F2G- Pose: 几何- 智能基金会 地物提升 用于直接 RGB- D 类- 级对象 Pose 估计
items.detail_zh: 本文研究了类级RGB-D对象的平面估计,该估计可以恢复对象的3D旋转和翻译,而无需实例特定的CAD模型或参考视图. 由于阶级内部的变异,对称,以及部分观察,这项任务非常模糊. 目前的解决办法难以平衡可靠性和效率:基于中间结构的方法容易出现错误传播,而传播模型则有高推论延迟和复杂的后热候选物提取。 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了F2G-Pose,即一个实时的直通单通框架,从一个向后传的单一RGB-D观测中预测出类别级的姿势,度量大小和相机帧完成的形状. F2G-Pose将稠密的视觉地基特征提升到部分点云上,用 DGCNN 符号化编码了局部几何,并整合了具有多功能变形器的物体级结构. 联合大小预测和相机-帧外形的完成通过密集的几何监督,鼓励了计量的一致性. F2G-Pose在任务特有网络只接受姿势附加说明的合成SOPE数据培训,其冷冻的RADIO主干线在外部经过预先培训后,在SOPE和ROPE上实现了最先进的精度,同时在28 FPS上运行,仅作姿势推断,并进一步展示了HouseCat6D上的强相机帧几何和HANDAL上的实际对象转移. 对耐久性,稳健性,形状完成性,和GenPose++候选行为的分析进一步证明了F2G-Pose的效率和可靠性,现实世界的操纵实验在分块的RGB-D输入下证明了部署潜力. 项目网页、代码和预先培训过的模型可在https://jryzh.github.io/F2G-Pose/上查阅。

items.title: PDFMathTranslate: Scientific Document Translation Preserving Layouts
items.subtitle: Language barriers in scientific documents hinder the diffusion and development of science and technologies. However, prior efforts in translating such documents largely overlooked the information in layouts. To bridge the gap, we introduce PDFMathTranslate, the world's first open-source software for translating scientific documents while preserving layouts. Leveraging the most recent advances in large language models and precise layout detection, we contribute to the community with key improvements in precision, flexibility, and efficiency. The work has been open-sourced at https://github.com/byaidu/pdfmathtranslate with more than 222k downloads.

items.detail: We introduce SANA-Video, a small diffusion model that can efficiently generate videos up to 720x1280 resolution and minute-length duration. SANA-Video synthesizes high-resolution, high-quality and long videos with strong text-video alignment at a remarkably fast speed, deployable on RTX 5090 GPU. Two core designs ensure our efficient, effective and long video generation: (1) Linear DiT: We leverage linear attention as the core operation, which is more efficient than vanilla attention given the large number of tokens processed in video generation. (2) Constant-Memory KV cache for Block Linear Attention: we design block-wise autoregressive approach for long video generation by employing a constant-memory state, derived from the cumulative properties of linear attention. This KV cache provides the Linear DiT with global context at a fixed memory cost, eliminating the need for a traditional KV cache and enabling efficient, minute-long video generation. In addition, we explore effective data filters and model training strategies, narrowing the training cost to 12 days on 64 H100 GPUs, which is only 1% of the cost of MovieGen. Given its low cost, SANA-Video achieves competitive performance compared to modern state-of-the-art small diffusion models (e.g., Wan 2.1-1.3B and SkyReel-V2-1.3B) while being 16x faster in measured latency. Moreover, SANA-Video can be deployed on RTX 5090 GPUs with NVFP4 precision, accelerating the inference speed of generating a 5-second 720p video from 71s to 29s (2.4x speedup). In summary, SANA-Video enables low-cost, high-quality video generation.

items.detail_zh: 我们引入了SANA-Video,一种能有效生成可达720x1280分辨率和分钟长度的视频的小型传播模型. SANA-Video合成了高分辨率,高品质和长相的视频,其文本-视频对接速度非常快,可被部署在RTX 5090 GPU上. 两个核心设计确保了我们的高效,高效和长的视频生成:(1) Linear DiT:我们利用线性关注作为核心操作,由于视频生成中处理的大量代币,这比香草关注更有效. (2) Content-Memory KV缓存 对于 Block Linear 注意:我们通过使用从线性注意的累积属性推导的常态,为长视频生成设计出以块为方向的自递回方式. KV缓存以固定内存成本为全局提供Linear DiT,消除了传统KV缓存的需求并使得视频生成效率高,分秒. 此外,我们还探索了有效的数据过滤和模式培训策略,将64个H100GPU的培训费用缩小为12天,这只占"电影源"费用的1%. 由于成本低廉,SANA-Video与现代最先进的小型扩散模型(如Wan 2.1-1.3B和SkyReel-V2-1.3B)相比,实现了有竞争力的性能,同时在测得的耐用性上快了16x. 此外,SANA-Video可以以NVFP4精度被部署在RTX 5090GPU上,加速了从71s到29s(2.4x快取)生成5秒720p视频的推论速度. 简而言之,SANA-Video实现了低成本,高质量的视频生成.

items.detail: LLM agents are increasingly expected not only to complete isolated tasks, but also to carry bounded representations of human expertise, judgment, and interaction style. Building such person-grounded agents remains difficult because actionable knowledge associated with a person or role is usually embedded in heterogeneous traces rather than written as clean instructions. Existing memory and persona systems capture fragments of this evidence, while skill frameworks provide portable packaging formats; however, there is no end-to-end workflow for distilling these traces into inspectable, correctable, and agent-usable skills. We present an automated trace-to-skill distillation system for generating person-grounded AI skills via expert knowledge distillation. Given materials from a target person or role, COLLEAGUE.SKILL produces a versioned skill package with two coordinated tracks: a capability track for practices, mental models, and decision heuristics, and a bounded behavior track for communication style, interaction rules, and correction history. The package can be inspected, invoked, updated through natural-language feedback, rolled back, installed across agent hosts, and optionally prepared for controlled distribution. We describe the artifact contract, generation workflow, correction lifecycle, deployment surface, and domain presets implemented in the open-source system. At the time of writing, the public repository has approximately 18.5k GitHub stars; the gallery lists 215 skills from 165 contributors and more than 100k cumulative stars across listed skill cards. The system illustrates how person-grounded skills can be represented as portable, correctable packages rather than opaque prompts or hidden memories.
items.title_zh: COLLEAGUE.SKILLL:通过专家知识分解实现自动AI技能生成
items.detail_zh: 人们越来越期望LLM代理人不仅完成孤立的任务,而且还要承担人的专门知识、判断和互动风格的有限表述。 建立这种以人为根据的代理人仍然很困难,因为与一个人或角色有关的可操作的知识通常被嵌入到各种各样的痕迹中,而不是写成干净的指示. 现有的内存和人格系统能够捕捉这些证据的碎片,而技能框架则提供便携式包装格式;然而,没有从端到端的工作流程将这些痕迹分馏成可检查、可纠正和可用剂的技能。 我们提出一个自动追踪技能分馏系统,通过专家知识分馏生成个人的人工智能技能。 根据来自目标人或角色的材料,COLLEAGUE.SKILL制作了一个版本的技能包,有两个协调的音轨:一个用于练习的能力音轨,精神模型,以及决策heuristics;一个用于交流风格,互动规则,以及校正历史的有界限的行为音轨. 包可以检查,引用,通过自然语言反馈来更新,回滚,跨代理主机安装,并可选择为可控发行做准备. 我们描述了在开源系统中实施的文物合同、生成工作流程、修正生命周期、部署表面和域名预设。 在编写本报告时,公共寄存器大约有18.5k GitHub星;画廊列出了165名贡献者的215个技能,以及超过100克的累计恒星横跨上市技能卡. 该系统说明个人定位技能如何能被表现为可移植,可纠正的包,而不是不透明的提示或隐藏的记忆.

items.title: Has GPT-6-Astra Achieved Embodied Intelligence?
items.subtitle: GPT-6-Astra demonstrates a level of competence in robotic manipulation and navigation that challenges the conventional paradigm of building specialized models for individual tasks and embodiments. In this report, we ask not only how capable GPT-6-Astra is, but what its capabilities imply for the field. First, we probe the limits of standalone GPT-6-Astra. We conduct a large-scale evaluation across 12 representative benchmarks spanning tabletop manipulation, humanoids, mobile platforms, and dexterous hands. items.detail: GPT-6-Astra demonstrates a level of competence in robotic manipulation and navigation that challenges the conventional paradigm of building specialized models for individual tasks and embodiments. In this report, we ask not only how capable GPT-6-Astra is, but what its capabilities imply for the field. First, we probe the limits of standalone GPT-6-Astra. We conduct a large-scale evaluation across 12 representative benchmarks spanning tabletop manipulation, humanoids, mobile platforms, and dexterous hands. Under a unified protocol that allows in-context learning (ICL) from training-set demonstrations and substantially increases the number of execution steps, GPT-6-Astra achieves unprecedented performance (Fig. 1). Future research may focus on improving 1) the generality of ICL 2) cost and execution time, 3) physical-state verification, 4) recovery from irreversible failures, and 5) long-horizon preservation of progress. Second, we study the agentic harness for embodied control. We identify that close-loop coordination between a high-level "System 2" reasoner (i.e., GPT-6-Astra) and a low-level "System 1" controller (e.g., π0.5) is costly but effective. Third, we examine GPT-6-Astra on real-world deployment. Our experiments on 8 robot configurations reveal substantial gaps: 1) robot demonstrations required for ICL are expensive to collect, and 2) it is implausible to trade longer execution for higher success rates with physical constraints. Fourth, we envision the next generation of embodied benchmarks. We develop a prototype that 1) derives tasks from real-world needs, 2) provides no in-domain demonstrations, and 3) judges agents on a world clock that keeps running while they deliberate. Taken together, our results suggest that GPT-6-Astra has largely crossed the threshold of embodied competence, but not yet that of practical embodied intelligence.
items.title_zh: GPT-6-Astra是否实现了健全的情报工作?
items.detail_zh: GPT-6-Astra在机器人操纵和导航方面表现出一定的能力,对为个别任务和表现建立专门模式的传统模式提出了挑战。 在本报告中,我们不仅询问GPT-6-Astra的能力如何,而且询问它的能力对该领域意味着什么。 首先,我们探索独立的GPT-6-Astra的极限. 我们对12项代表性基准进行大规模评估,这些基准涉及桌面操纵、人造物、移动平台和狡猾的手。 根据统一协议,允许从培训设置的演示中学习内容,并大大增加执行步骤的数量,GPT-6-Astra取得了前所未有的成绩(图1)。 未来的研究可能侧重于改善1)ICL(2)的成本和执行时间的普遍性,3)物理状态核查,4)从不可逆转的故障中恢复,5)长期保持进展。 第二,我们研究 内含控制的力量。 我们确认,一个高级"System 2"(即GPT-6-Astra)和低级"System 1"控制器(即"0.5")之间的近距离协调成本高而有效. 第三,我们审查GPT-6-Astra的实际情况。 我们关于8个机器人配置的实验揭示出巨大的差距:1)ICL所需的机器人演示费很昂贵的收集,2)在物理限制下以较长的执行时间换取更高的成功率是不可信的. 第四,我们设想下一代包含的基准。 我们开发了一个原型,即:(1) 任务来自现实世界的需要;(2) 不提供内部示范;(3) 法官在不断运转的世界时钟上进行审理。 总而言之,我们的结果表明,GPT-6-Astra已基本跨越了已体现的能力界限,但尚未超越实际体现的智力界限。

items.detail: Long-horizon agents compact their history to continue within a finite context window, but a textual summary alone may not support every subsequent decision. We introduce REMORY, a neural memory network that supplements the summary with a bounded sequence of soft memory tokens. Given the history and summary, the network learns to generate tokens that help a frozen LLM approximate the continuation it would produce with the full history. The tokens are conditioned on the summary and appended after it, forming an analogue of a residual connection along the sequence dimension. On SummHay, REMORY improves source attribution at nearly unchanged insight coverage and approaches the full-context joint score using only 5.2% of the input positions. Across long-horizon agent benchmarks, Qwen3.8-27B and GLM-5.3-Flash show consistent gains with residual memory. Both models also exhibit substantially fewer repeated tool outputs and tool errors on BrowseComp and Terminal-Bench 2.1.

items.detail: This paper presents the design, implementation, and evaluation of the PyTorch distributed data parallel module. PyTorch is a widely-adopted scientific computing package used in deep learning research and applications. Recent advances in deep learning argue for the value of large datasets and large models, which necessitates the ability to scale out model training to more computational resources. Data parallelism has emerged as a popular solution for distributed training thanks to its straightforward principle and broad applicability. In general, the technique of distributed data parallelism replicates the model on every computational resource to generate gradients independently and then communicates those gradients at each iteration to keep model replicas consistent. Despite the conceptual simplicity of the technique, the subtle dependencies between computation and communication make it non-trivial to optimize the distributed training efficiency. As of v1.5, PyTorch natively provides several techniques to accelerate distributed data parallel, including bucketing gradients, overlapping computation with communication, and skipping gradient synchronization. Evaluations show that, when configured appropriately, the PyTorch distributed data parallel module attains near-linear scalability using 256 GPUs.
items.title_zh: PyTorch 分布:加速数据并行培训的经验
items.detail_zh: 本文件介绍了PyTorch分布式数据平行模块的设计、实施和评价。 PyTorch是一个被广泛采纳的科学计算包,用于深层学习研究和应用. 近期在深入学习方面的进展论证了大型数据集和大型模型的价值,这就要求有能力将模型培训扩大到更多的计算资源。 由于数据平行原则的直截了当和广泛适用性,数据平行主义已成为分发培训的受欢迎的解决办法。 一般来说,分布式数据平行主义的技术复制了每个计算资源上的模式来独立生成梯度,然后在每个迭代上传达出这些梯度来保持模型复制的一致性. 尽管技术在概念上很简洁,但计算和通信之间的微妙依赖性使得优化分布式培训效率成为非三角性. 截至v1.5,PyTorch本土提供了几种技术来加速分布式数据平行,包括桶式梯度,与通信相重叠的计算,并跳过梯度同步. 评价显示,PyTorch分布式数据平行模块在适当配置时,使用256GPU实现近线性可扩展性.

items.detail: Single image 3D generation aims to dress a given 3D mesh with relightable materials while faithfully preserving the visual details of a reference image. Existing methods either introduce artifacts when fusing inconsistent multi-view predictions or struggle to preserve fine details through implicit image-feature conditioning. To resolve these challenges, we introduce SUPRA-Tex, built on the principle of decoupling visible-material estimation, surface alignment, and observation-guided 3D completion. This division of labor allows the 3D generator, trained on limited 3D data, to focus its capacity on preserving visible evidence and completing unobserved surfaces. Specifically, we first train an MLLM-based image editing model to predict lighting-separated PBR maps in the reference view. We then project these maps onto the visible surface and encode them with the pretrained material VAE encoder into native observation latents that share the generation target's latent space. An interleaved flow transformer holds these latents as fixed, read-only anchors while alternating unobserved-region and full-surface updates to generate complete material latents. This design achieves super-alignment with the reference, delivering What You See Is What You Get fidelity on visible regions and coherent completion on unobserved surfaces. Trained solely on public datasets, SUPRA-Tex achieves SOTA performance in both geometry-conditioned texturing and end-to-end asset generation, matching or even exceeding leading commercial systems on in-the-wild images. Project page: https://supra-3d.github.io/supratex/
