items.detail_zh: 单一图像 3D 生成旨在为给定的 3D 网目穿戴可发光的材料,同时忠实地保存参考图像的视觉细节. 现有方法要么在调和不一致的多视图预测时引入了文物,要么通过隐含的图像地貌条件努力保存精细细节. 为了应对这些挑战,我们采用了SUPRA-Tex,它建立在可视材料估算、地表对接和观察制导3D完成脱钩的原则上。 这种分工使得经过有限三维数据培训的三维生成器能够将能力集中于保存可见证据并完成无法观察的表面. 具体来说,我们首先培训一个基于MLLM的图像编辑模型,在参考视图中预测被照明分隔的PBR地图. 然后把这些地图投放到可见的地表 并用经过预先训练的材料 VAE编码器 编码成本地观测潜质 共享生成目标的潜在空间 一个相接的流变器将这些潜伏物作为固定的,只读的锚地,同时交替进行未观测的区域和全地表更新以产生完整的物质潜伏物. 这个设计实现了与参考物的超对接,在可见区域上传递出"你所看到的"(What You See Is What What You Get)"忠贞"(We's Toientity),在未观测到的地表上连贯地完成. SUPRA-Tex只接受公共数据集的培训,在几何条件的纹理和端到端的资产生成方面都实现了SOTA的性能,比对甚至超过了最领先的商业系统在闪烁的图像上. 项目网页:https://supra-3d.github.io/supratex/

items.detail: We introduce Zep, a novel memory layer service for AI agents that outperforms the current state-of-the-art system, MemGPT, in the Deep Memory Retrieval (DMR) benchmark. Additionally, Zep excels in more comprehensive and challenging evaluations than DMR that better reflect real-world enterprise use cases. While existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks for large language model (LLM)-based agents are limited to static document retrieval, enterprise applications demand dynamic knowledge integration from diverse sources including ongoing conversations and business data. Zep addresses this fundamental limitation through its core component Graphiti -- a temporally-aware knowledge graph engine that dynamically synthesizes both unstructured conversational data and structured business data while maintaining historical relationships. In the DMR benchmark, which the MemGPT team established as their primary evaluation metric, Zep demonstrates superior performance (94.8% vs 93.4%). Beyond DMR, Zep's capabilities are further validated through the more challenging LongMemEval benchmark, which better reflects enterprise use cases through complex temporal reasoning tasks. In this evaluation, Zep achieves substantial results with accuracy improvements of up to 18.5% while simultaneously reducing response latency by 90% compared to baseline implementations. These results are particularly pronounced in enterprise-critical tasks such as cross-session information synthesis and long-term context maintenance, demonstrating Zep's effectiveness for deployment in real-world applications.
items.title_zh: Zep: 代理内存的时空知识图形架构
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了Zep,一种为AI代理提供的新颖的记忆层服务,在"深记忆检索"(DMR)基准中超越了目前最先进的系统MemGPT. 此外,Zep在比DMR更全面和更具挑战性的评价方面表现优于更好地反映现实世界企业使用案例的评价. 虽然基于大语言模型(LLM)的代理机的现有检索增强生成(RAG)框架仅限于静态文件检索,但企业应用程序需要来自不同来源的动态知识集成,包括持续的对话和商业数据. Zep通过它的核心组件Graphiti来解决这一根本的局限性——一种时间意识的知识图引擎,在保持历史关系的同时,动态地合成了无结构的对话数据和有结构的商业数据. 在作为主要评价衡量标准而成立的DMR基准中,Zep显示业绩优异(94.8%对93.4%)。 除了DMR之外,Zep的能力通过更具挑战性的LongMemEval基准得到进一步验证,通过复杂的时间推理任务更好地反映企业使用案例. 在本次评价中,泽普取得了实质性成果,精度提高可达18.5%,同时与基线实施相比,将反应延迟率降低90%. 这些成果在跨会间信息综合和长期上下文维护等企业关键任务中尤为突出,显示出泽普在现实世界应用中的部署效果.

items.detail: Recent focus in agentic reinforcement learning (RL) seeks to improve credit assignment in long-horizon tasks. One promising direction combines reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), integrating trajectory-level advantages with dense token-level supervision. This line of work often conditions a teacher model on privileged context, such as agentic skills, to score tokens generated by the student policy. Despite their progress, they largely overlook the on-policy evolution of agentic skills and the reliability of teacher supervision. Towards this end, we introduce Recursive Self-Improving Policy Optimization (RSIPO), a self-evolving agentic RL framework that enables agentic skills and the policy model to co-evolve throughout the training process. Specifically, RSIPO enables the policy itself to extract skills from completed trajectories and explicitly optimizes its skill-generation capability through trajectory replay. It further employs empirical Bayes shrinkage to dynamically calibrate the student's trust in teacher scores, accounting for the fact that skill-enhanced teacher guidance can sometimes be less reliable. Experiments with Qwen-family models on embodied interaction and search-based agentic tasks demonstrate that RSIPO outperforms all the compared baseline approaches. With Qwen2.5-7B as the base model, RSIPO achieves an average success rate of 98.6\% on ALFWorld, yielding absolute improvements of 2.5\% and 17.4\% over the second-best baseline and standard GRPO, respectively.
items.title_zh: RSIPO:通过技能政策共同进取,递增自我改进政策优化代理强化学习
items.detail_zh: 最近对代理强化学习(RL)的侧重,旨在改进长期任务中的信贷分配。 一个有希望的方向是将强化学习与可核查的奖励(RLVR)和政策上的自我消化(OPSD)结合起来,将轨迹层面的优势与密集的象征层面的监督结合起来。 这种工作方式往往将教师模式作为特殊背景的条件,如代理技能,以给学生政策产生的标志记分。 尽管取得了进展,但它们在很大程度上忽略了代理技能的政策演变和教师监督的可靠性。 为此,我们引入了递增自我改进政策优化(RSIPO),这是一种自我演变的代理RL框架,使代理技能和政策模式能够在整个培训过程中共同发展。 具体而言,RSIPO使政策本身能够从已完成的轨迹中提取出技能,并通过轨迹回放明确优化其技能生成能力. 它进一步利用经验性的拜耳斯收缩来动态地校正学生对教师分数的信任,说明技能增强的教师指导有时可能不太可靠. 利用关于内在互动和基于搜索的代理任务的 " Quen-family " 模型进行的实验表明,RSIPO的绩效超过了所有比较基准方法。 以Quen2.5-7B为基准模式,RSIPO在ALFWorld上取得98.6XX的平均成功率,与第二好的基准和标准的GRPO相比,其绝对改进率分别为2.5X和17.4X.

items.detail: Recent advances in automatic rigging now deliver animation-ready 3D assets at scale, yet generating the motion to drive them remains a bottleneck. Existing learned animators are topology-constrained: they rely on category-specific templates or require per-skeleton fine-tuning and reference motions at inference. We present UniMate, a unified foundation model that synthesizes articulated motion for arbitrary skeletons from a rigged 3D asset and a text prompt, with no test-time optimization or per-skeleton retraining. UniMate introduces a topology-aware diffusion transformer, which integrates skeletal topology into attention via three mechanisms: (1) a graph-aware attention bias from pairwise joint relations and geodesic distances; (2) a spectral rotary position embedding generalizing RoPE to arbitrary kinematic trees via the graph Laplacian; and (3) a global topological conditioner attention-pooled from the rest-pose skeleton. We also curate UniML3D, 13,006 motion sequences spanning bipedal, quadrupedal, avian, marine, insectoid, serpentine, and articulated rigid objects with unified canonicalization and text pairing. Trained on this dataset, UniMate outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in quality, generalization, and efficiency, and supports zero-shot cross-topology transfer, in-betweening, expansion, and text-guided editing. Our project page is available at https://linzhanmou.com/unimate/.

items.detail_zh: 近期在自动操纵方面的进步现在可以大规模地提供动画准备的3D资产,但驱动这些资产的运动仍然是一个瓶颈。 已学习到的动画师在地形学上是受制约的:他们依赖特定类别的模板,或者需要每斯凯莱通的微调和推论的参考运动. 我们提出UniMate,一个统一的基础模型,它从一个被操纵的3D资产和文本提示中合成任意骨架的清晰运动,没有测试时间优化或每斯凯莱通再培训。 UniMate引入了地貌意识扩散变压器,通过三种机制将骨骼地貌融合到注意力中:(1)从对接关系和大地测量距离中产生图感注意力偏差;(2)通过图拉普拉西安嵌入RoPE通向任意动能树的光谱回转位置;和(3)从休眠骨架中汇集出全球地貌条件注意器. 我们还管理UniML3D、13 006个运动序列,这些序列跨越双管、四管、禽类、海洋、昆虫、蛇纹等,并具有统一划线和文本对等的清晰的刚性物体。 受此数据集培训,UniMate在质量,通俗化,效率方面超越了最先进的基线,支持零镜头跨地形传输,介于间隙,扩展,以及文本引导编辑. 我们的项目网页见https://linzhanmou.com/unimate/。

items.detail: Fine-grained visual understanding requires distinguishing subtle differences in local attributes and spatial relations, yet remains challenging for existing vision-language models. Unified multimodal models (UMMs) offer a new opportunity through generation pathways that preserve rich visual information complementary to understanding. However, existing generation-assisted understanding methods mainly rely on generative supervision or explicit generation and have not systematically explored direct use of native generation-side representations. To address this gap, we systematically analyze what generation-side representations offer for fine-grained understanding, finding that they are more sensitive to fine-grained semantic changes, capture task-relevant changes missed by understanding-side representations, and depend on correct spatial organization for this advantage. Guided by these findings, we design GAFU, a post-training framework that unlocks native generation-side information for fine-grained understanding. It compresses generation-side visual representations into compact \(G\) tokens that preserve fine-grained visual details, enabling task-conditioned retrieval by the understanding pathway. Experiments show that GAFU consistently outperforms SFT baselines trained on the same data across diverse visual understanding tasks and UMM architectures, with maximum relative improvements of 20.00\%, 17.94\%, and 8.62\% on VStar-Bench, OmniSpatial, and VSR-Bench, respectively. Overall, GAFU converts complementary information from the generation pathway into gains in fine-grained visual understanding, providing an effective path toward synergy between generation and understanding in UMMs.
items.title_zh: 一代人知道什么:在统一多式联运模式中解锁精细理解
items.detail_zh: 精细的视觉理解要求区分出当地属性和空间关系的细微差异,但对现有视觉语言模型来说仍然是挑战. 统一的多模式模式提供了新的机会,通过生成途径保存丰富的视觉信息来补充理解。 然而,现有的世代辅助理解方法主要依靠基因监督或显性生成,没有系统地探索直接使用本地世代侧代表. 为了弥补这一差距,我们系统地分析代际表述为精细理解提供了什么,发现它们对于精细描述的语义变化更加敏感,捕捉到理解侧表述所错过的与任务相关的变化,并依赖正确的空间组织来获得这一优势. 以这些结论为指导,我们设计了GAFU,一个培训后框架,解开本地的一代方信息,以便精细地理解. 它将生成侧视觉表现压缩为收缩的\(G\)符号来保存精细的视觉细节,从而能够通过理解路径进行基于任务条件的检索. 实验显示,GAFU在各种视觉理解任务和UMM架构中始终超越了基于相同数据培训的SFT基线,在VStar-Bench,OmniSpatial和VSR-Bench上,其最大相对改进分别为20.00\%,17.94\%和8.62\%. 总体而言,GAFU将来自生成途径的补充信息转化为精细视觉理解的增益,为生成和理解UMM提供了一条有效的途径.

items.detail: Recent advancements in 3D generative modeling have significantly improved the generation realism, yet the field is still hampered by existing representations, which struggle to capture assets with complex topologies and detailed appearance. This paper present an approach for learning a structured latent representation from native 3D data to address this challenge. At its core is a new sparse voxel structure called O-Voxel, an omni-voxel representation that encodes both geometry and appearance. O-Voxel can robustly model arbitrary topology, including open, non-manifold, and fully-enclosed surfaces, while capturing comprehensive surface attributes beyond texture color, such as physically-based rendering parameters. Based on O-Voxel, we design a Sparse Compression VAE which provides a high spatial compression rate and a compact latent space. We train large-scale flow-matching models comprising 4B parameters for 3D generation using diverse public 3D asset datasets. Despite their scale, inference remains highly efficient. Meanwhile, the geometry and material quality of our generated assets far exceed those of existing models. We believe our approach offers a significant advancement in 3D generative modeling.
items.title_zh: 3D 世代的原生和契约结构
items.detail_zh: 最近在3D基因模型化方面的进步大大地改进了生成现实主义,然而这个领域仍然被现有的表达所阻碍,这些表达方式难以用复杂的地貌和详细的外观来捕捉资产. 本文件介绍了从本地立体数据中学习结构性潜在代表性以应对这一挑战的方法。 其核心是一个被称作"O-Voxel"(O-Voxel)的新稀疏的活体结构,一种将几何和外观都编码的omni-voxel代表. O-Voxel可以强力地模拟任意地貌,包括开放地貌,非狂形地貌,并完全封闭地表,同时捕捉出超出纹理颜色的全面地表属性,如物理渲染参数. 基于O-Voxel,我们设计了 Sparse Compression VAE,提供高空间压缩率和紧凑的潜入空间. 我们利用不同的公共三维资产数据集,为三维生成培训由4B参数组成的大规模流配模型。 尽管其规模很大,但推断仍然非常有效。 同时,我们创造的资产的几何和物质质量远远超过了现有模型。 我们认为,我们的方法在3D基因模型方面取得重大进展。

items.detail: The fast growth of open-source AI infrastructure, from model serving engines and agent platforms to the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem and the language models themselves, has outpaced the security tooling available to defend it. We present AI-Infra-Guard, an open-source framework that organizes AI red teaming around a single observation: the attack surface of an AI agent is stratified across layers (infrastructure, protocol/tool, agent behavior, and model), and no single detection paradigm fits all of them. The framework therefore matches a paradigm to each layer, from deterministic rule matching over 75+ AI components and 1{,}400+ vulnerability rules, through LLM-driven agentic auditing of MCP servers and agent-skill packages and multi-turn black-box agent red teaming, to a jailbreak harness with 26+ attack operators over sixteen datasets. To our knowledge it is the only open-source framework to span all of these, including supply-chain auditing of the agent skills that increasingly extend AI agents. We release AI-Infra-Guard as open source so that layer-paradigm matching can serve as a practical foundation for agent security and a shared base for the community to build on.
items.title_zh: 保障人工智能代理:多层代理红色团队统一框架
items.detail_zh: 开源AI基础设施的快速发展,从模型服务引擎和代理平台到模型背景协议(MCP)生态系统和语言模型本身,都超过了可用来防御它的安全工具. 我们提出AI-Infra-Guard(AI-Infra-Guard),这是一个开源框架,它组织AI红色团队围绕一个单一的观察:AI剂的攻击表面被分层分层分层分层(基础设施,协议/工具,代理行为,以及模型),没有单一的检测范式适合所有这些. 因此,框架将规范与每一层相匹配,从确定规则比75+ AI组件和 1{,}400+ 脆弱性规则,通过由LLM驱动的代理审计MCP服务器和代理技能包以及多回合黑盒代理红色组合,到有26+攻击操作员超过16个数据集的越狱控制所. 据我们所知,这是涵盖所有这些的唯一开放源码框架,包括对代理技能进行供应链审计,使AI代理越来越多。 我们释放AI-Infra-Guard作为开源,这样地层-paradigm匹配就可以作为代理安全的实际基础,成为社区立足的共同基础.

items.detail: Real-time vision demands models that are accurate, efficient, and simple to deploy across diverse hardware. The YOLO family has become widely deployed for this reason, yet most YOLO detectors still rely on non-maximum suppression at inference, carry heavy detection heads due to Distribution Focal Loss, require long training schedules, and can leave the smallest objects without positive label assignments. We present Ultralytics YOLO26, a unified real-time vision model family that addresses these limitations through coordinated architecture and training advances. YOLO26 uses a dual-head design for native NMS-free end-to-end inference and removes DFL entirely, yielding a lighter head with unconstrained regression range. Its training pipeline combines MuSGD, a hybrid Muon-SGD optimizer adapted from large language model training; Progressive Loss, which shifts supervision toward the inference-time head; and STAL, a label assignment strategy that guarantees positive coverage for small objects. Beyond detection, YOLO26 introduces task-specific head and loss designs for instance segmentation, pose estimation, and oriented detection, producing consistent gains across tasks and scales. The family spans five scales (n/s/m/l/x) and supports detection, instance segmentation, pose estimation, classification, and oriented detection in a single pipeline, with an open-vocabulary extension, YOLOE-26, for text-, visual-, and prompt-free inference. Across all scales, YOLO26 achieves 40.9-57.5 mAP on COCO at 1.7-11.8 ms T4 TensorRT latency, advancing the accuracy-latency Pareto front over prior real-time detectors, while YOLOE-26x reaches 40.6 AP on LVIS minival under text prompting. Code and models are available at https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics.
items.title_zh: 超解YOLO26:统一实时端到端视觉模型
items.detail_zh: 实时视觉需要准确,高效,简便的模型,可以跨出各种硬件. YOLO家族因此被广泛部署,然而大多数YOLO探测器仍然依靠非最大压制推想,由于分布焦距损失而携带重探测头,需要较长的训练时间表,并且可以让最小的物体没有正面的标签任务. 我们介绍Ultralytics YOLO26,这是一个统一的实时视野模型家庭,通过协调的建筑和培训进步来克服这些局限性. YOLO26为原生的NMS无端到端推论使用双头设计并完全去除DFL,产生一个没有受限制的回归范围的更轻头. 其培训管道结合了MuSGD这一混合型Muon-SGD优化器,根据大型语言模式培训进行改造; 进步损失,将监督转向推论时间头; STAL,一种标签分配策略,保证了对小物体的积极覆盖。 除了检测外,YOLO26还引入了针对特定任务的头和损失设计,例如分解,提出估计,并定向检测,在任务和尺度之间产生一致的收益. 家族跨出5个尺度(n/s/m/l/x),并支持检测,实例分解,在单一的管道中提出估计,分类,并定向检测,并带有开放式的vocabulary扩展,YOLOE-26,用于文本,可视和即时的无线推断. 在所有尺度上,YOLO26在COCO上以1.7-11.8 ms T4 TensorRT 耐用度达到40.9-57.5 mAP,在前作实时探测器上推进了精度相近的Pareto前置,而YOLOE-26x在文字提示下在LVIS小val上达到40.6 AP. 守则和模型见https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics.

items.detail: Harness self-evolution revises an agent's software scaffolding, including prompts, memory, workflows, and executable components, while keeping model weights fixed. We formalize a feedback-driven process in which accepted revisions persist across runs. The framework separates update targets from proposal and admission mechanisms. It distinguishes changes to interpreted state from revisions to tools and code, repository-level control logic, and plugin composition. We characterize search through evolutionary optimization and examine its reliability through continual PAC-learning. Under explicit assumptions, the analysis yields an expected generalization bound, a retention bound conditional on historical regression budgets, and a high-probability admission rule using fresh, independent validation data. We examine how persistent harness revisions affect knowledge sharing and organizational workflows, with implications for scientific reliability, physical safety, and institutional accountability. Cases from prior work illustrate model--harness co-design, distributed execution, and plugin reuse. Reliable deployment requires continual validation as task distributions and evaluators change, with independent safeguards for learning, runtime privileges, and consequential actions. We provide a comprehensive 66-page discussion of related work, theory, algorithms, evaluation, applications, and the broader impact of Harness RSI, together with continuously updated code and supplementary materials, at https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI.
items.title_zh: 自我演进的特工
items.detail_zh: Harness自演化修改了代理的软件脚手架,包括提示,内存,工作流程,以及可执行组件,同时保持模型权重固定. 我们正式确定一个反馈驱动的进程,在这一进程中,接受的修订始终存在。 该框架将更新目标与建议和接纳机制分开。 它区分了对解释状态的修改和对工具和代码的修订,寄存器级控制逻辑,以及插件构成. 我们通过进化优化来描述搜索的特点,并通过持续的PAC学习来检查其可靠性. 在明确的假设下,分析产生一个预期的概括约束,一个以历史回归预算为条件的保留约束,以及一个利用新的,独立的验证数据的高概率录取规则. 我们审查持续利用的修订如何影响知识共享和组织工作流程,对科学可靠性、人身安全和机构问责制产生影响。 先前工作的案例说明了模型-harness协同设计、分布式执行和插件再利用。 可靠的部署需要随着任务分配和评价人员的改变而不断加以验证,同时对学习、运行时间特权和相应的行动提供独立的保障。 我们在https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI网站上,全面讨论了66页的有关工作、理论、算法、评价、应用以及Harness RSI的更广泛影响。

items.detail: How can we build an agent that thinks beyond human language, yet still acts through it in the external environment? Modern LLM agents still reason and interact through text, while latent reasoning offers an efficient internal medium but lacks native tool access and reasoning transparency. We bridge these two directions with Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents), which dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction throughout a unified generation process. Architecturally, a lightweight HybridLink enables seamless transitions between text and latent modes, while the agent's continuous working memory preserves lossless hybrid context across multiple turns. These designs preserve tool-integrated agentic capabilities while making latent thoughts directly inspectable. Building on this architecture, we further develop dedicated post-training algorithms for hybrid reasoning: HybridSFT stabilizes tool-integrated hybrid generation by teaching the backbone to coordinate with HybridLink, then HybridRL scales reasoning by learning when to think in latent space and when to act through text. We evaluate HybridAgent at 3 model scales across 11 benchmarks covering mathematics, science, medicine, search, and agentic reasoning. Compared with frontier LLM Agents and agentic frameworks spanning both text-based and latent methods, HybridAgent consistently improves performance by 10.4%, while delivering 35.5%-54.7% token reduction, 1.8x-2.6x faster inference, and 2.7x-3.7x cost savings. Code and data are available at https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent.
items.title_zh: 混合理由代理人
items.detail_zh: 我们怎样才能建立一种超越人类语言而仍然在外部环境中通过它行事的代理人呢? 现代LLM代理商仍然通过文本进行理性和互动,而潜在的推理则提供了高效的内部介质,但缺乏本土工具访问和推理透明度. 我们用混合理性代理(HybridAgents)来连接这两个方向,后者在整个统一的生成过程中动态地引导潜在的推理和基于文本的互动. 在结构上,一个轻量级的HybridLink可以在文本和潜伏模式之间实现无缝的过渡,而代理的连续工作内存则保留了跨多转弯的无损失混合上下文. 这些设计保留了工具集成剂能力,同时使潜想可以直接检查。 在这个架构的基础上,我们进一步发展了用于混合推理的专用的训练后算法:HybridSFT通过教授骨干来协调HybridLink,然后HybridRL通过学习何时在潜入空间中思考以及何时通过文本采取行动来稳定工具-集成混合生成. 我们以3个模型尺度评价混合体,涉及数学、科学、医学、搜索和代理推理等11个基准。 与涵盖文字和潜在方法的前沿LLM代理和代理框架相比,混合代理公司不断提高性能10.4%,同时实现35.5%-54.7%的象征性减排,1.8x-2.6x更快的推论,以及2.7x-3.7x成本节约。 代码和数据见https://github.com/couplecomputer/HybridAgent。

items.detail: Visual backbones have evolved from Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with local aggregation to Vision Transformers (ViTs) with global interactions, State-Space Models (SSMs) with input-dependent state transitions, and Test-Time Training (TTT) layers that adapt an inner learner while processing an image. Across this progression, visual computation has become increasingly adaptive to each input, yet the rules governing that adaptation remain largely prescribed by the trained backbone. We introduce VisionHOPE, the first generic visual backbone formulated as a self-modifying learning system, in which what the model remembers and how it learns co-evolve within an image. Building on the self-referential construction of Nested Learning (NL), VisionHOPE realizes this co-evolution through five coupled memories that store content, generate key and value representations, and govern learning rate and retention. These memories evolve jointly as visual context accumulates along each scan. However, directly applying the unconstrained self-referential update to a visual backbone leads to instability. We therefore derive a stability-matched step-size control scheme that combines a soft cap on self-referential injection with a spectral clamp on the retained memory transition, and prove that the resulting memory dynamics are non-expansive along each scan. For two-dimensional feature maps, we adapt NL's chunk formulation by aligning chunks with image rows and columns across four directional scans. The proposed VisionHOPE achieves competitive results on ImageNet-1K, COCO, and ADE20K, establishing self-modifying learning systems as a practical foundation for general-purpose visual backbones. The code is available at https://github.com/PSRben/VisionHOPE.
items.title_zh: VisionHOPE:视觉后骨作为自修学习系统
items.detail_zh: 视觉主干网从Convolutional Neural Networks(CNNs)演变而来,局部集成到具有全球互动的Vision Transformers(ViTs),具有投入依赖状态过渡的State-Space Models(SSM)和在处理一个图像的同时适应一个内在学习者的TTT(TTT)层. 在整个进展过程中,视觉计算越来越适应于每项投入,然而关于适应的规则基本上仍然由受过培训的骨干部门规定。 我们引入了VisionHOPE,这是第一个作为自我改造的学习系统而形成的通用视觉骨干,在这个系统中,模型记忆了什么,它是如何在一个图像中共同学习的. 在Nested Learning(NL)的自我特惠构建的基础上,VisionHOPE通过存储内容,生成关键和价值表述,规范学习率和保留率的五种并存记忆,实现了这一共同演变. 这些记忆随着视觉上下文在每次扫描过程中的积累而共同演化. 然而,将不受约束的自我优惠更新直接应用到视觉主干上会导致不稳定. 因此,我们得出了稳定相匹配的相继尺寸控制方案,将自特惠注射的软盖与保留内存过渡的光谱夹结合起来,并证明所产生的内存动力学在每次扫描过程中都是非扩展性的. 对于二维特征图,我们调整了NL的块式配方,通过四个方向扫描将块与图像行和列对齐. 拟议的VisionHOPE在ImageNet-1K,COCO,ADE20K上实现了竞争结果,建立了自修的学习系统,为通用视觉骨干奠定了实用的基础. 该代码可在https://github.com/PSRben/VisionHOPE查询.

items.detail: Decision models support routing, guardrails, and output verification in LLM systems. However, item accuracy alone cannot establish whether models make correct decisions across controlled variations or assign reliable confidence to their predictions. We introduce DecisionPivot, a diagnostic benchmark comprising 48 tasks and 40,033 items across seven decision roles. Its core track contains 7,800 items from 13 generated task families, organized into contrast groups with computed answers verified by independently implemented solvers. The complementary reference track contains 32,233 items from 35 public test sets, preserving their original evaluation metrics. We evaluate 40 decision models and 14 general models using documented, model-specific protocols, assessing item and contrast-group accuracy, probability ordering, calibration, and empirical selective coverage. Our results reveal substantial differences obscured by aggregate scores: two 27B models separated by only 2.6 points on the reference track achieve contrast-group accuracies of 70.1% and 44.2%. Across 2,400 binary contrast pairs, Perplexity Decider correctly ranks the positive member above the negative member in 92.3% of pairs but answers both members correctly in only 74.1%, exposing a gap between probability ordering and decision correctness. Models with similar item accuracy also differ in the reliability of their high-confidence predictions. On a separate 1,296-item subset, GLM-5.3 achieves 93.5\% contrast-group accuracy at a higher reasoning setting, compared with 81.5% at its lowest effort. By linking errors to pivotal details and difficulty levels, DecisionPivot provides fine-grained diagnostics of decision failures that aggregate evaluation alone cannot reveal.
items.title_zh: 决定要点:LLM系统决策模式诊断基准
items.detail_zh: 决策模型支持LLM系统中的路由,护栏,和输出验证. 然而,光是项目准确性无法确定模型是针对受控变异作出正确的决定,还是给预测带来可靠的信心。 我们提出决策支柱,这是一个诊断基准,包括48个任务和40 033个项目,涉及7个决策角色。 其核心轨道包含来自13个生成任务组的7 800个项目,它们被组织成对照组,由独立执行的解答者核实计算答案。 补充参考轨道包含35个公共测试组的32 233个项目,保留了原有的评价指标。 我们利用有文件记载的、针对具体模式的规程,评估40个决策模型和14个一般模型,评估项目和对照组的准确性、概率顺序、校准以及经验性选择性覆盖。 我们的结果显示了被总分所掩盖的巨大差异:两个27B模型在参考轨道上只相隔了2.6分,实现了70.1%和44.2%的对比组速率. 在2400个二进制对比对中, Percomplexity Conservation将正成员排在负成员后方的92.3%对正成员进行正确排序,但两个成员只正确回答74.1%,暴露出概率顺序与决定正确性之间的差距. 具有类似项目精度的模型,其高自信预测的可靠性也有所不同. 在一个单独的1,296项子集上,GLM-5.3在更高的推理设置中实现了93.5QX对比组的精确度,而其最低努力率为81.5%. 通过将出错与关键细节和难度水平联系起来,DecisionPivot对决策失误提供了精细的诊断,仅综合评价无法揭示.

items.detail: Language models are sequential processors, but long-horizon agency requires external information and computation beyond model weights and active context. Prime Agent is an open-source harness for long-horizon evaluation and coding-agent workflows. A persistent IPython REPL follows the Recursive Language Model abstraction for programmatic context processing and test-time compute, while Continual Harness preserves histories, memories, skills, prompts, and subagent specifications across trajectories. Recursive subagents coordinate through direct agent-to-agent communication, and the Agents View lets humans inspect and manage daemon-backed sessions. Prime Agent standardizes execution, recovery, verification, and resource accounting while leaving strategy construction to the model. This low-friction, expressive membrane prevents harness failures from becoming model failures and pushes measurement toward the model's true maximal underlying capability. Prime Agent raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 from 30% to 95.5% and matches or exceeds native and popular harnesses across long-context coding, GPU-kernel generation, emulator construction, and autonomous nanoGPT speedruns. On Factorio, we find refinement allows for continuous technology progression and dedicated subagents enable parallelized work. Code is available at https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.
items.title_zh: 主干员:自我改进的 RLM 技巧
items.detail_zh: 语言模型是相继的处理器,但长视机构需要外部信息并进行超出模型权重和活性上下文的计算. Prime Agent是用于长视评价和编码代理工作流程的开源控制器. 持续的IPython REPL遵循了Recursive Language Model的抽象,用于程序上下文处理和测试时间计算,而Continual Harness则保存了历史,记忆,技能,提示,和跨道的子剂规格. 递归子剂通过直接代理对代理通信来协调,代理视图让人类检查和管理守护进程支持的会话. 主干员将执行、恢复、核查和资源核算标准化,同时将战略构建留给模型。 这种低温的显性薄膜防止了操纵故障成为模型故障,并将测量推向模型真正的最大基础能力. Prime Agent将ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1从30%提升到95.5%,并在长文本编码、GPU-内核生成、模拟器构建和自主纳米GPT快跑中匹配或超过本地和受欢迎的牵引。 在Instemio上,我们发现改进可以使技术不断进步,专用的子剂可以使工作并行。 代码见https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.

Prime Agent将ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1从30%提升到95.5%,并在长文本编码、GPU-内核生成、模拟器构建和自主纳米GPT快跑中匹配或超过本地和受欢迎的牵引。 在Instemio上,我们发现改进可以使技术不断进步,专用的子剂可以使工作并行。 代码见https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.

items.detail: Full-duplex spoken dialogue systems significantly advance over traditional turn-based dialogue systems, as they allow simultaneous bidirectional communication, closely mirroring human-human interactions. However, achieving low latency and natural interactions in full-duplex dialogue systems remains a significant challenge, especially considering human conversation dynamics such as interruptions, backchannels, and overlapping speech. In this paper, we introduce a novel End-to-End GPT-based model OmniFlatten for full-duplex conversation, capable of effectively modeling the complex behaviors inherent to natural conversations with low latency. To achieve full-duplex communication capabilities, we propose a multi-stage post-training scheme that progressively adapts a text-based large language model (LLM) backbone into a speech-text dialogue LLM, capable of generating text and speech in real time, without modifying the architecture of the backbone LLM. The training process comprises three stages: modality alignment, half-duplex dialogue learning, and full-duplex dialogue learning. Throughout all training stages, we standardize the data using a flattening operation, which allows us to unify the training methods and the model architecture across different modalities and tasks. Our approach offers a straightforward modeling technique and a promising research direction for developing efficient and natural end-to-end full-duplex spoken dialogue systems. Audio samples of dialogues generated by OmniFlatten can be found at this web site (https://omniflatten.github.io/).
items.title_zh: OmniFlatten:无缝语音交谈的一端到端的GPT模型
items.detail_zh: 完全繁复的口语对话系统大大超越了传统的回合式对话系统,因为它们可以同时进行双向交流,密切地反映人与人之间的互动。 然而,在完全复杂的对话系统中实现低延迟和自然互动仍然是一个重大挑战,特别是考虑到人的对话动态,如中断、后通道和重叠的言论。 在本文中,我们引入了以"端到端"(End-to-End GPT)为基础的小说"OmniFlatten"(OmniFlatten)模式,用于全复式对话,能够以低潜性有效模拟自然对话所固有的复杂行为. 为了实现全复式的交流能力,我们提出一个多阶段后培训计划,将基于文本的大型语言模型(LLM)主干逐步改编为语音-文本对话LLM,能够实时生成文本和语音,而不修改主干LLM的结构. 培训进程包括三个阶段:模式调整、半复式对话学习和全复式对话学习。 在所有培训阶段,我们都采用平整操作使数据标准化,使我们能够统一不同模式和任务的训练方法和模式架构。 我们的方法为发展高效的、自然的、端到端的完全复杂的口语对话系统提供了直接的建模技术和有希望的研究方向。 OmniFlatten产生的对话的音频样本可在该网站(https://omniflatten.github.io/)查阅。

items.detail: Vision-language models (VLMs) pretrained on large-scale multimodal datasets encode rich visual and linguistic knowledge, making them a strong foundation for robotics. Rather than training robotic policies from scratch, recent approaches adapt VLMs into vision-language-action (VLA) models that enable natural language-driven perception and control. However, existing VLAs are typically massive--often with billions of parameters--leading to high training costs and limited real-world deployability. Moreover, they rely on academic and industrial datasets, overlooking the growing availability of community-collected data from affordable robotic platforms. In this work, we present SmolVLA, a small, efficient, and community-driven VLA that drastically reduces both training and inference costs, while retaining competitive performance. SmolVLA is designed to be trained on a single GPU and deployed on consumer-grade GPUs or even CPUs. To further improve responsiveness, we introduce an asynchronous inference stack decoupling perception and action prediction from action execution, allowing higher control rates with chunked action generation. Despite its compact size, SmolVLA achieves performance comparable to VLAs that are 10x larger. We evaluate SmolVLA on a range of both simulated as well as real-world robotic benchmarks and release all code, pretrained models, and training data.
items.title_zh: SmolVLA:经济适用和高效机器人的愿景-语言-行动模型
items.detail_zh: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)在大规模多模式数据集上预训,编码了丰富的视觉和语言知识,使其成为机器人的坚实基础. 近期的做法不是从零开始对机器人政策进行培训,而是将VLMs改造成视觉语言-动作(VLA)模式,使自然语言驱动的认知和控制成为可能. 然而,现有的志愿军通常规模很大,往往有数十亿个参数,导致培训费用高和现实世界的可部署性有限。 此外,它们依赖学术和工业数据集,忽略了社区从负担得起的机器人平台收集的越来越多的数据。 在这项工作中,我们介绍了SmolVLA,这是一个小型、高效和社区驱动的VLA,它大大减少了培训和推论费用,同时保留了竞争性业绩。 SmolVLA被设计在单一GPU上进行训练,并被部署在消费级GPU甚至CPU上. 为了进一步提高反应能力,我们引入了一个同步推论堆栈,将感知和动作预测与动作执行脱钩,从而可以以块状动作生成来提高控制率. 尽管SmolVLA的尺寸很紧凑,但它的性能与10x更大的VLA相当. 我们用一系列模拟和现实世界的机器人基准来评估SmolVLA, 并发布所有代码,预先训练的模型和培训数据。

items.detail: In this report, we present the Qwen3-TTS series, a family of advanced multilingual, controllable, robust, and streaming text-to-speech models. Qwen3-TTS supports state-of-the-art 3-second voice cloning and description-based control, allowing both the creation of entirely novel voices and fine-grained manipulation over the output speech. Trained on over 5 million hours of speech data spanning 10 languages, Qwen3-TTS adopts a dual-track LM architecture for real-time synthesis, coupled with two speech tokenizers: 1) Qwen-TTS-Tokenizer-25Hz is a single-codebook codec emphasizing semantic content, which offers seamlessly integration with Qwen-Audio and enables streaming waveform reconstruction via a block-wise DiT. 2) Qwen-TTS-Tokenizer-12Hz achieves extreme bitrate reduction and ultra-low-latency streaming, enabling immediate first-packet emission (97,ms) through its 12.5 Hz, 16-layer multi-codebook design and a lightweight causal ConvNet. Extensive experiments indicate state-of-the-art performance across diverse objective and subjective benchmark (e.g., TTS multilingual test set, InstructTTSEval, and our long speech test set). To facilitate community research and development, we release both tokenizers and models under the Apache 2.0 license.

items.detail: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled them to act as autonomous agents, creating and editing 3D models via code or direct software manipulation. In practical workflows, these models must infer object shapes, materials, spatial layouts, and lighting from diverse references while strictly following instructions to reconstruct, modify, or design 3D content. However, existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of such open-ended requests across real-world scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce BlenderWorld, the first comprehensive benchmark dedicated to evaluating frontier models on realistic 3D creation tasks. BlenderWorld comprises 223 tasks spanning architecture, products, natural environments, and scientific visualization, driven by text, image, video, and structured specification inputs. To rigorously assess these complex deliverables, we establish a unified evaluation protocol: we render the submitted Blender projects from multiple viewpoints and evaluate them against 2,651 task-specific binary rubrics alongside holistic visual quality scores. Benchmarking thirteen frontier models reveals that GPT-6-Astra achieves the highest overall fused score of 79.9, followed by Opus-5 (73.0) and GPT-5.6-Sol (67.7). Ultimately, our findings reveal a critical bottleneck: while current models can parse broad instructions, they still profoundly struggle with fine-grained 3D spatial coherence and accurate structural reproduction in Blender, leaving substantial headroom for future 3D-native agentics.
items.title_zh: BlenderWorld:根据真实世界参考资料为3D创建设定基准的视觉代理
items.detail_zh: 最近在多式大语言模型(MLLMs)上的进步使得它们能够发挥自主代理作用,通过代码或直接软件操纵来创建并编辑3D模型. 在实际工作流程中,这些模型必须从各种参考文献中推断出物体形状,材料,空间布局和照明,同时严格遵循指令来重建,修改或设计3D内容. 然而,现有基准在现实世界的各种设想中对这种无限期请求的涵盖范围有限。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了BlenderWorld,这是第一个专门用于评估现实的三维创建任务的前沿模型的全面基准. BlenderWorld包含223项任务,涉及建筑、产品、自然环境和科学可视化,由文字、图像、视频和结构化规格投入所驱动。 为了严格评估这些复杂的可交付成果,我们建立了一个统一的评价协议:我们从多个角度对提交的Blender项目进行评估,并根据2 651个任务特定二进制和整体视觉质量分数进行评估。 13个前沿模型的基准显示,GPT-6-Astra实现了79.9的总的引信分数最高,其次是Opus-5(73.0)和GPT-5.6-Sol(67.7)。 最终,我们的调查结果揭示了一个关键的瓶颈:虽然目前的模型可以解析广泛的指示,但它们仍然与精细的3D空间一致性和Blender的精确结构再生有着深刻的挣扎,为未来的3D-内在活性剂留下了巨大的头室.

items.detail: Frontier open-weight models are increasingly available, but serving them still largely assumes datacenter infrastructure. We present FreeToken, an edge-native MoE serving system that treats a personal machine not as a small GPU, but as a unified, elastic inference platform. FreeToken co-designs the full serving stack, including model layout and loading, expert residency, CPU--GPU execution, agentic state reuse, and runtime memory management, around two realities of local AI: agent workloads continuously change their execution pattern, and edge hardware exposes heterogeneous resources whose balance differs from machine to machine. Rather than committing to a fixed offloading strategy, FreeToken continuously maps computation and model state onto the resources actually available. FreeToken supports more than 20 MoE models and real coding and tool-using agents across hardware ranging from an 8GB laptop GPU to a single workstation GPU. More importantly, it changes what these machines can practically serve, from a 35B model on a laptop to a 284B model on a gaming desktop and the 753B GLM-5.2 on a single workstation GPU. FreeToken turns open weights into deployable local software, making the machines users already own a practical platform for frontier-scale intelligence. We release the system at flashml.ai.
items.detail_zh: 边境开放重量模型越来越多,但为这些模型服务在很大程度上仍假定数据中心基础设施。 我们介绍FreeToken,一种边缘内置的MOE服务系统,它将个人机器不作为小型的GPU,而是作为一个统一的弹性推论平台. FreeToken共同设计了完整的服务堆栈,包括模型布局和加载,专家居住,CPU-GPU执行,代理状态再用,以及运行时间内存管理,围绕本地AI的两个现实:代理工作量持续地改变其执行模式,边缘硬件暴露出各种资源,其平衡因机器而异. FreeToken没有致力于固定的卸载战略,而是不断将计算和模型状态映射到实际可用的资源上。 FreeToken支持超过20个MOE模型以及从8GB笔记本电脑GPU到单一工作站GPU等硬件之间的真实编码和工具使用代理. 更重要的是,它改变了这些机器可以实际服务的东西,从笔记本电脑上的35B型到游戏桌面上的284B型,以及单个工作站GPU上的753B GLM-5.2. FreeToken将开放的权重转化为可部署的本地软件,使机器用户已经拥有了一个实用的前沿规模智能平台. 我们在闪出系统

items.detail: Multimodal code intelligence connects the symbolic world of programs with the visual world their execution creates. Interest in this capability is burgeoning, as models are increasingly asked to produce charts, webpages, animations, and semi-structured documents. Recently, proprietary models have pushed far ahead, producing interactive artifacts even from a text description or a screenshot alone. Yet their data and training remain closed, and open progress is held back by the quantity and quality of available data and by the pipelines and methods for producing it. Quality is the harder of the two, since a sample must be correct as a program, well built, and above all visually right once rendered. No existing signal covers all three. Execution often returns just a pass or fail, code similarity does not map to the visual output, and task-specific verifiers do not generalize. To push open progress further, we start from the data side with PrismaForge, a hierarchical data pipeline centered on a synthesized rubric that decomposes these factors into checkable criteria. The same rubric serves as both filter and reward: it curates the supervised corpus, then drives reinforcement learning on visual-coding tasks. Leveraging PrismaForge for data synthesis and filtering, we build PrismaCoder-2M, the most diverse open dataset for multimodal code intelligence and the largest to date. On the model side, we train PrismaCoder-9B and PrismaCoder-35B on this data and release both. They lead the open state of the art by a wide margin and rival leading proprietary systems. Our analyses further show that the proposed rubric-based pipeline improves multimodal coding performance across model backbones. We release our code and data at https://qiushisun.github.io/PrismaCoder-Home/.
items.title_zh: PrismaCoder:通过分解的Rubric合成推进开放式多式代码智能的边界
items.detail_zh: 多式联运代码智能将程序符号世界与被执行的视觉世界相接. 对这种能力的兴趣正在增长,因为越来越多的模型被要求制作图表、网页、动画和半结构文件。 最近,专有模式推进了一大步,甚至从文字描述或截图中产生了交互式文物。 然而,他们的数据和培训仍然关闭,现有数据的数量和质量以及生产数据的管道和方法阻碍了开放进展。 质量是两者中最难的,因为一个样本必须作为一个程序正确,构建良好,最重要的是,在渲染出来后,视觉右侧。 没有现有的信号覆盖全部三个. 执行往往只返回一个通过或失败,代码相似性不映射到可视输出,而任务特定核查者不概括. 为了进一步推进开放进展,我们从数据侧面开始与PrismaForge,一个层次数据管道,其中心是一个将这些因素分解为可核查标准的综合标题. 同一个标题既可以过滤,又可以奖励:它可以校正被监管的指令,然后推动在视觉编码任务方面的强化学习。 利用PrismaForge进行数据合成和过滤,我们建造了PrismaCoder-2M,这是用于多模式代码智能的最多样化开放数据集,也是迄今为止最大的数据集. 在模型方面,我们将Prisma Coder-9B和Prisma Coder-35B在此数据上进行训练并发布两者. 它们以广阔的优势领导开放的艺术状态,并竞争领先的专有系统. 我们的分析还表明,拟议的基于标题的管道可改进示范骨干之间的多式联运编码工作。 我们在https://qiushisun.github.io/PrismaCoder-Home/发布我们的代码和数据。

items.title: Any Time, Any Space: A World-State-Centric Framework for Agentic Video Generation
items.subtitle: Long-form agentic video generation must turn a screenplay into shots that remain spatially and temporally consistent across nonconsecutive requests. Passing prompts or recent frames between shots does not provide a shared spatial frame for revisiting a scene or a time-indexed record for replaying an earlier event. We present Any Time, Any Space (ATAS), which compiles a screenplay into shot requests with explicit location, camera, and event-time references. Before generation, it retrieves relevant evidence from a scene memory of registered static geometry and an event memory of dynamic observations indexed by scene, event, and time. After generation, ATAS reconstructs and registers the clip.
items.detail: Long-form agentic video generation must turn a screenplay into shots that remain spatially and temporally consistent across nonconsecutive requests. Passing prompts or recent frames between shots does not provide a shared spatial frame for revisiting a scene or a time-indexed record for replaying an earlier event. We present Any Time, Any Space (ATAS), which compiles a screenplay into shot requests with explicit location, camera, and event-time references. Before generation, it retrieves relevant evidence from a scene memory of registered static geometry and an event memory of dynamic observations indexed by scene, event, and time. After generation, ATAS reconstructs and registers the clip. It updates memory only when review and state checks accept the observation, while film delivery remains independent of memory admission. Across four video generators, ATAS improves all reported cross-shot consistency measures and achieves the highest aggregate benchmark score for each backbone. It also outperforms the compared agents and 3D-guided methods on target-image spatial revisit, leads three event-recapture criteria, and receives the highest human ratings on all six criteria. The video results and code are available on our project page: https://lhmd.top/atas/.
items.title_zh: 任何时间,任何空间:代理视频生成的世界-国家-儿童框架
items.detail_zh: 长式代理视频生成必须把剧本变成在空间和时间上在非连续请求之间始终一致的镜头. 镜头之间的传递提示或最近的帧并不能为重访一幕提供共享空间框架,也不能为重播更早的事件提供有时间索引的记录. 我们提出任何时间,任何空间(ATAS),它将一个剧本编译成带有明确位置、相机和事件时间参考的拍摄请求。 在生成前,它从已注册的静态几何的场景内存取出相关证据,并取出按场景,事件,时间索引的动态观测事件记忆. 一代后,ATAS重建并注册了剪辑. 它只有在审查及状态检查接受观察时才会更新内存,而电影的交付仍然独立于内存的收录. 在四台视频发电机中,ATAS改进了所有报告的交叉射击一致性措施,并实现了每个主干单位最高的总基准分. 它还在目标-图像空间重访上超越了比较的代理和3D制导方法,领先了三个事件-回收标准,并在所有6个标准上获得人类最高的评分. 视频结果和代码见我们的项目网页:https://lhmd.top/atas/。

items.detail: Advances in frontier coding agents have sharply increased the token costs of AI-assisted software engineering. Their token efficiency is typically evaluated on isolated tasks, whereas real-world developers use them to continuously build, update, and maintain large-scale projects. This mismatch motivates us to evaluate agents over sequences of realistic coding tasks, where we find that agents exhibit recurring environment-dependent token costs that existing methods struggle to reduce. To minimize these costs, we introduce TokenEconomizer, an external controller that cuts environment-specific token costs over a sequence of tasks. These cuts come from determining (i) which operational micro-skills to inject, (ii) which persistently irrelevant tools to prune, and (iii) when to intervene in unproductive failure loops. Across Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot CLI paired with frontier models, TokenEconomizer reduces the average token cost by 18.4-30.9% with comparable task success. Savings hold in every repository under every tested agent-model setting and generalize to diverse domains such as sequential web development and security auditing, where costs fall by 6.4-21.2% depending on task structure. Our work establishes adaptive black-box cost control as a promising direction for reducing token costs of coding agents in realistic settings.
items.title_zh: TokenEconomizer: 经验驱动的编码代理黑盒成本控制
items.detail_zh: 前沿编码代理商的进步使AI辅助软件工程的象征性成本急剧增加. 他们的象征效率通常在孤立的任务上得到评价,而现实世界的开发者则利用它们来持续地构建,更新和维护大型项目. 这种不匹配促使我们评价代理商超越现实的编码任务的序列,我们发现代理商表现出经常性的以环境为依存的象征性成本,而现有方法难以减少这些成本。 为了尽量减少这些成本,我们引入了TokenEconomizer,一个外部控制器,通过一系列任务削减特定环境的象征性成本。 这些削减来自于确定:(一) 注入哪些操作性微型技能,(二) 哪些工具一直无关紧要,以及(三) 何时干预非生产性故障循环。 在Claude Code, Codex, 和 GitHub 副驾驶CLI 与前沿模型对齐, TokenEconomizer 将平均代币成本降低了18.4%-30.9%, 并取得了相似的任务成功. 在每个经测试的代理模式设置下,每个存储库都有节余,并被概括到不同领域,如连续的网络开发和安全审计,根据任务结构,成本下降6.4至21.2%。 我们的工作建立了适应性的黑盒成本控制,作为在现实环境中降低编码剂象征性成本的有希望的方向。

items.detail: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become an essential infrastructure for Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), yet their lack of well-defined memory management systems hinders the development of long-context reasoning, continual personalization, and knowledge consistency.Existing models mainly rely on static parameters and short-lived contextual states, limiting their ability to track user preferences or update knowledge over extended periods.While Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) introduces external knowledge in plain text, it remains a stateless workaround without lifecycle control or integration with persistent representations.Recent work has modeled the training and inference cost of LLMs from a memory hierarchy perspective, showing that introducing an explicit memory layer between parameter memory and external retrieval can substantially reduce these costs by externalizing specific knowledge. Beyond computational efficiency, LLMs face broader challenges arising from how information is distributed over time and context, requiring systems capable of managing heterogeneous knowledge spanning different temporal scales and sources. To address this challenge, we propose MemOS, a memory operating system that treats memory as a manageable system resource. It unifies the representation, scheduling, and evolution of plaintext, activation-based, and parameter-level memories, enabling cost-efficient storage and retrieval. As the basic unit, a MemCube encapsulates both memory content and metadata such as provenance and versioning. MemCubes can be composed, migrated, and fused over time, enabling flexible transitions between memory types and bridging retrieval with parameter-based learning. MemOS establishes a memory-centric system framework that brings controllability, plasticity, and evolvability to LLMs, laying the foundation for continual learning and personalized modeling.
items.title_zh: MemOS:AI系统的内存OS
items.detail_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)已经成为人工一般智能(AGI)的基本基础设施,然而它们缺乏定义明确的内存管理系统会阻碍长写推理,持续个性化,以及知识一致性的发展. 现有模型主要依赖于静态参数和短寿命上下文状态,限制了它们在长时间内跟踪用户偏好或更新知识的能力. 虽然检索-增强生成(RAG)以简单文字介绍外部知识,但它仍然是无国籍的工作,没有生命周期控制或与持续表述相结合。 最近的工作从内存分级的角度模拟了LLMs的培训和推断成本,表明在参数内存和外部检索之间引入一个明确的内存层可以通过将特定知识外部化来大幅降低这些成本. 除了计算效率外,法学硕士课程还面临着因信息如何在时间和背景上分布而产生的更广泛的挑战,需要能够管理跨越不同时间尺度和来源的各种知识的系统。 为了应对这一挑战,我们提出"MemOS",这是一个将内存视为可管理系统资源的内存操作系统. 它统一了平正文字、基于活化的记忆和参数级记忆的表达、时间安排和演变,从而能够以具有成本效益的方式存储和检索。 作为基本单元,一个MemCube同时封装内存内容和元数据,如出处和版本. MemCube可以随时间而组成,迁移,并被熔化,使得内存类型和以参数为基础的学习连接检索之间能够灵活地过渡. MemOS建立了一个以记忆为中心的系统框架,为LLMS带来可控性,可塑性和可转性,为持续学习和个人化的模型制作打下基础.

items.title: A decoder-only foundation model for time-series forecasting
items.subtitle: Motivated by recent advances in large language models for Natural Language Processing (NLP), we design a time-series foundation model for forecasting whose out-of-the-box zero-shot performance on a variety of public datasets comes close to the accuracy of state-of-the-art supervised forecasting models for each individual dataset. Our model is based on pretraining a patched-decoder style attention model on a large time-series corpus, and can work well across different forecasting history lengths, prediction lengths and temporal granularities.
items.detail: Motivated by recent advances in large language models for Natural Language Processing (NLP), we design a time-series foundation model for forecasting whose out-of-the-box zero-shot performance on a variety of public datasets comes close to the accuracy of state-of-the-art supervised forecasting models for each individual dataset. Our model is based on pretraining a patched-decoder style attention model on a large time-series corpus, and can work well across different forecasting history lengths, prediction lengths and temporal granularities.
items.title_zh: 用于时间序列预测的解码器唯一基础模型
items.detail_zh: 受自然语言处理大语言模型(NLP)最新进步的推动,我们设计了一个时间序列基础模型,用于预测其各种公共数据集的出箱零发性能接近每个数据集最新监督预测模型的准确性. 我们的模型是基于在大型时间序列体上预先训练一个补丁-解码器风格的注意模型,可以很好地跨越不同的预测历史长度,预测长度和时间颗粒.

items.title: LlamaFactory: Unified Efficient Fine-Tuning of 100+ Language Models
items.subtitle: Efficient fine-tuning is vital for adapting large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks. However, it requires non-trivial efforts to implement these methods on different models. We present LlamaFactory, a unified framework that integrates a suite of cutting-edge efficient training methods. It allows users to flexibly customize the fine-tuning of 100+ LLMs without the need for coding through the built-in web UI LlamaBoard. We empirically validate the efficiency and effectiveness of our framework on language modeling and text generation tasks. It has been released at https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory and already received over 13,000 stars and 1,600 forks.

items.detail: Recently, large language model (LLM) based text-to-speech (TTS) systems have gradually become the mainstream in the industry due to their high naturalness and powerful zero-shot voice cloning capabilities.Here, we introduce the IndexTTS system, which is mainly based on the XTTS and Tortoise model. We add some novel improvements. Specifically, in Chinese scenarios, we adopt a hybrid modeling method that combines characters and pinyin, making the pronunciations of polyphonic characters and long-tail characters controllable. We also performed a comparative analysis of the Vector Quantization (VQ) with Finite-Scalar Quantization (FSQ) for codebook utilization of acoustic speech tokens. To further enhance the effect and stability of voice cloning, we introduce a conformer-based speech conditional encoder and replace the speechcode decoder with BigVGAN2. Compared with XTTS, it has achieved significant improvements in naturalness, content consistency, and zero-shot voice cloning. As for the popular TTS systems in the open-source, such as Fish-Speech, CosyVoice2, FireRedTTS and F5-TTS, IndexTTS has a relatively simple training process, more controllable usage, and faster inference speed. Moreover, its performance surpasses that of these systems. Our demos are available at https://index-tts.github.io.
items.title_zh: IndexTTS:工业一级可控和高效的零热文本对语音系统
items.detail_zh: 最近,基于文字对语音(TTS)的大型语言模型(LLM)系统由于天生性高和强大的零镜头语音克隆能力而逐渐成为了业界的主流. 在这里,我们引入了IndexTTS系统,该系统主要基于XTTS和"龟"模型. 我们补充了一些新的改进。 具体地说,在汉语情景中,我们采用混合模型方法,将字符和平分音结合起来,使多音字符和长尾字符的发音可以控制. 我们还与Finite-Scalar Quantization(FSQ)对矢量分量(VQ)进行了比较分析,用于编码本使用声学语音符号. 为了进一步提高语音克隆的效果和稳定性,我们引入了以同位素为基础的语音条件编码器,并用BigVGAN2取代语音码解码器. 与XTTS相比,它在自然性,内容一致性,零镜头语音克隆方面都取得了显著的改善. 至于开源中受欢迎的TTS系统,如Fish-Speech,CosyVoice2,FireRedTTS和F5-TTS等,IndexTTS的训练过程相对简单,使用量比较可控,推导速度也更快. 此外,其业绩超过了这些系统。 我们的演示可在https://index-tts.github.io上查阅。

items.title: SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills
items.subtitle: Agent skills today are hand-crafted, generated one-shot, or evolved through loosely controlled self-revision, none of which behaves like a deep-learning optimizer for the skill, and none of which reliably improves over its starting point under feedback. items.detail: Agent skills today are hand-crafted, generated one-shot, or evolved through loosely controlled self-revision, none of which behaves like a deep-learning optimizer for the skill, and none of which reliably improves over its starting point under feedback. We argue the skill should instead be trained as the external state of a frozen agent, with the same discipline that makes weight-space optimization reproducible. SkillOpt is, to our knowledge, the first systematic controllable text-space optimizer for agent skills: a separate optimizer model turns scored rollouts into bounded add/delete/replace edits on a single skill document, and an edit is accepted only when it strictly improves a held-out validation score. A textual learning-rate budget, rejected-edit buffer, and epoch-wise slow/meta update make skill training stable while adding zero inference-time model calls at deployment. Across six benchmarks, seven target models, and three execution harnesses (direct chat, Codex, Claude Code), SkillOpt is best or tied on all 52 evaluated (model, benchmark, harness) cells and beats every per-cell competitor among human, one-shot LLM, Trace2Skill, TextGrad, GEPA, and EvoSkill skills. On GPT-5.5 it lifts the average no-skill accuracy by +23.5 points in direct chat, by +24.8 inside the Codex agentic loop, and by +19.1 inside Claude Code. Transfer experiments further show that optimized skill artifacts retain value when moved across model scales, between Codex and Claude Code execution environments, and to a nearby math benchmark without further optimization.
items.title_zh: SkillOpt:自我发展代理技能执行战略
items.detail_zh: 今天的代理技能是手工制作的,产生一发一发,或者通过松散的自控自译自审而演化而来,这些自译自译自译的自译自出,都没有一个表现得像技能的深层学习优化器,也没有一个在反馈下可靠地改善了其起步点. 我们主张技能应该作为冷冻剂的外在状态来训练,具有同样的学科,使得重量空间优化可以再生产. 据我们所知,SkillOpt是代理技能的首个系统可控文本空间优化器:一个单独的优化器模型将分数滚出变成在单一技能文档上被绑定的添加/删除/替换编辑,而编辑只有在严格改进被搁置的验证分数时才被接受. 文字学习率预算、拒绝编辑缓冲和划时代的慢/元更新使技能培训稳定,同时在部署时增加零推断时间模型呼叫。 在6个基准、7个目标模型和3个执行工具(直接聊天、Codex、Claude Code)上,SkillOpt是最佳的或与所有52个被评价的细胞(模型、基准、取用)捆绑在一起,并击败了人类中每个细胞的每个竞争者、一发LLM、Trace2Skill、TextGrad、GEPA和EvoSkill技能。 在GPT-5.5上,它通过直接聊天的+23.5分,Codex代理回路的+24.8分和Claude代码的+19.1分提高平均无技能精度. 转移实验进一步显示,优化后的技能文物在跨模型尺度移动时,在Codex和克洛德代码执行环境之间,以及在不作进一步优化的情况下被保留到相邻的数学基准上,保留了价值.

items.detail: Audio Language Models (ALM) have emerged as the dominant paradigm for speech and music generation by representing audio as sequences of discrete tokens. Yet, unlike text tokens, which are invertible, audio tokens are extracted from lossy codecs with a limited bitrate. As a consequence, increasing audio quality requires generating more tokens, which imposes a trade-off between fidelity and computational cost. We address this issue by studying Continuous Audio Language Models (CALM). These models instantiate a large Transformer backbone that produces a contextual embedding at every timestep. This sequential information then conditions an MLP that generates the next continuous frame of an audio VAE through consistency modeling. By avoiding lossy compression, CALM achieves higher quality at lower computational cost than their discrete counterpart. Experiments on speech and music demonstrate improved efficiency and fidelity over state-of-the-art discrete audio language models, facilitating lightweight, high-quality audio generation. Samples are available at https://continuous-audio-language-models.github.io
items.title_zh: 连续音频语言模型
items.detail_zh: 音频语言模型(ALM)通过代表音频作为离散符号的序列而成为了语音和音乐生成的主导范式. 然而,与不可逆的文字符号不同的是,音频符号是从减值的解码器中取出,比特率有限. 因此,提高音频质量需要产生更多的信使,这就要求在忠诚与计算成本之间作出权衡。 我们通过研究连续音频语言模型来解决这一问题。 这些模型即时化出一个巨大的变形器主干线,在每一时段产生上下文嵌入. 这种相继的信息然后对通过一致性模型生成音频 VAE 下一个连续帧的 MLP 附加条件. 通过避免损失压缩,CALM以更低的计算成本达到比离散的对应物更高的质量. 关于语音和音乐的实验表明,相对于最先进的离散音频语言模型而言,效率和忠诚得到了提高,促进了轻而易举的高质量音频生成。 样本见https://continucle-audio-language-models.github.io。

items.detail: Agentic coding tools receive goals written in natural language as input, break them down into specific tasks, and write or execute the actual code with minimal human intervention. Central to this process are agent context files ("READMEs for agents") that provide persistent, project-level instructions. In this paper, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of 2,303 agent context files from 1,925 repositories to characterize their structure, maintenance, and content. We find that these files are not static documentation but complex, difficult-to-read artifacts that evolve like configuration code, maintained through frequent, small additions. Our content analysis of 16 instruction types shows that developers prioritize functional context, such as build and run commands (62.3%), implementation details (69.9%), and architecture (67.7%). We also identify a significant gap: non-functional requirements like security (14.5%) and performance (14.5%) are rarely specified. These findings indicate that while developers use context files to make agents functional, they provide few guardrails to ensure that agent-written code is secure or performant, highlighting the need for improved tooling and practices.
items.title_zh: 代理 READMEs: 代理编码背景文件的实证研究
items.detail_zh: 代理编码工具接收用自然语言写成的目标作为输入,将其分解为具体的任务,并在最小的人类干预下编写或执行实际代码. 这个过程的核心是代理上下文文件("用于代理的READMEs"),提供持久,项目级指令. 在本文中,我们对来自1,925个寄存器的2,303个代理上下文文件进行了第一次大规模的经验性研究,以描述其结构、维护和内容。 我们认为,这些文件不是静态文件,而是复杂而难以阅读的文物,这些文物像配置代码一样演变而来,通过频繁的小添加来维护. 我们对16个指令类型的内容分析显示,开发者优先考虑功能环境,如构建和运行命令(62.3%),实施细节(69.9%),以及架构(67.7%). 我们还发现了一个重大差距:安全(14.5%)和性能(14.5%)等不起作用的要求很少得到明确。 这些发现表明,开发者在使用上下文文件使代理机发挥作用的同时,它们也提供了很少的护栏来保证代理机所写的代码是安全的或者执行的,这突出说明了改进工具和实践的必要性.

items.detail: We introduce Matrix-Game, an interactive world foundation model for controllable game world generation. Matrix-Game is trained using a two-stage pipeline that first performs large-scale unlabeled pretraining for environment understanding, followed by action-labeled training for interactive video generation. To support this, we curate Matrix-Game-MC, a comprehensive Minecraft dataset comprising over 2,700 hours of unlabeled gameplay video clips and over 1,000 hours of high-quality labeled clips with fine-grained keyboard and mouse action annotations. Our model adopts a controllable image-to-world generation paradigm, conditioned on a reference image, motion context, and user actions. With over 17 billion parameters, Matrix-Game enables precise control over character actions and camera movements, while maintaining high visual quality and temporal coherence. To evaluate performance, we develop GameWorld Score, a unified benchmark measuring visual quality, temporal quality, action controllability, and physical rule understanding for Minecraft world generation. Extensive experiments show that Matrix-Game consistently outperforms prior open-source Minecraft world models (including Oasis and MineWorld) across all metrics, with particularly strong gains in controllability and physical consistency. Double-blind human evaluations further confirm the superiority of Matrix-Game, highlighting its ability to generate perceptually realistic and precisely controllable videos across diverse game scenarios. To facilitate future research on interactive image-to-world generation, we will open-source the Matrix-Game model weights and the GameWorld Score benchmark at https://github.com/SkyworkAI/Matrix-Game.
items.title_zh: Matrix-Game:互动世界基金会模型
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了Matrix-Game,一个可控游戏世界代的互动世界基础模型. Matrix-Game使用两个阶段的管道进行训练,该管道首先进行大规模无标签的预训,以了解环境,然后为交互式视频生成进行行动标签培训。 为了支持这一点,我们管理Matrix-Game-MC,这是一个全面的Minecraft数据集,包括2 700多小时的无标签游戏播放视频片段和1 000多小时的高质量有标签的片段,并附有精细的键盘和鼠标动作说明。 我们的模型采用了可控的图像到世界生成模式,以参考图像、运动背景和用户动作为条件。 拥有超过170亿个参数,Matrix-Game能够精确控制人物动作和相机运动,同时保持高视觉质量和时间一致性. 为了评价性能,我们开发了GameWorld Score,一个用于测量视觉质量,时间质量,动作可控性,以及Minecraft世界一代物理规则理解的统一基准. 广泛的实验表明,Matrix-Game在所有度量衡上一直比以前的开源Minecraft世界模型(包括绿洲和MineWorld)表现优于前作,在可控性和物理一致性方面特别显著. 双盲人评价进一步证实了Matrix-Game的优越性,凸显出其在不同游戏场景中产生能感知到现实和准确可控的视频的能力. 为了便利今后对交互式图像到世界生成的研究,我们将在https://github.com/SkyworkAI/Matrix-Game上开放矩阵-Game模型权重和游戏世界分数基准。

items.title: Fish Audio S2 Technical Report
items.subtitle: We introduce Fish Audio S2, an open-sourced text-to-speech system featuring multi-speaker, multi-turn generation, and, most importantly, instruction-following control via natural-language descriptions. To scale training, we develop a multi-stage training recipe together with a staged data pipeline covering video captioning and speech captioning, voice-quality assessment, and reward modeling. To push the frontier of open-source TTS, we release our model weights, fine-tuning code, and an SGLang-based inference engine. items.detail: We introduce Fish Audio S2, an open-sourced text-to-speech system featuring multi-speaker, multi-turn generation, and, most importantly, instruction-following control via natural-language descriptions. To scale training, we develop a multi-stage training recipe together with a staged data pipeline covering video captioning and speech captioning, voice-quality assessment, and reward modeling. To push the frontier of open-source TTS, we release our model weights, fine-tuning code, and an SGLang-based inference engine. The inference engine is production-ready for streaming, achieving an RTF of 0.195 and a time-to-first-audio below 100 ms.Our code and weights are available on GitHub (https://github.com/fishaudio/fish-speech) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/fishaudio/s2-pro). We highly encourage readers to visit https://fish.audio to try custom voices.
items.title_zh: 鱼声S2技术报告
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了Fish Audio S2,一个开源的文字对语音系统,其特点是多语种,多回转生成,最重要的是通过自然语言描述来进行指令跟踪控制. 为了扩大培训规模,我们开发了一个多阶段培训配方,以及一个包括视频字幕和语音字幕、语音质量评估和奖励模型的分阶段数据管道。 为了推进开源TTS的前沿,我们释放出我们的模型重量,微调代码,以及基于SGLang的推论引擎. 推想引擎已可被制取出可流出,实现0.195的RTF和100ms以下的时间到第一的Audio. 我们的代码和权重可在GitHub(https://github.com/fishaudio/fish-speech)和Hugging Face(https://huggingface.co/fishaudio/s2-pro)上查阅。 我们非常鼓励读者访问https://fish.audio,

items.detail: As streaming video generation advances, enabling real-time interaction with generated video is becoming increasingly important. We introduce StreamEval, a unified benchmark for interactive streaming video generation spanning five tasks: avatar dialogue, avatar performance, world generation, instruction editing, and reference editing. StreamEval comprises 300 scripted test cases lasting 15-300s, each specifying initial assets, incrementally arriving multimodal requests, and explicit requirements for state changes and content preservation. Performance is assessed along four evaluation dimensions: task execution, state consistency, visual fidelity, and audiovisual coordination, instantiated through ten task-specific metrics on a 0-100 scale. Evaluating 37 distinct models across 300 test cases, we find that high visual quality and identity retention do not necessarily coincide with reliable request execution or sustained state consistency. In particular, request execution remains challenging: the highest task-specific scores are 36.90 for Following among seven avatar-performance models, 25.93 for Following in text-conditioned world generation, and 15.00 for Edit Success among three reported reference-editing models. These findings identify reliable request execution under timing and preservation constraints as a central challenge for advancing omni-modal real-time interactive systems. The leaderboard is available at https://streameval.ai
items.title_zh: StreamEval: 评估互动流视频生成模式
items.detail_zh: 随着流媒体视频生成的进步,与生成的视频进行实时互动变得越来越重要. 我们引入了 StreamEval, 用于交互流视频生成的统一基准 , 涵盖五个任务:相机对话、相机性能、世界相机、指令编辑和参考编辑。 StreamEval由300个脚本测试案例组成,持续15-300个,每个案例都具体说明初始资产,递增收到的多式申请,以及国家变更和内容保存的明确要求。 业绩按四个评价方面来评估:任务执行、状态一致性、视觉忠诚和视听协调,通过10个具体任务衡量标准在0-100尺度上进行即时评估。 在对300个测试案例的37个不同模型进行评估时,我们发现,高视觉质量和保留身份并不一定与可靠的请求执行或持续的国家一致性相吻合。 特别是,执行请求仍然具有挑战性:在7个阿凡达性能模型中,任务特有分数最高的是36.90分,在文本条件世界一代中,为25.93分,在三个报告参考编辑模型中,为15.00分。 这些结论指出,在时间和保存方面的限制下可靠地执行请求是推进全方位实时互动系统的一个中心挑战。 领导牌可在https://streameval.ai查阅。

items.detail: Smaller activation outliers do not necessarily imply better low-bit quantization: their alignment with the quantizer matters. We introduce PrismQuant, a quantizer-aware rotation framework that aligns the leading activation eigenspace with the constant group subspace of asymmetric grouped INT4. The affine offsets represent the energy in this subspace without widening the range within the group. We formulate rotation design as a Ky Fan trace maximization and derive a closed-form solution that is provably optimal for this alignment objective. Compact Householder transformations and their compact-WY representation enable gradient-free construction and efficient application at both foldable and online sites. A predictive range law further connects unaligned activation energy and group size to quantization-relevant variation. Experiments on Llama, Qwen, and Mistral span dense models up to 70B parameters and a 30B mixture-of-experts model. Under W4A4KV4, PrismQuant sets the state of the art on Llama-3.2-3B among the compared methods in both perplexity and accuracy. On Llama-3.1-70B, it attains 3.85 perplexity and 72.46% average zero-shot accuracy, only 0.22 percentage points below full precision. In the deployment study on Llama-3.1-8B, our optimized implementation achieves 1.51x prefill and 1.22x CUDA Graph decode speedups over matched FP16 baselines, with 56.34% lower decode peak memory and only 2.35% additional Graph decode latency over Hadamard. Code is available at https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/PrismQuant.
items.title_zh: PrismQuant: 组合量子优化核-空间旋转
items.detail_zh: 更小的活化离子不一定意味着更好的低位分量:它们与分量器事项的对接. 我们引入了PrismQuant,一个分量-意识自转框架,它将引导活化的eigenspace与不对称分组INT4的恒定群子空间相协调. 等离子抵消代表这个子空间的能量,而不扩大组内的范围. 我们把旋转设计作为Ky Fan的跟踪最大化, 并得出一个封闭式的解决方案, 这个组合目标可以证明是最佳的。 可折叠和在线网站的紧凑住户转换及其紧凑的WY表述可以实现无梯度构造和高效应用。 一个预测范围定律进一步将不相通活化能和组大小与量化相关变异相接. 有关Llama,Quen,和Mistral的实验跨越了密度模型,可达70B参数和一个30B专家混合模型. 在W4A4KV4下,PrismQuant在Llama-3.2-3B上设定了比较方法中既复杂又准确的状态. 在Llama-3.1-70B上,它达到了3.85的通透度和72.46%的平均零发精度,仅比全精度低0.22个百分点. 在Llama-3.1-8B的部署研究中,我们优化的实施实现了1.51x预填和1.22x CUDA Graph解码速度超过相匹配的FP16基线,解码峰值内存的56.34%更低,哈达马尔德上空的解码空位仅增加2.35%. 代码可见于https://github.com/Forever Blue816/PrismQuant.

items.detail: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is increasingly deployed in enterprise search and document-centric assistants, where responses must be grounded in long and complex source materials. In practice, verifying that generated answers faithfully reflect retrieved documents is difficult: large language models can check long contexts but are too slow and costly for interactive services, while lightweight classifiers operate within strict context limits and frequently miss evidence outside truncated passages. We present the design of a real-time verification component integrated into a production RAG pipeline that enables full-document grounding under latency constraints. The system processes documents up to 32K tokens and employs adaptive inference strategies to balance response time and verification coverage across workloads. We describe the architectural decisions, operational trade-offs, and evaluation methodology used to deploy the verifier, and show that full-context verification substantially improves detection of unsupported responses compared with truncated validation. Our experience highlights when long-context verification is necessary, why chunk-based checking often fails in real documents, and how latency budgets shape model design. These findings provide practical guidance for practitioners building reliable large-scale retrieval-augmented applications. (Model, benchmark, and code: https://huggingface.co/llm-semantic-router)
items.title_zh: 快速而忠实:长文件检索强化生成系统的实时验证
items.detail_zh: 在企业搜索和以文件为中心的助理人员中,越来越多地部署检索增强生成(RAG),这些助理人员的反应必须以长期而复杂的原始材料为基础。 在实践中,验证生成的答案忠实地反映被检索到的文档是困难的:大型语言模型可以检查较长的上下文,但对于交互服务来说过于缓慢和昂贵,而轻量级分类器则在严格的上下文限制下运行,经常会漏掉短段外的证据. 我们提出将实时核查部分纳入生产RAG管道的设计,以便能够在暂时性限制下全面铺设文件。 该系统处理多达32K个文件,并采用适应性的推论战略,以平衡反应时间和工作量的核查范围。 我们描述了用于部署核查员的建筑决定、业务取舍和评价方法,并表明,与短时验证相比,全文核查大大改进了对不支持的答复的检测。 我们的经验突出表明,何时需要长文本核查,为什么基于块的检查往往在真实文件中失败,以及长期预算模型设计如何。 这些研究结果为从业人员建立可靠的大规模检索强化应用程序提供了实际指导。 (模式、基准和代码:https://huggingface.co/llm-semantic-router)

items.detail: World models enable embodied agents to anticipate action consequences, yet jointly modeling locomotion and manipulation across diverse embodiments remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces and limited multimodal supervision. We present Ropedia W0, the first egocentric loco-manipulation world foundation model spanning humans and robots with diverse embodiments. We curate Xp-Data, comprising 10k hours of egocentric human data and 3k hours of robot data with unified multimodal annotations and systematic quality control. A unified kinematic representation encodes locomotion through camera poses and manipulation through projected skeletons, with robot skeletons combining embodiment-specific forward kinematics with extensive manual keypoint annotation and correction. We also introduce Xp-Teleop, a long-horizon loco-manipulation benchmark based on high-quality dexterous humanoid teleoperation data. Evaluations demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across five cross-embodiment benchmarks (DreamDojo, Ψ_0, ω-HOME, Xp-Teleop, and AgiBot) and on held-out human egocentric video, from zero-shot inference to few-shot and full-data post-training. Scaling human pre-training data improves performance on both human and robot evaluations. After distillation, our model supports real-time, minute-long rollouts, enabling live VR interaction. Applications in policy evaluation, model-based planning, and world-action modeling further demonstrate the model's utility for embodied decision-making.

items.detail: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems enhance large language models (LLMs) by integrating external knowledge sources, enabling more accurate and contextually relevant responses tailored to user needs. However, existing RAG systems have significant limitations, including reliance on flat data representations and inadequate contextual awareness, which can lead to fragmented answers that fail to capture complex inter-dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose LightRAG, which incorporates graph structures into text indexing and retrieval processes. This innovative framework employs a dual-level retrieval system that enhances comprehensive information retrieval from both low-level and high-level knowledge discovery. Additionally, the integration of graph structures with vector representations facilitates efficient retrieval of related entities and their relationships, significantly improving response times while maintaining contextual relevance. This capability is further enhanced by an incremental update algorithm that ensures the timely integration of new data, allowing the system to remain effective and responsive in rapidly changing data environments. Extensive experimental validation demonstrates considerable improvements in retrieval accuracy and efficiency compared to existing approaches. We have made our LightRAG open-source and available at the link: https://github.com/HKUDS/LightRAG.
items.title_zh: LightRAG: 简单而快速的检索增强生成
items.detail_zh: 检索-增强生成(RAG)系统通过整合外部知识来源来增强大型语言模型(LLMS),从而能够根据用户需求做出更加准确和符合具体情况的反应. 然而,现有的RAG系统有重大的局限性,包括依赖平坦的数据表述和对背景认识不足,这可能导致答案支离破碎,无法反映复杂的相互依存关系。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议使用LightRAG,将图表结构纳入文本索引和检索过程。 这一创新框架采用双层检索系统,加强从低层和高层知识发现的全面信息检索。 此外,将图表结构与矢量表示方式结合起来,有助于高效检索相关实体及其关系,大大地改善反应时间,同时保持关联性。 这一能力通过递增更新算法得到进一步加强,该算法确保了新数据的及时整合,使系统能够在迅速变化的数据环境中保持效力和响应性. 与现有方法相比,广泛的实验验证表明,检索准确性和效率有了相当大的提高。 我们开放了我们的LightRAG的源头,可在以下链接获得:https://github.com/HKUDS/LightRAG。

items.title: VoiceMem: Streaming Dual-Brain Memory for Real-Time Interaction

items.detail: Conversational systems, such as duplex speech language models (SLMs), still lack a streaming, accurate, and empathetic memory system as their soul. We introduce VoiceMem, a simple memory architecture with a parallel informational left brain, an emotional right brain, and streaming memory I/O mechanisms. We further build a complete pipeline for memory-aware SLM training, long-horizon evaluation, and decoupled deployment with interchangeable memory backends. Experiments and real-world deployment show three advantages: i) Accuracy: under top-5 retrieval, the left brain outperforms classical systems such as Mem0 at top-200 by nearly 30 points; ii) Emotional & Personal: the right brain, with short- and long-horizon affective attribution and dual-node persona modeling, achieves state-of-the-art performance across three persona benchmarks and improves the aggregate score by 4.29 points over the previous best system; and iii) Real-Time & Cheap: VoiceMem completes retrieval in 134 ms, well within standard VAD latency, adding no extra conversational delay while maintaining high accuracy and low cost. These results show that VoiceMem provides a practical memory foundation for real-time, personalized, and emotionally aware speech interaction.
items.title_zh: VoiceMem: 流出双脑记忆用于实时互动
items.detail_zh: 对话式系统,如双相语音语言模型(SLMS),仍然缺乏作为灵魂的流出,准确,并具有爱心的记忆系统. 我们引入了VoiceMem, 一个简单的记忆架构, 一个平行的信息左脑, 一个情感右脑, 和流传的记忆 I/O机制。 我们进一步为记忆意识的可持续土地管理培训、长视野评估以及可互换记忆后端的脱钩部署搭建了完整的管道。 实验和现实世界部署显示出三个优点: (一)精准度:在前5回取下,左脑在上-200的"Mem0"等古典系统上超过了近30分; (二)情感与个人:右脑,具有短相和长相的有影响属性和双相的人物模型化,在三个人基准上实现最先进的性能,比之前的最佳系统提高总分4.29分; (三)实时与便宜度:声能在134分以内完成回取,远在标准VAD空档内,在保持高精度和低成本的同时不增加额外的对话延迟. 这些结果显示"VoiceMem"为实时,个性化,情感意识的语音互动提供了实用的记忆基础.

items.detail: Despite rapid advances in autonomous AI scientists powered by language models, generating publication-ready illustrations remains a labor-intensive bottleneck in the research workflow. To lift this burden, we introduce PaperBanana, an agentic framework for automated generation of publication-ready academic illustrations. Powered by state-of-the-art VLMs and image generation models, PaperBanana orchestrates specialized agents to retrieve references, plan content and style, render images, and iteratively refine via self-critique. To rigorously evaluate our framework, we introduce PaperBananaBench, comprising 292 test cases for methodology diagrams curated from NeurIPS 2025 publications, covering diverse research domains and illustration styles. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that PaperBanana consistently outperforms leading baselines in faithfulness, conciseness, readability, and aesthetics. We further show that our method effectively extends to the generation of high-quality statistical plots. Collectively, PaperBanana paves the way for the automated generation of publication-ready illustrations.
items.title_zh: Paper Banana:AI科学家学术说明自动化
items.detail_zh: 尽管由语言模型驱动的自主人工智能科学家取得了快速进步,但生成已出版的插图仍然是研究工作流程中的一个劳力密集型瓶颈。 为了减轻这一负担,我们介绍了Paper Banana,这是自动生成可供出版的学术插图的代理框架。 由最先进的VLMs和图像生成模型提供动力,PaperBanana组织专门人员检索参考资料、计划内容和风格、制作图像以及通过自我批评进行迭代精炼。 为了严格评价我们的框架,我们介绍了《Banana Bench文件》,其中包括292个测试案例,用于从NeurIPS 2025年出版物中整理的方法图,涵盖不同的研究领域和插图风格。 综合实验表明,Paper Banana在忠诚、简洁、可读性和美学方面一贯优于领先基线。 我们进一步表明,我们的方法有效地扩展到生成高质量的统计图。 集体而言,Paper Banana为自动生成已出版的插图铺平了道路。

items.detail: Large Language Model (LLM) agents can handle increasingly complex tasks, navigating long trajectories of observations and actions. As these trajectories grow, key-value (KV) cache I/O and storage become the dominant cost. Trajectories can also exceed the LLM's maximum context length, requiring control over active cache growth. Prior work uses context engineering to reduce cache size by trimming or summarizing history. However, modifying the trajectory prefix invalidates subsequent cached states and triggers costly re-prefilling of retained context. Task accuracy can also suffer when too little context is retained to limit re-prefill costs. We propose cache engineering as a new scheme. It allows agents to directly control their active KV cache without modifying the trajectory or re-prefilling retained context. Specifically, agents can proactively use drop to exclude selected cache from future attention and repos to adjust retained keys' position encodings. We formalize these cache operations and identify history dependence as a serving challenge: identical token sequences can yield different cache states under different cache operation sequences, making prefix matching insufficient for correct cache reuse. Thus, we co-design the AKV serving engine. It provides a stateless interface compatible with existing serving APIs, while internally managing stateful cache reuse, eviction, and restoration. Experiments show that a tool-response rolling-drop cache policy improves average benchmark scores by 1.7 points and reduces average cost by 27.7%, compared with conventional threshold-triggered summarization. With AKV, it achieves up to 1.2x the output throughput and a 1.5x speedup in P95 request latency. Recursive self-improvement of cache policies further reduces cost by 7.1% over expert design. Our code is at https://github.com/thu-nics/AKV.
items.title_zh: 代理缓存工程
items.detail_zh: 大语言模型(LLM)代理可以处理日益复杂的任务,导航观测和行动的长期轨迹. 随着这些轨迹的增长,密钥值(KV)缓存一/O和存储成为主导成本. 轨迹也可以超过LLM的最大上下文长度,需要控制活性缓存生长. 前作采用上下文工程,通过裁剪或总结历史来减少缓存大小. 然而,修改轨迹前缀会使随后被缓存的状态失效并引发对所保留上下文进行成本高昂的再预置. 如果保留的内容太少,无法限制再预补费用,任务准确性也会受到影响。 我们提出缓存工程作为新计划. 它允许代理直接控制其活性的KV缓存,而无需修改轨迹或重新预留上下文. 具体来说,代理商可以主动地使用放出来将所选缓存排除在未来注意力之外,并重置以调整所保留的密钥位置编码. 我们把这些缓存操作正式化,并认定历史依赖性是一个服务性的挑战:相同的符号序列可以在不同的缓存操作序列下产生不同的缓存状态,使前缀匹配不足以进行正确的缓存再用. 因此,我们共同设计AKV服务引擎. 它提供了一个与现有的服务API相兼容的无国籍界面,同时在内部管理状态缓存再利用,驱逐和恢复. 实验显示,与传统的阈值触发总和相比,工具响应滚动投放缓存政策将平均基准分数提高1.7分并降低27.7%. 与AKV相通后,可实现最高1.2x输出吞吐量和1.5x速度在P95请求潜伏. 缓存政策的回溯性自我改进进一步使成本比专家设计降低7.1%. 我们的代码在https://github.com/thu-nics/AKV上.

items.detail: Agents built on vision language models (VLMs) now compete with learned policies on robot manipulation leaderboards. We ask how far a coding agent can go when it controls a robot instead of a computer, and where it stops. Our system, HexaShell, keeps the harness thin: it only turns the agent's commands into robot motion. The agent drives a robot with two arms through one command line. It sees three RGB cameras and knows their calibration. After each failed attempt, the agent reads the log, finds the cause, and writes or fixes small programs called tools. In this way it keeps what it learns as code, as a coding agent does when it fixes a failing test. The tools may use only what the robot observes. They use triangulation to find where objects are, relative to each other and to the gripper. If two cameras see the same point, the point lies where the two camera rays meet. If a point lies on a known plane, such as the table or the top of a block, it lies where its ray meets that plane. When the head camera is not enough, the robot moves a wrist camera to get a second view. We build the tools on only ten layouts of one seed per task, then freeze them and test them on ten new layouts of the same seed. We use Codex with GPT-6-Astra at medium reasoning effort. On all 42 RoboDojo tasks, HexaShell reaches a success rate of 39.7% and a progress score of 48.0, averaged in the same way as the leaderboard. This is a new state of the art on RoboDojo. The limit is contact, not reasoning: pushing reaches 92.5% and memory tasks 65.0%, but tight insertion only 8.3%. When the agent fails, it usually sees the failure but cannot make the motion work. We open source the tools evolved so far at https://github.com/HexaFuture/HexaShell.

items.title: UniForge3D: Joint 3D Reconstruction and Generation in a Shared Anchor-Guided Space
items.subtitle: Generating complete 3D assets from sparse, unposed images requires preserving observed geometry while completing unseen regions. Joint reconstruction and generation offers a way to address both goals: reconstruction recovers the geometry observed in the input images, while generation contributes learned shape priors. However, combining camera-relative reconstruction with canonical-space generation introduces a coordinate mismatch that makes direct geometric interaction more difficult. Moreover, conditioning each 3D location on all views without accounting for their relevance may mix useful geometric evidence with unrelated image content, hindering local detail recovery. items.detail: Generating complete 3D assets from sparse, unposed images requires preserving observed geometry while completing unseen regions. Joint reconstruction and generation offers a way to address both goals: reconstruction recovers the geometry observed in the input images, while generation contributes learned shape priors. However, combining camera-relative reconstruction with canonical-space generation introduces a coordinate mismatch that makes direct geometric interaction more difficult. Moreover, conditioning each 3D location on all views without accounting for their relevance may mix useful geometric evidence with unrelated image content, hindering local detail recovery. We present UniForge3D, which jointly models reconstruction and generation in a shared anchor-guided space, resolving their coordinate mismatch. This space follows the anchor view's azimuth while keeping the object upright. The two branches exchange features bidirectionally to predict per-view point maps and a complete sparse voxel structure. We further condition point-map prediction on the generated structure to establish pixel-to-voxel correspondences and select the most informative input view for each voxel. Features from the selected views then guide detailed shape generation, helping preserve observed geometric details. Our method achieves state-of-the-art appearance and geometry results on Toys4K and GSO, generating complete 3D assets with improved fidelity. Project webpage: https://xishuxishu.github.io/uniforge3d-project/
