items.detail: Scientific discovery requires developing worthwhile hypotheses into practical investigations, yet learning from this evolving research process remains challenging. We introduce an operational definition of valuable and testable research hypotheses: evidence-grounded claims about consequential uncertainties, coupled with feasible investigations, explicit decision criteria, and alternative explanations. Our DiscoveryRSI framework develops hypothesis trees through multi-agent evolutionary search, compiles selected investigations into executable Harbor tasks, and recursively learns through three mechanisms: hypothesis credit optimization attributes scientific assessments to documented research contributions; harness replay identifies productive strategies and recurring failures to refine research workflows; and rediscovery applies accepted improvements to new investigations, generating further experience for subsequent learning. We also introduce DFM-Bench, which provides comprehensive assessment of hypothesis quality and cumulative research progress at the levels of hypotheses, revisions, development paths and research runs. Across four life-science domains, automated evaluation shows that hypothesis quality rises from 4.86 for the base model to 5.39 after two rounds of self-improvement, with the large gains in falsifiability and data resolvability. We further validate hypothesis quality through expert review, comparing our DiscoveryRSI-27B with other research agents. Preliminary human assessments show that DiscoveryRSI-27B scores higher than GPT-6 Luna on hypothesis importance and whether claims are plausible and evidence-bounded. DiscoveryRSI-27B achieved a 6.3% rate of hypothesis correspondence with research published after the model cutoff, largely outperform GPT-6 with 2.5% and Claude Opus 5 with 2.3%, while delivering greater human-rated improvement along research paths.
items.title_zh: DiscoveryRSI:回溯性地学习去发现有价值假说
items.detail_zh: 科学发现需要将有价值的假设发展成实际调查,但从这一不断发展的研究进程中吸取教训仍然具有挑战性。 我们提出了宝贵和可检验的研究假设的实用定义:对由此引起的不确定性的有证据依据的指控,以及可行的调查、明确的决定标准和其他解释。 我们的"发现"(Discovery RSI)框架通过多代理进取搜索来开发假想树,汇编对可执行港务任务的部分调查,并通过三种机制进行再生学习:假想信用优化将科学评估归结为有文献记载的研究贡献;利用再演绎识别生产策略和反复出现的失败来完善研究工作流程;再演绎对新调查应用被接受的改进,为以后的学习产生进一步的经验. 我们还引入了DFM-Bench,该技术在假设,修订,发展路径和研究运行的层面上对假设质量和累积研究进展进行全面评估. 在整个四个生命科学领域,自动化评价表明,假设质量从基础模型的4.86上升到了两轮自改进后的5.39,在易腐烂性和数据可解性方面取得了巨大收益. 我们通过专家审查进一步验证假说质量,将我们的"发现"RSI-27B与其他研究代理人进行比较. 初步的人类评估显示,发现RSI-27B的得分高于GPT-6 Luna的假设重要性以及索赔是否合理和证据范围. items.detail: Real-world clinical decision-making grapples with integrating information from diverse data modalities, including medical text, 2D/3D images, and video, leading to inefficiencies and potential diagnostic oversights. While generalist vision-language models (VLMs) offer promise, their medical development faces challenges of opaque pipelines, data scarcity, and architectural inflexibility. Here we present Hulu-Med, a transparent medical VLM that unifies understanding across all these modalities. Built upon a unified patch-based vision encoder and an LLM decoder, Hulu-Med was progressively trained on 16.7 million (M) samples to scale from 2D to 3D and video comprehension. The medical-aware token reduction enables efficient training, requiring only 4,000 to 40,000 GPU hours for 7B to 32B parameter variants. Extensive evaluation across 30 benchmarks exhibits state-of-the-art performance, surpassing leading open-source models and competing with proprietary systems in tasks spanning visual question-answering, medical report generation, and complex reasoning in multilingual and rare disease scenarios. By open-sourcing our complete pipeline, we establish that high-performance medical VLM can be achieved transparently, providing a foundational tool for accessible and impactful clinical AI. Code is released on https://github.com/ZJUI-AI4H/Hulu-Med{https://github.com/ZJUI-AI4H/Hulu-Med}.
items.title_zh: Hulu-Med:实现综合医学视野-语言理解的透明通论模式
items.detail_zh: 现实世界临床决策努力整合来自各种数据模式的信息,包括医疗文本、2D/3D图像和视频,导致效率低下和潜在的诊断监督。 虽然泛泛的视觉语言模型(VLMs)提供了希望,但其医学发展面临着不透明的管道、数据稀缺和建筑不灵活等挑战。 在此,我们介绍Hulu-Med,一种透明的医学 VLM,它统一了所有这些方式的理解。 Hulu-Med在统一的补丁视觉编码器和LLM解码器的基础上,在1 670万个样本上逐步接受了从2D到3D的分级和视频理解的培训。 医学认知符号的减少使得能够进行有效的培训,7B到32B参数变体只需要4,000到40,000GPU小时. 对30个基准的广泛评价显示了最新业绩,超越了领先的开放源码模式,在涉及视觉问答、医疗报告生成以及多种语言和罕见疾病情况下复杂推理的任务中与专有系统竞争。 通过开放我们的完整管道,我们确定高性能的医学VLM可以透明地实现,为无障碍和有影响的临床AI提供了一个基础工具. 代码发布在https://github.com/ZJUI-AI4H/Hulu-Med{https://github.com/ZJUI-AI4H/Hulu-Med}上.

items.detail: AI coding agents can now build small playable games in minutes, but the results usually look like programmer art: gray blockouts, colored geometric primitives, and flat semantic blobs. We present AnyGameRenderer, a video-to-video generative renderer that turns such footage into high-quality visuals with characters, motion detail, and effects. Throughout, it keeps the layout, camera, and every entity's position and timing intact. Our AnyGameRenderer generalizes across a wide range of genres that agents build, such as tower defense, auto-battlers, top-down survivors, turn-based battles, kart racing, and crowd runners. AnyGameRenderer takes plain video as its game-state input, with no complex representations such as engine G-buffers, per-object class labels, or low-poly proxies. Gray blockouts, colored primitives, semantic maps, and wireframes all work as input. It also preserves entity correspondence: group counts stay correct, and entities appear and disappear on the right frame. We implement AnyGameRenderer by LoRA fine-tuning MiniMax-H3 ref2va, a 33B reference-video-conditioned video generation model. Training uses sim10k paired clips from three sources: (i) multi-stream rendering data from 38 agent-made games exported from GEAR, an AI game-creation tool; (ii) two-stream rendering data from Unreal Engine, with programmatically controlled crowds, count changes, and entity scales; and (iii) real gameplay recordings, with pairs reconstructed via 3D-box detection. To evaluate the entity correspondence, we propose an entity-level benchmark of 59 held-out cases with 753 entities, scored against ground-truth boxes. Compared with the base model, AnyGameRenderer better preserves entity correspondence: temporal match rises from 50.9\% to 62.9\%, missed count changes fall from 34.7\% to 21.3\%, and fewer entities are hallucinated or left unrendered.
items.title_zh: AnyGameRender: 实体- 恒定跨游戏的基因生成和实体级基准
items.detail_zh: AI编码代理现在可以在几分钟内构建出可玩的小游戏,但结果通常看起来像程序员的艺术:灰色阻塞,有色几何原始,平平的语义blobs. 我们介绍AnyGameRender, 一个视频到视频的基因渲染器, 将这样的镜头转化为高质量的视觉, 带有人物, 运动细节和效果。 在整个过程中,它保持了布局,相机,以及每个实体的位置和时间不变. 我们的AnyGameRender 概括了特工们建立的各种流派,例如塔楼防御、自动击发机、自上而下幸存者、回合制战斗、Kart赛跑和人群跑车。 AnyGameRender将平面视频作为其游戏状态输入,没有引擎G-buffers,每个对象类标签等复杂表示,或低波快取. 灰色挡道,有色原始人,语义地图,并有线框作为输入都起作用. 它还保留了实体函证:组数保持正确,实体出现在并消失在正确的框架. 我们执行AnyGameRender,由LORA微调MiniMax-H3 ref2va,一个33B的参考视频条件生成模型. 训练使用来自三个来源的sim10k配对剪辑: (一)从GEAR输出出38个代理制作的游戏的多流渲染数据,是AI游戏制作工具; (二)从不真实引擎输出出双流渲染数据,有程序上控制的人群,计数变化,以及实体尺度; (三)真实的游戏玩法录音,通过3D-box检测重建成对. 为了评价实体的函证,我们提出一个实体一级的基准,即59起搁置案件,有753个实体,与地面真相箱对照。 与基准模型相比,AnyGameRender更好地保存了实体对应:时间匹配从50.9\%上升到62.9\%,错失的计数变化从34.7\%下降到21.3\%,幻觉或被置之不理的实体较少.

items.subtitle: General-purpose robots must infer what a new task requires and translate that understanding into appropriate physical action. In-context learning (ICL) for robots supports this process by using demonstrations and interaction to direct existing competence with neural parameters held fixed during deployment. We organize this literature review around the interfaces connecting contextual evidence to execution, distinguishing four families: context-conditioned policies, geometric demonstration transfer, world-model-based control, and skill- and agent-based execution. Comparing these interfaces clarifies their transfer assumptions and the roles of training, correspondence, and memory in making con
items.detail: General-purpose robots must infer what a new task requires and translate that understanding into appropriate physical action. In-context learning (ICL) for robots supports this process by using demonstrations and interaction to direct existing competence with neural parameters held fixed during deployment. We organize this literature review around the interfaces connecting contextual evidence to execution, distinguishing four families: context-conditioned policies, geometric demonstration transfer, world-model-based control, and skill- and agent-based execution. Comparing these interfaces clarifies their transfer assumptions and the roles of training, correspondence, and memory in making context useful. Across manipulation and navigation, we examine how these mechanisms preserve taught requirements as objects, environments, and execution conditions change. This analysis links method design to evaluation practices that distinguish responsiveness to teaching, physical transfer, and benefits from retained experience. The resulting agenda connects compositional task acquisition and faithful transfer with physical recursive self-improvement, in which experience improves the ability to learn subsequent tasks.
items.title_zh: 机器人文稿学习:方法和应用
items.detail_zh: 通用机器人必须推断新任务需要什么,并将这种理解转化为适当的实际行动。 机器人的内文本学习(ICL)通过使用演示和互动来引导部署期间固定的神经参数的现有能力,支持了这一过程. 我们围绕着将背景证据与执行联系起来的界面组织文献审查,区分四个家庭:环境条件化政策、几何示范转移、基于世界模式的控制、基于技能和代理的执行。 比较这些接口可以澄清其转移假设以及培训、函证和内存在使环境有用方面的作用。 通过操纵和导航,我们研究了这些机制如何在物体、环境和执行条件发生变化时维护所教导的要求。 这种分析将方法设计与评价做法联系起来,这些评价做法区分了对教学的响应、物理转移以及保留经验的好处。 由此产生的议程将组成任务获得和忠实转移与物理递归自我改进联系起来,其中经验提高了学习后续任务的能力.

items.detail: Despite recent progress in dexterous reference tracking, existing models focus primarily on single-hand manipulation and a limited range of interactions, leaving the bimanual dexterous behaviors common in real life unaddressed. The scarcity of contact-rich bimanual manipulation data and the increased complexity of coordinating contacts make developing a generalist bimanual tracker particularly challenging. Therefore, we present 1) DONIC, the first generalist bimanual tracker jointly trained across operation categories and human-motion sources, together with 2) BiHOI, a multi-view dataset of 1,575 sequences spanning 229 objects and emphasizing sustained bimanual interaction, where reconstructed interactions are retargeted into robot references. DONIC combines proximal policy optimization with behavioral cloning in a feedback loop that recycles verified successful executions into training demonstrations. An object-centered per-hand reward maintains object-motion feedback while supervising each hand according to its reference contact role. Clip-Centered Advantages remove reference-dependent advantage offsets while preserving within-trajectory differences. Together, these designs enable one single policy to learn coordinated manipulation across heterogeneous references. Without finetuning, a single checkpoint achieves 86.79% success on unseen trajectories of training objects and 57.32% on held-out objects, surpassing the state-of-the-art bimanual tracking baselines by 77.36 and 45.73 percentage points.
items.title_zh: 通用Dexterous双人追踪控制
items.detail_zh: 尽管最近在离子参考跟踪方面取得了进展,但现有的模型主要侧重于单手操纵和有限的相互作用范围,使得现实生活中常见的双手离子行为得不到解决. 缺乏内容丰富的双人操作数据以及协调接触日益复杂,使得开发通用双人跟踪器尤其具有挑战性。 因此,我们介绍1)DONIC,这是第一个跨行动类别和人类运动源联合培训的通用双人追踪器,以及2)波黑OI,一个由1,575个序列组成的多视图数据集,覆盖了229个物体,强调持续的双人互动,其中重建的互动被重新锁定为机器人参考。 DONIC将近效政策优化与行为克隆结合在一个反馈回路中,将已核实的死刑成功执行回收到训练演示中. 以对象为主的单手奖励保持对象运动反馈,同时按照参考接触作用监督每只手. 以 Clip-Clecting 为主的优势消除了依赖参考的优势相抵消,同时保留了内向差异. 这些设计合在一起,使单一政策能够学习不同参考文献的协调操作。 没有微调,一个检查站在未见的训练物体轨道上取得了86.79%的成功,在被扣留物体上取得了57.32%的成功,比最新双人追踪基线高出77.36和45.73个百分点。

items.detail: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve. We introduce RSI-Anything, a domain-general framework built on JEPA-Anything that uses predictive world models to guide action and learning-data selection. Observed feedback drives policy or workflow improvement and conditional world-model adaptation, while component and compatibility checks govern the retention of updated policy-model pairs. Across diverse computational and scientific domains, RSI-Anything demonstrates substantial gains. In code repair, with the coder fixed, success increases from 26.3% with a static verifier to 29.2% through predictive selection and 31.2% after world-model adaptation, at comparable test usage. Graphical user interface (GUI) evaluations showed higher task completion, while average actions decrease by 39.4%. Across five successive policy versions, laboratory-planning scores more than double from 21.80% to 46.01%. In reaction optimization, RSI-Anything achieves 96.15% mean best observed yield versus 82.16% for Bayesian optimization under the same 40-experiment budget. An end-to-end immune-science application further connects workflow evolution and predictive modeling with therapeutic hypothesis generation. These results demonstrate how predictive world models and retained system updates enable recursive improvement across diverse environments.
items.title_zh: RSI-任何东西:与世界模型解锁回转自我改进
items.detail_zh: 递增自强(RSI)旨在将互动经验转化为持久的改进,然而外部反馈成本高昂,随着政策的发展,世界模型预测可能变得不可靠. 我们介绍了RSI-Anything,这是建立在JEPA-Anything基础上的域总框架,它使用预测性的世界模型来指导行动和学习数据选择。 所观察到的反馈驱动着政策或工作流程的改进和有条件的世界模型改造,而组件和相容性检查则制约着更新后的政策模型对子的保存. 在各个不同的计算和科学领域,RSI-任何东西都显示出了巨大的收益。 在代码修复中,经过编码器的固定,通过预测选择,成功率从静态验证器的26.3%提高到29.2%,在世界模型改造后,成功率从31.2%提高到可比测试用量. 图形用户界面评价显示任务完成率较高,而平均行动减少39.4%。 在连续五个政策版本中,实验室规划的得分从21.80%上升到46.01%,翻了一番多。 在反应优化中,RSI-Anything实现96.15%的观测收益率最高,而Bayesian在相同的40实验预算下实现的优化为82.16%。 端到端的免疫科学应用进一步将工作流程演化和预测模型与治疗假说生成联系起来. 这些结果表明,预测性的世界模型和保留的系统更新如何使各种环境中的递归性改进得以进行。

items.detail: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a central post-training tool for large language models (LLMs), providing dense per-token teacher supervision along the student's own rollouts. In this work, we identify a common structural cause underlying OPD, which we call prefix failure. Under prefix failure, dense per-token supervision induces a bimodal teacher mixture and fragmented gradients that token-level loss truncation or reweighting fail to address. This observation motivates us to move beyond token-level loss interventions toward trajectory-level output corrections. We thus propose Trajectory-Refined Distillation (TRD), a trajectory-level correction method that revises the student's rollout under the teacher guidance while within on-policy support. By correcting problematic prefixes before distillation, TRD mitigates prefix failure at its source. Moreover, TRD improves the exploration by exposing the student to alternative valid derivations under teacher guidance, even when the original rolls are already correct. TRD can also be applied to on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), a parameter-sharing variant that uses the student model conditioned on privileged informations as the teacher. Across a wide range of benchmarks and base models at multiple scales, TRD consistently outperforms prior baselines, improving single-attempt accuracy and broadening reasoning coverage. Code is available at https://github.com/louieworth/trd
items.title_zh: 轨迹- 缩放
items.detail_zh: 政策上分馏(OPD)已成为大型语言模型(LLMs)培训后的核心工具,在学生自己推出的过程中提供密集的一脚一脚的教师监督. 在这部作品中,我们找出了OPD背后的共同结构原因,我们称之为前缀失败. 在前缀失效的情况下,密密的每根管束会诱发双模式教师混合物和零碎的梯度,使象征级损失分解或再加权无法解决. 这一观察促使我们超越象征性的损失干预,转向轨迹级产出修正。 因此,我们提议采用轨迹参考分解(TRD),这是一种轨迹级校正方法,在政策支持范围内修改学生在教师指导下的推广。 通过在蒸馏前纠正有问题的前缀,TRD会从源头减轻前缀故障. 此外,TRD通过让学生在教师指导下接触其他有效的衍生物来改进探索,即使原始卷已经正确. TRD还可以被应用到政策上自我消化(OPSD),这是一个参数共享的变体,使用以特权信息为条件的学生模式作为教师. 在多种规模的广泛基准和基准模型中,TRD的业绩始终高于先前的基线,提高了单试精度并扩大了推理范围。 代码见https://github.com/louieworth/trd。

items.title: MiniCPM-V 4.5: Cooking Efficient MLLMs via Architecture, Data, and Training Recipe
items.subtitle: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are undergoing rapid progress and represent the frontier of AI development. However, their training and inference efficiency have emerged as a core bottleneck in making MLLMs more accessible and scalable. To address the challenges, we present MiniCPM-V 4.5, an 8B parameter model designed for high efficiency and strong performance. items.detail: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are undergoing rapid progress and represent the frontier of AI development. However, their training and inference efficiency have emerged as a core bottleneck in making MLLMs more accessible and scalable. To address the challenges, we present MiniCPM-V 4.5, an 8B parameter model designed for high efficiency and strong performance. We introduce three core improvements in model architecture, data strategy and training method: a unified 3D-Resampler model architecture for highly compact encoding over images and videos, a unified learning paradigm for document knowledge and text recognition without heavy data engineering, and a hybrid reinforcement learning strategy for proficiency in both short and long reasoning modes. Comprehensive experimental results in OpenCompass evaluation show that MiniCPM-V 4.5 surpasses widely used proprietary models such as GPT-4o-latest, and significantly larger open-source models such as Qwen2.5-VL 72B. Notably, the strong performance is achieved with remarkable efficiency. For example, on the widely adopted VideoMME benchmark, MiniCPM-V 4.5 achieves state-of-the-art performance among models under 30B size, using just 46.7\% GPU memory cost and 8.7\% inference time of Qwen2.5-VL 7B.

items.detail_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)正在迅速进步,是AI发展的前沿. 然而,他们的培训和推论效率已成为提高MLLM的无障碍性和可扩展性的核心瓶颈。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提出了MiniCPM-V 4.5,一种8B参数模型,旨在提高效率和强性能。 我们在模型架构,数据策略和培训方法方面引入了三个核心改进:一个用于高度紧凑的图像和视频编码的统一3D-Resampler模型架构,一个用于文档知识和文本识别而不重数据工程的统一学习范式,以及一个用于精通短和长推理模式的混合强化学习策略. OpenCompass评价的综合实验结果显示,MiniCPM-V 4.5超越了GPT-4o-latest等被广泛使用的专有模型,而Quen2.5-VL 72B等显著更大的开源模型. 值得注意的是,以显著的效率取得了良好的业绩。 例如,在被广泛采纳的VideoMME基准上,MiniCPM-V 4.5在30B尺寸以下的模型中实现了最先进的性能,仅使用46.7+QGPU内存成本和8.7+X推断时间为Quen2.5-VL 7B.

items.detail: Scaling video diffusion transformers (DiTs) is limited by their quadratic 3D attention, even though most of the attention mass concentrates on a small subset of positions. We turn this observation into VSA, a trainable, hardware-efficient sparse attention that replaces full attention at both training and inference. In VSA, a lightweight coarse stage pools tokens into tiles and identifies high-weight critical tokens; a fine stage computes token-level attention only inside those tiles subjecting to block computing layout to ensure hard efficiency. This leads to a single differentiable kernel that trains end-to-end, requires no post-hoc profiling, and sustains 85\% of FlashAttention3 MFU. We perform a large sweep of ablation studies and scaling-law experiments by pretraining DiTs from 60M to 1.4B parameters. VSA reaches a Pareto point that cuts training FLOPS by 2.53times with no drop in diffusion loss. Retrofitting the open-source Wan-2.1 model speeds up attention time by 6times and lowers end-to-end generation time from 31s to 18s with comparable quality. These results establish trainable sparse attention as a practical alternative to full attention and a key enabler for further scaling of video diffusion models.

items.detail: We introduce a novel 3D generation method for versatile and high-quality 3D asset creation. The cornerstone is a unified Structured LATent (SLAT) representation which allows decoding to different output formats, such as Radiance Fields, 3D Gaussians, and meshes. This is achieved by integrating a sparsely-populated 3D grid with dense multiview visual features extracted from a powerful vision foundation model, comprehensively capturing both structural (geometry) and textural (appearance) information while maintaining flexibility during decoding. We employ rectified flow transformers tailored for SLAT as our 3D generation models and train models with up to 2 billion parameters on a large 3D asset dataset of 500K diverse objects. Our model generates high-quality results with text or image conditions, significantly surpassing existing methods, including recent ones at similar scales. We showcase flexible output format selection and local 3D editing capabilities which were not offered by previous models. Code, model, and data will be released.
items.title_zh: 可缩放和Versatile 3D生成结构化的 三维梯度
items.detail_zh: 我们为多能和高品质的三维资产创造引入了一种新的三维生成方法。 基石是统一的结构化LATent(SLAT)代表,可以解码出不同的输出格式,如radiance Fields,3D Gaussians,和meshes. 实现这一点的方法是整合从强大的视觉基础模型中提取的密集多视图视觉特征的稀少的3D网格,全面捕捉结构(几何)和纹理(出现)信息,同时在解码过程中保持灵活性. 我们使用专门为SLAT设计的修正流变器作为我们的3D生成模型,并在500K多种物体的大型3D资产数据集上使用多达20亿个参数的火车模型。 我们的模式产生高质量的结果,具有文字或图像条件,大大超越了现有方法,包括类似尺度的最近方法。 我们展示了以往模型没有提供的灵活输出格式选择和当地三维编辑能力。 代码、模型和数据将会发布。

items.detail: Recent progress in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has brought AI capabilities from static offline data processing to real-time streaming interaction, yet they still remain far from human-level multimodal interaction. The key bottlenecks are no longer modality coverage or latency alone, but the interaction paradigm itself. First, perception and response are still separated into alternating phases, preventing models from incorporating new inputs for timely adjustment during generation. Second, most current models remain reactive, responding only to explicit user requests instead of acting proactively in the evolving multimodal environment. We present MiniCPM-o 4.5, our latest effort towards human-like multimodal interaction, which mitigates these gaps by real-time full-duplex omni-modal interaction. It can see, listen, and speak simultaneously in real-time, while also exhibiting proactive behaviors such as issuing reminders or comments based on its continuous understanding of the live scene. The key technique behind MiniCPM-o 4.5 is Omni-Flow, a unified streaming framework that aligns omni-modal inputs and outputs along a shared temporal axis. This formulation converts conventional turn-based interaction into a full-duplex, time-aligned process, enabling simultaneous perception and response and allowing proactive behavior to arise within the same framework. With a total of 9B parameters, MiniCPM-o 4.5 approaches Gemini 2.5 Flash in vision-language capabilities, delivering state-of-the-art open-source performance at its scale. It also surpasses Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B in omni-modal understanding and delivers better speech generation, with significantly higher computation efficiency. Driven by its efficient architecture design and inference optimization, the model can perform real-time full-duplex omni-modal interaction on edge devices with less than 12GB RAM cost.
items.title_zh: MiniCPM-o 4.5:实现实时全双相模态互动
items.detail_zh: 最近在多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)上的进展,使AI能力从静态下线数据处理到实时流线交互,然而它们仍然远离人-人的多模式交互. 关键瓶颈不再仅仅是模式覆盖面或持久性,而是互动模式本身。 首先,感知和反应仍然被分成交替阶段,使模型无法纳入新的投入,以便在生成过程中及时进行调整。 其次,目前大多数模式仍然是被动的,只回应明确的用户要求,而不是在不断变化的多模式环境中主动采取行动。 我们介绍MiniCPM-o 4.5,这是我们最近为人类式多模式互动而作的努力,通过实时的全双模式互动来缩小这些差距。 它可以实时看到,聆听,并同时发言,同时也表现出主动积极的行为,例如根据其对现场的持续理解发出提醒或评论. MiniCPM-o 4.5背后的关键技术是"Omni-Flow"("Omni-Flow"),这是一个统一流线框架,按照共享的时间轴来将全米模式输入和输出相协调. 这种提法将常规的转动互动转化为一个完全的,时间相接的过程,使同时感知和反应成为可能,并允许在同一框架内出现主动的行为. 总共9B参数,MiniCPM-o 4.5接近双子座2.5 闪耀于视觉语言能力,按其规模提供最先进的开源性能. 它在全方位模式理解中也超过了Qune3-Omni-30B-A3B,并提供了更好的语音生成,具有显著更高的计算效率. 在其高效的架构设计和推想优化的推动下,该模型可以在边缘设备上进行全时全相模-模式交互,成本低于12GB RAM.

items.detail: Agent learning is shifting from learning from human data toward learning through interaction with the world. However, scaling such learning directly in real-world computer systems is challenging and can introduce substantial security risks. We therefore propose Agent World Model in the Wild (WildAWM), a scalable pipeline for synthesizing controllable environments and tasks for training general computer-use agents (CUAs). Whereas existing approaches typically specialize in a single agent interaction interface, we construct executable environments that jointly support graphical user interfaces, model context protocol services, and command-line interfaces, allowing agents to flexibly combine visual interaction, tool use, and code execution. WildAWM is entirely powered by open-source models, demonstrating that high-quality computer-use environments can be generated without proprietary frontier models. Beyond environments, we address three recurring challenges in task synthesis: ensuring solvability, maintaining sufficient difficulty, and producing reliable verifiers, by introducing execution-based quality gates that combine heterogeneous agent rollouts, cross-judge consistency checks, and counterfactual probes of judgment robustness. The resulting pipeline synthesizes 341 long-horizon environment-task pairs that can require over 100 agent steps to solve and remain challenging even for frontier models, with GPT-6-Astra solving only 60% of them. We train two Qwen models of different sizes exclusively in these synthetic worlds. Both models achieve substantial gains across 8 out-of-distribution benchmarks spanning web, claw, and computer-use agents, demonstrating that learning in WildAWM's synthesized worlds generalizes broadly to unseen computer-use tasks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM.
items.title_zh: 野外代理世界模型:计算机使用代理环境综合
items.detail_zh: 代理学习正在从学习人类数据转向通过与世界的互动来学习。 然而,在现实世界计算机系统中直接推广这种学习具有挑战性,可能带来巨大的安全风险。 因此,我们提议在野外建立世界代理模式(WildAWM),这是一个可扩展的管道,用于合成可控制的环境和培训一般计算机使用代理的任务。 虽然现有方法一般专门用于单一代理交互接口,但我们构建了可执行环境,共同支持图形用户界面,模式上下文协议服务,以及命令行界面,使代理能够灵活地将视觉交互,工具使用和代码执行结合起来. WildAWM完全由开源模型提供动力,表明高质量的计算机使用环境可以在没有专有前沿模型的情况下生成. 除了环境之外,我们还应对任务综合中反复出现的三个挑战:确保可溶性、保持足够的困难并产生可靠的核实者,方法是采用基于执行的质量门,将不同代理人的推出、交叉判断的一致性检查和判断力的反事实探测结合起来。 由此形成的管线合成了341个长相环境任务对子,可以要求100多个代理步骤来解决并保持挑战,即使是前沿模型,GPT-6-Astra只解决了其中60%. 我们专门在这些合成世界训练两个大小不同的Quen模型. 这两个模型在覆盖网络、爪子和计算机使用物剂的8项分配外基准方面取得了巨大收益,表明在WildAWM的合成世界中学习将广泛归纳为无形的计算机使用任务。 该守则可在https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM上公开查阅。

items.detail: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as long-term interactive agents, yet their limited context windows make it difficult to sustain coherent behavior over extended interactions. Existing memory systems often store isolated records and retrieve fragments, limiting their ability to consolidate evolving user states and resolve conflicts. We introduce EverMemOS, a self-organizing memory operating system that implements an engram-inspired lifecycle for computational memory. Episodic Trace Formation converts dialogue streams into MemCells that capture episodic traces, atomic facts, and time-bounded Foresight signals. Semantic Consolidation organizes MemCells into thematic MemScenes, distilling stable semantic structures and updating user profiles. Reconstructive Recollection performs MemScene-guided agentic retrieval to compose the necessary and sufficient context for downstream reasoning. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show that EverMemOS achieves state-of-the-art performance on memory-augmented reasoning tasks. We further report a profile study on PersonaMem v2 and qualitative case studies illustrating chat-oriented capabilities such as user profiling and Foresight. Code is available at https://github.com/EverMind-AI/EverMemOS.
items.title_zh: EverMemOS:结构化长视距内存操作系统
items.detail_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)作为长期互动代理越来越多地被部署,然而其有限的上下文窗口使得在扩展互动上难以维持连贯的行为. 现有的内存系统经常存储孤立的记录并取回片段,限制了它们整合不断发展的用户状态并解决冲突的能力. 我们引入了EverMemOS,一个自组织内存操作系统,它执行一个被engram启发的生命周期,用于计算内存. Episodic Trace Formation 将对话框流转换为MemCells,可以捕捉出零星的痕迹,原子事实,以及有时限的前瞻信号. 语义整合将MemCells组织成主题的MemScens,分馏出稳定的语义结构并更新用户简介. 重构回想执行 MemScene-guided agentic reference 为下游推理创造出必要而充足的上下文. LoCoMo和LongMemEval上的实验显示,EverMemOS在内存增强推理任务上实现了最先进的性能. 我们还报告关于PersonaMem v2的概况研究和定性案例研究,说明以聊天为导向的能力,如用户剖析和展望。 代码见https://github.com/EverMind-AI/EverMemOS。

items.detail: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has proven to be an effective tool for post-training language models (LMs). However, AI systems are increasingly expressed as modular programs that mix together multiple LM calls with distinct prompt templates and other tools, and it is not clear how best to leverage GRPO to improve these systems. We begin to address this challenge by defining mmGRPO, a simple multi-module generalization of GRPO that groups LM calls by module across rollouts and handles variable-length and interrupted trajectories. We find that mmGRPO, composed with automatic prompt optimization, improves accuracy by 11% on average across classification, many-hop search, and privacy-preserving delegation tasks against the post-trained LM, and by 5% against prompt optimization on its own. We open-source mmGRPO in DSPy as the dspy.GRPO optimizer.
items.title_zh: 多模块 GRPO: 语言模型程序构建政策梯度和快速优化
items.detail_zh: 团体相对政策优化(GRPO)已被证明是培训后语言模型的有效工具. 然而,AI系统越来越多地被表述为模块化程序,将多个LM调用组合在一起,并带有独特的即时模板和其他工具,目前尚不清楚如何最佳地利用GRPO来改进这些系统. 我们开始通过定义mmGRPO来应对这一挑战,这是一个简单的GRPO的多模块概括,LM组通过模块逐个调用,处理可变长度和被中断的轨迹. 我们发现由自动快速优化组成的 mmGRPO 提高了准确度 11% 跨分类,多跳搜索, 和隐私保护任务 后训练的 LM , 以及5% 的 自身快速优化。 我们在DSPY开源的mmGRPO作为dspy. GPRO优化器.

items.detail: Harness development plays a crucial role in building capable AI agents. Recent approaches improve harnesses through recursive self-improvement (RSI), but their performance gains often come with higher execution costs. We introduce HarnessPro, a label-free method for evolving harnesses to improve task performance while reducing execution cost. In this setting, candidate harnesses are evaluated using LLM-generated tests without access to ground-truth solutions or official tests. Specialized agents diagnose execution trajectories, plan updates with different performance-cost priorities, and implement them as candidate harnesses. Rather than returning a single harness, HarnessPro uses normalized weighted squared-distance selection to provide cost-focused (lite), balanced (medium), and performance-focused (heavy) harnesses for different deployment budgets. Selected harnesses enter the next iteration, where execution feedback guides further updates. Our experiments cover Terminal-Bench 2, SWE-Bench Pro, and ProgramBench, using GPT-5.5 with Codex and GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Across these benchmarks using GPT-5.5 with Codex, the heavy mode of HarnessPro achieves an average pass-rate gain of 2.0 percentage points and an average per-task cost reduction of 26.1% relative to RHO. This advantage also holds when using GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Code is available at https://github.com/pzs19/HarnessPro
items.title_zh: HarnessPro:与Pareto优化性能-成本取舍的递归性取舍自我改进
items.detail_zh: 在建立有能力的AI代理商方面,利用性发展发挥着至关重要的作用. 最近的办法通过递归性自我改进(RSI)改进了利用,但其业绩收益往往伴随着较高的执行成本。 我们引入了HarnessPro,一种无标签的方法,用于不断演化的牵引来提高任务性能并同时降低执行成本. 在此情况下,通过LLM生成的测试对候选带进行评估,而无法获得地面真实解决方案或正式测试。 专门人员对执行轨迹进行诊断,根据不同的性能成本优先事项计划更新,并作为候选工具加以实施。 HarnessPro没有返回单一的航道,而是使用正常的加权平方距离选择,为不同的部署预算提供注重成本(升)、平衡(中)和注重绩效(重)的航道。 被选中的牵引器会进入下一个迭代,其中执行反馈指导进一步更新. 我们的实验涵盖Bench 2号终端、SWE-Bench Pro和Program Bench,使用GPT-5.5同Codex和GLM-5.2同Claude Code. 在这些基准中,使用GPT-5.5和Codex,HarnessPro的重型模式平均通过率收益为2.0个百分点,每个任务的平均成本比RHO降低26.1%。 在使用克洛德代码的GLM-5.2时,这种优势也存在. 代码见https://github.com/pzs19/HarnesPro。

items.detail: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adapted to downstream tasks via reinforcement learning (RL) methods like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which often require thousands of rollouts to learn new tasks. We argue that the interpretable nature of language can often provide a much richer learning medium for LLMs, compared with policy gradients derived from sparse, scalar rewards. To test this, we introduce GEPA (Genetic-Pareto), a prompt optimizer that thoroughly incorporates natural language reflection to learn high-level rules from trial and error. Given any AI system containing one or more LLM prompts, GEPA samples system-level trajectories (e.g., reasoning, tool calls, and tool outputs) and reflects on them in natural language to diagnose problems, propose and test prompt updates, and combine complementary lessons from the Pareto frontier of its own attempts. As a result of GEPA's design, it can often turn even just a few rollouts into a large quality gain. Across four tasks, GEPA outperforms GRPO by 10% on average and by up to 20%, while using up to 35x fewer rollouts. GEPA also outperforms the leading prompt optimizer, MIPROv2, by over 10% across two LLMs, and demonstrates promising results as an inference-time search strategy for code optimization.
items.title_zh: GEPA:反思性快速演变能够超越强化学习
items.detail_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)越来越多地通过强化学习(RL)方法来适应下游任务,如Group相亲政策优化(GRPO),这往往需要上千个推出来学习新的任务. 我们争辩说,语言的可解释性往往能为法学硕士课程提供更丰富的学习媒介,而政策梯度则来自稀少的分级奖励。 为了检验这一点,我们引入了GEPA(Genetic-Pareto),这是一个快速优化器,它彻底融入了自然语言的反射,从试想和错误中学习高层次规则. 鉴于任何包含一个或多个LLM提示的AI系统,GEPA对系统层面的轨迹(例如推理,工具调用,工具输出)进行抽样,并以自然语言进行反思,以诊断问题,提出并测试即时更新,并结合从Pareto前沿获得的自身尝试的补充经验教训. 由于GEPA的设计,它往往甚至可以把哪怕几个推出变成一个巨大的质量收益. 在四项任务中,GEPA的绩效平均比GPRO高出10%,最高可达20%,而推出量则减少35倍。 GEPA还超越了领先的即时优化器MIPROv2, 超过两个LLM的10%,

items.detail: An LLM agent's capability is largely magnified by its harness, namely the prompts, control flow, tooling, memory, and context management surrounding the frozen backbone model. Recent methods increasingly automate this process by iteratively proposing and selecting component-wise edits of an agent harness, practically establishing a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI) at the agent-system level. However, such recursive evolution may overfit by memorizing the training tasks, showing large in-distribution gains that shrink or even vanish on out-of-distribution benchmarks. We introduce Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses (RRSI), which incorporates the principles of regularizations into harness self-improvement by constraining the evolution candidate proposal and selection. The proposer operates with a temporally annealed budget, limiting how many edits a candidate can bundle, and it encourages unexplored trajectories based on evolution history. The selector is equipped with a critic and a pruner: the critic screens benchmark-specific proposals, while the pruner, removes changes that are too small, too expensive, or no longer useful. Together these constraints favor reusable agent mechanisms over benchmark-specific ones or even noises. Across eight benchmarks spanning coding, agentic workspace and engineering design tasks, RRSI gains up to 14.1 points on the split it evolves against and up to 4.7 points on the five out-of-distribution benchmarks, while producing a harness that runs on 30% fewer policy tokens than the unregularized evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/google-research/rrsi and project page is https://regularized-rsi.com/.
items.title_zh: RRSI: 特工哈内斯的常规递归自我改进
items.detail_zh: 一个LLM代理的能力在很大程度上被它的操纵所放大,即围绕被冻结的骨干模型的导出,控制流,工具,内存和上下文管理. 最近的方法通过迭接地提议和选择按元件编辑一种干线带,使这一过程日益自动化,实际上在干线系统一级建立了一种自变自变的形式。 然而,这种再演化可能过于适合训练任务,显示出巨大的分配收益,这些收益在分配基准外缩小甚至消失。 我们引入了对哈内塞斯特工(RRSI)的规范化自我改进(RRSI),通过限制进化候选人的建议和选择,将规范化原则纳入自我改进。 提议者以暂时性厌倦的预算运作,限制一个候选者可以捆绑多少编辑,鼓励基于进化史的未探索出轨. 选取者配备有评论家和花花公子:评论家筛选出特定基准的建议,而花花公子则去除太小,太贵或不再有用的变化. 这些制约因素加在一起有利于可重复使用的代理机制,而不是基准机制,甚至还有噪音。 RRSI在涉及编码、代理工作空间和工程设计任务的8个基准中,在与分配外的5个基准相对应的划分上获得最高14.1分的收益,在分配外的5个基准上获得最高4.7分的收益,同时生产出比非规范化演变少了30%的政策标志。 代码见https://github.com/google-research/rrsi,项目页见https://rentized-rsi.com/.

items.title: Toward Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI
items.subtitle: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) describes a system that improves not only its behavior but also the process by which it improves. items.detail: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) describes a system that improves not only its behavior but also the process by which it improves. Recent digital agents test this idea by rewriting their own code and checking each version with executable tests. Bringing these mechanisms into the physical world requires learning from partial observations through costly trials, while accounting for changing operating conditions and potentially irreversible consequences. We position RSI within robot learning and trace pathways from improving robot capabilities to improving the processes that generate them. We examine how physical experience can strengthen these improvement mechanisms and when the resulting gains can support further self-improvement of the mechanisms themselves. Gains carry forward only when feedback addresses remaining learning needs, the receiving component can use the change, its value survives changes in tasks or hardware, and continued practice remains safe and affordable. Existing studies, concentrated in manipulation, support behavioral improvement, benefits to later learning, and procedure improvement. Some systems also change the improver's knowledge or tools, but the physical studies reviewed here have yet to isolate gains attributable to recursion. We synthesize these findings into evaluation principles and research directions for machines that, trial by trial, safely improve the way they improve.
items.title_zh: 在身体AI中实现自我改进
items.detail_zh: 递归自修(RSI)描述了一种系统,它不仅改善了它的行为,而且改善了它的过程. 最近的数字代理通过重写自己的代码并用可执行测试检查每个版本来测试这个想法. 使这些机制进入实际世界,需要通过昂贵的试验从部分观察中学习,同时考虑不断变化的运作条件和可能不可逆转的后果。 我们把RSI定位在机器人学习和追踪路径中,从提高机器人能力到改善生成机器人的过程. 我们审查实际经验如何能加强这些改进机制,以及由此产生的成果何时能支持这些机制本身的自我改进。 只有在反馈满足了剩余的学习需要,接收部分能够利用变化,其价值在任务或硬件的变化中存活下来时,收益才能继续前进,而持续的做法仍然是安全和负担得起的. 现有的研究,集中于操纵,支持行为上的改善,有利于后期学习,以及程序上的改进. 有些系统也改变改进者的知识或工具,但本文所审查的物理研究尚未分离出可归因于复发的收益. 我们把这些结果综合到对机器的评价原则和研究方向中,这些机器通过试验可以安全地改进改进方式。

items.detail: System one models enable direct, low-latency decision-making. Yet recent practice of predicting an answer from serialized text does not, by itself, respect the structure of a decision problem. We argue that current designs underemphasize four important structural requirements. (i) null-aware: Models should distinguish answer absence from uncertainty among candidates; (ii) permutation-invariant: Reordering alternatives should not change the decision; (iii) option-scalable: Growing candidate sets should not require redefining the output space; (iv) cacheable: Request-independent computation over recurring alternatives should be reusable across requests. We introduce Jeva, a decision-native architecture that addresses these requirements jointly. A shared encoder independently represents the request and each option, while a compact decision stack refines only the request state against immutable option memory. Symmetric aggregation yields permutation-equivariant probabilities; shared scoring accommodates variable-size candidate sets. A separate coverage estimate distinguishes answer absence from candidate competition, enabling explicit null outcomes. Request-independent option representations and layer projections support reuse across newly assembled sets. These mechanisms unify Choice, Noul, and Score outputs. Across evaluations, Jeva combines strong typed-decision performance with near-perfect null detection and no decision flips under any tested permutations. It scales to thousands of candidates and substantially reduces latency through cross-request reuse without changing decisions.
items.title_zh: Jeva: 来自第一原则的系统模式
items.detail_zh: 系统一模型可以进行直接、低相关性的决策。 然而,最近从序列化文本中预测答案的做法本身并不尊重决定问题的结构。 我们认为,目前的设计低估了四个重要的结构要求。 (一)无意识:模型应区分答案缺失和候选人的不确定性;(二)永久性变量:重排替代品不应改变决定;(三)可选择可扩展性:不断增长的一组候选人不应要求重新界定产出空间;(四)可缓存性:请求独立计算相对于反复出现的替代品应可重复使用。 我们介绍了杰瓦,这是一个共同满足这些要求的决策-内在结构。 一个共享编码器独立代表请求和每个选项,而一个紧凑的决定堆栈则只对请求状态进行精炼来对抗不可变的选项内存. 对称的汇总收成-等同概率;共享分数可容纳可变大小的候选组合. 单独的覆盖范围估计将答案缺失与候选竞争区分开来,从而导致明确无效的结果。 请求独立的选项说明和分层预测支持新组装的复用。 这些机制统一了选择、努尔和分数产出。 在整个评价中,杰瓦将强打型决定性能与近乎完美无能的无效检测相结合,在任何被测试的穿透下都没有决定翻转. 它的规模达到数千名候选人,并通过不改变决定的交叉请求再利用来大大减少延迟。

items.detail: Data-centric training has emerged as a promising direction for improving large language models (LLMs) by optimizing not only model parameters but also the selection, composition, and weighting of training data during optimization. However, existing approaches to data selection, data mixture optimization, and data reweighting are often developed in isolated codebases with inconsistent interfaces, hindering reproducibility, fair comparison, and practical integration. In this paper, we present DataFlex, a unified data-centric dynamic training framework built upon LLaMA-Factory. DataFlex supports three major paradigms of dynamic data optimization: sample selection, domain mixture adjustment, and sample reweighting, while remaining fully compatible with the original training workflow. It provides extensible trainer abstractions and modular components, enabling a drop-in replacement for standard LLM training, and unifies key model-dependent operations such as embedding extraction, inference, and gradient computation, with support for large-scale settings including DeepSpeed ZeRO-3. We conduct comprehensive experiments across multiple data-centric methods. Dynamic data selection consistently outperforms static full-data training on MMLU across both Mistral-7B and Llama-3.2-3B. For data mixture, DoReMi and ODM improve both MMLU accuracy and corpus-level perplexity over default proportions when pretraining Qwen2.5-1.5B on SlimPajama at 6B and 30B token scales. DataFlex also achieves consistent runtime improvements over original implementations. These results demonstrate that DataFlex provides an effective, efficient, and reproducible infrastructure for data-centric dynamic training of LLMs.
items.title_zh: DataFlex:大语言模型数据-儿童动态培训的统一框架
items.detail_zh: 以数据为中心的培训已成为改进大型语言模型的有希望的方向,不仅优化了模型参数,而且在优化期间优化了培训数据的选择、组成和权重。 然而,数据选择、数据混合物优化和数据再加权的现有方法常常是在接口不一致的孤立代码库中开发的,阻碍了可复制性、公平比较和实际的整合。 在本文中,我们介绍了DataFlex,这是一个基于LLaMA-Factory的以数据为中心的统一动态培训框架. DataFlex支持动态数据优化的三个主要范式:样本选择,域相混合调整,和样本再加权,同时保持与原始培训工作流程完全相容. 它提供了可扩展的教练抽象和模块化组件,使得标准LLM培训能够被滴入替换,并统一了嵌入取取出,推论,梯度计算等关键依赖模型的操作,支持包括DeepSpeed ZeRO-3在内的大规模设置. 我们通过多种以数据为中心的方法进行综合实验。 动态数据选择在Mistral-7B和Llama-3.2-3B两地的MMLU的静态全数据培训上都一直超过业绩。 对于数据混合物,当在SlimPajama上以6B和30B符号标尺预先训练Quen2.5-1.5B时,DoRemi和ODM既能提高MMLU的准确度,又能提高实体水平的复杂度,使其高于默认比例。 DataFlex还实现了与原始执行相比的一致运行时间改进. 这些结果表明,DataFlex为LLMs的数据中心动态培训提供了有效、高效和可复制的基础设施。

items.detail: This report presents VibeVoice, a novel model designed to synthesize long-form speech with multiple speakers by employing next-token diffusion, which is a unified method for modeling continuous data by autoregressively generating latent vectors via diffusion. To enable this, we introduce a novel continuous speech tokenizer that, when compared to the popular Encodec model, improves data compression by 80 times while maintaining comparable performance. The tokenizer effectively preserves audio fidelity while significantly boosting computational efficiency for processing long sequences. Thus, VibeVoice can synthesize long-form speech for up to 90 minutes (in a 64K context window length) with a maximum of 4 speakers, capturing the authentic conversational ``vibe'' and surpassing open-source and proprietary dialogue models.
items.detail_zh: 本报告介绍了VibeVoice,这是一种新颖的模型,旨在通过使用相邻的传播来合成长式语音和多位扬声器,这是一种通过传播自相递相生成潜在向量来模拟连续数据的统一方法. 为了启用此功能,我们引入了一种新颖的连续语音表示器,与流行的Encodec模型相比,在保持可比较性能的同时,可以将数据压缩提高80倍. 标致器有效保存了音频的忠实性,同时大大提高了处理长序列的计算效率. 因此,VibeVoice可以将长式语音合成到最多90分钟(以64K上下文窗口长度),最多可有4个扬声器,捕捉正宗对话""vibe"并超越开源和专有对话模式.

items.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
items.subtitle: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
items.detail: A coding-agent skill that turns your agent into a security auditor. It orchestrates isolated agents through reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification, and target-neutral reporting. This is the skill that seeded Cloudflare's vulnerability discovery harness, described in Build your own vulnerability harness. The harness grew into a multi-stage, fleet-wide system; this skill is the single-repo starting point it evolved from. 1. Reconnaissance -- map architecture, trust boundaries, input surfaces, prior evidence, and deterministic coverage in architecture.md and coverage-ledger.json. 2. Coverage-led hunting -- assign isolated hunters from ledger units, record their checks, and use coverage critics to find gaps. 3. Candidate validation -- give every unique candidate to a fresh verifier that tries to disprove it. 4. Structured output -- write confirmed, needsvalidation, and rejected records to findings.json and validate them against report-schema.json. 5. Independent record verification -- fresh agents verify final source claims. Material replacements receive another independent verifier. 6. Target-neutral reporting -- derive REPORT.md, FINDINGS-DETAIL.md, and NEEDS-VALIDATION.md from the verified records and coverage ledger.

items.title: akitaonrails/ai-memory
items.subtitle: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors
items.detail: Your coding agent probably has a memory feature already. Claude Code takes its own notes, Cursor remembers some things, and every platform is adding more. They all have the same limits: the notes live on one machine, belong to one agent, and drop out of view when you switch tools or hand the work to a teammate. Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Grok, Devin, Kimi, Kiro, and others) feed one shared memory. Quit Claude Code mid-task, open Codex in the same directory, and the next agent picks up a handoff that says where you left off, what failed, and what is still open. Handoffs are a typed protocol: each one has an owner and is claimed exactly once. ai-memory run: quit Claude Code, run ai-memory run codex, and Codex gets the shared workstream plus a private, temporary local projection of Claude's visible native history for exact details the bounded startup packet omitted. The remote server receives only the harness and session identity, never the local transcript path or body. Direct harness launches behave exactly as before.

Codex, Cursor,双子座CLI,OpenCode,Grok,Devin,Kimi,Kiro等)提供1个共享内存. 退出Claude代码中任务,在同一目录中打开了Codex,而下一位代理则取出一张交接单,上面写出你离开的地方,什么失败,什么还在打开. Handoffs是一个打字协议:每个都有一个所有者,并被要求一次。 ai-memory 运行:退出 Claude Code, 运行 ai-memory 运行 codex, Codex 获得共享的工作流外加一个私有的,临时的本地投影 克洛德可见的本地历史 精确的详情, 边框起动包被省略. 远程服务器只接收到带和会话身份,从不接收本地记录路径或正文. 直接拉带发射的动作和以前一样

items.subtitle: De-AI writing skill for any Agent Skills-compatible agent (77+ via the Skills CLI), with native plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, and Antigravity. Narrative-architecture repair for fiction, venue-matched rules for professional prose. Based on StoryScope (arXiv:2604.03136).
items.badge: GitHub · 新创建 Skills 仓库
items.author: Python
items.detail: A portable Agent Skill: any agent that speaks the standard can load it, and the Skills CLI, which supports 77+ agents, installs it with one command. Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Antigravity, and QwenPaw additionally get native plugin packaging. One canonical SKILL.md, no per-platform forks. Four operations: write, review (diagnose only), refactor (minimal edits), recreate (full rewrite). Every popular humanizer edits word choice and syntax. StoryScope (Russell et al., 2026: 61,608 stories, human + 5 frontier LLMs) showed that a classifier using narrative-structure features alone detects AI fiction at 93.2% macro-F1. In the same study's LAMP-edited condition, where human editors had rewritten the surface style, detection dropped only from 95.5% to 93.9%. The tells that survive are architectural: themes explained by the narrator, single-track causally-tidy plots, emotions rendered only as bodily sensation, no real-world references, no reader, linear time, endings resolved by protagonist growth and acceptance. sepia turns those measured gaps, together with the related studies digested in research/, into a three-pass writing and revision protocol for fiction:

items.badge: GitHub · 新创建 Skills 仓库
items.author: Python
items.detail: Give your coding agent a video editor. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client edits your footage with local FFmpeg, then checks its own output. No cloud · No API keys · Python standard library Left half is the input, right half is what the command produced. All 66 before/after demos, with the exact command under each one → — all of it generated from synthetic footage by python3 demos/build.py, so you can rebuild every frame of it yourself. ffmpeg-skill is an Agent Skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and any agent that reads SKILL.md. It teaches the agent a fixed workflow (probe → edit losslessly where possible → check → verify) and ships 42 tools that do the actual work with ffmpeg / ffprobe: cut, join, silence removal, fit to duration and aspect, captions and karaoke, overlays and motion graphics, HDR → SDR and LUTs, audio clean-up and typed dynamics, sync with drift correction, multicam, loudness, delivery checks, whole-edit project rendering, batch folders. Every tool is also callable as an MCP tool (tools/list advertises a core 12 by default to keep client context small, with FFMPEGSKILLMCPFULL=1 listing all 42; every tool is reachable by name through tools/call either way), and the whole set is described by a machine-readable contract.

items.detail: Research Solution Supervisor 是一个面向研究型工作的 AI 监督 skill。它不负责把研究重新做一遍，而是判断 AI 的回答、研究 pass 或方案建议是否真正推进了用户的研究目标，并把结论转成下一步可执行动作。 这个 skill 借鉴了 Intent Debugger 的思路：先把目标和判断标准说清楚，再评估当前输出是否满足这些标准。不同点在于，Intent Debugger 更偏“把模糊意图变成可确认需求”，Research Solution Supervisor 更偏“监督 AI 是否让研究方案真的向前走”。 1. 推进判断：当前 AI 工作是否解决了本阶段问题。 2. 关键缺口：哪些缺失、冲突或证据不足会影响继续推进。 3. 下一步动作：下一轮最该做什么，必要时给出可直接发送的 prompt。 4. 当前状态：哪些可以暂时视为成立，哪些仍然不能依赖。

items.detail_en: Research Solutions Manager is an AI skiller for research-oriented work. It is not responsible for re-examining research, but rather for determining whether AI ' s answers, studies pass or programme recommendations really advance the user ' s research objectives and translates the conclusions into next implementable actions. This skill draws on the idea of Intent Debugger: first, to clarify the objective and the judgement criteria, then to assess whether the current output meets them. The difference is that the Intent Debugger prefers "to turn vague intent into an identifiable need" and the Research Solutions Manager favours "supervising AI to make research programmes really move forward." 1. Advance judgement: whether the current AI process has resolved this stage of the problem. 2. Key gaps: what are missing, conflicting or insufficient evidence to influence further progress. 3. Next steps: The next round should do the most, giving, if necessary, a prompt that can be sent directly. 4. Current state: which can be considered valid for the time being and which cannot still be relied upon.

Unlike cloud browser-use tools that require spun-up headless containers, login bypass proxies, or remote servers, OpenBUA operates right inside your existing browser session with all your active cookies, credentials, and logins already available.
